title.zh: MYCIN · 把专家知识写成规则
title.en: MYCIN · writing expertise as rules

hook.zh: 把领域知识写成一条条规则，还能解释自己为什么这样建议。
hook.en: It stored expert knowledge as rules and could explain the advice it gave.

body.zh: 1975 年的系统报告里，MYCIN 把领域知识写成一条条规则。它能解释自己给出的建议，也能接收新加的规则。这种做法叫知识工程：把专家知道的东西，整理成机器能用的规则。它当时是一个研究系统。
body.en: In its 1975 system report, MYCIN stored domain knowledge as rules. It could explain the recommendations it gave and accept new rules. This approach is called knowledge engineering: turning what experts know into rules a machine can use. MYCIN was a research system at the time.

limit.zh: 知识怎么持续维护，规则没覆盖到的情况怎么办，它都没解决。
limit.en: How to keep the knowledge maintained, and what to do when no rule applies, stayed open.

title.zh: SVM · 把分界线画得离两边都远
title.en: SVM · drawing a boundary far from both classes

hook.zh: 分界线离两类样本都尽量远，留出一段间隔。
hook.en: It places the dividing line as far as possible from both classes of examples.

body.zh: SVM 分类时，找一条离两边样本都尽量远的分界线，这段距离叫间隔。1995 年这篇代表作，让它也能处理两类数据分不干净的情况。间隔、正则化和核方法合在一起，是统计学习自己的一套建模选择，算不上通往神经网络的过渡。
body.en: An SVM classifies by finding a dividing line that stays as far as possible from the examples on both sides; that distance is the margin. The 1995 work extended it to data that cannot be cleanly separated. Margins, regularization, and kernels together form statistical learning's own set of modeling choices, not a stopgap on the way to neural networks.

limit.zh: 核方法早于这篇论文，它补上的是数据分不干净时怎么办。
limit.en: Kernel methods predate this paper; what it added was a way to handle data that cannot be cleanly separated.

title.zh: Dartmouth · 一群人聚到 AI 名下
title.en: Dartmouth · gathering research under the name AI

hook.zh: 一份 1955 年的提案，把学习、语言、推理列成了研究问题。
hook.en: A 1955 proposal set out learning, language, and reasoning as research questions.

body.zh: 1955 年，一份提案为第二年的 Dartmouth 项目列出了要研究的问题：学习、语言、推理。从这时起，一群研究者开始围绕 AI 这个名字组织工作。机器会不会有智能，这个问题早有人想过；新的是这个名字，和聚在它下面的这群人。
body.en: A 1955 proposal laid out questions about learning, language, and reasoning for the 1956 Dartmouth project. From then on, a group of researchers organized their work under the name AI. Machine intelligence was an older question; what was new was the name and the group around it.

limit.zh: 当时好几条路线同时在走，没有哪条注定通向今天的大模型。
limit.en: Several approaches ran side by side, and none was bound to lead to LLMs.

title.zh: Logic Theory Machine · 用经验法则找证明
title.en: Logic Theory Machine · searching for proofs with heuristics

hook.zh: 靠经验法则决定往哪搜，把找证明写成机器能执行的规则。
hook.en: Rules of thumb decide where to search, turning proof-finding into steps a computer can follow.

body.zh: 1956 年，Newell 和 Simon 在一份报告里写下一个系统的规格，用来寻找符号逻辑的证明。往哪个方向搜，由启发式决定，也就是一些经验法则。整个推理过程，被写成了计算机能实现的规则。
body.en: In a 1956 report, Newell and Simon specified a system for finding proofs in symbolic logic. Heuristics, or rules of thumb, decide which direction to search. The whole reasoning process is written as rules that a computer could carry out.

limit.zh: 报告主要写的是系统规格，还没讲它在计算机上怎么实现。
limit.en: The report mainly specifies the system and says little about running it on a computer.

sources: Newell & Simon · RAND P-868 (1956), original report and abstract

title.zh: 反向传播 · 让误差一层层往回传
title.en: Backpropagation · sending errors back through the layers

hook.zh: 把输出的误差往回传，网络每一层都知道该怎么改。
hook.en: Output errors flow backward, telling every layer how to adjust its weights.

body.zh: 网络输出错了，深处哪些权重该改？反向传播把输出端的误差一层层往回传，据此调整每一层的权重。1986 年这篇代表作展示了：这样训练，网络中间层能自己学出内部特征，也就是隐藏表示。反向求导的办法更早就有，这篇论文让人看到它能学出什么。
body.en: When a network's output is wrong, which weights deep inside should change? Backpropagation passes the output error back layer by layer and uses it to adjust every layer's weights. The 1986 work showed that, trained this way, a network's middle layers learn their own internal features, called hidden representations. Reverse-mode differentiation existed earlier; this paper showed what it could teach a network.

limit.zh: 有了梯度，深网络照样难训，训好了也未必能用在新数据上。
limit.en: Gradients alone did not make deep networks easy to train, or make them work on new data.

title.zh: Q-learning · 从奖励里学每个动作值多少
title.en: Q-learning · learning what each action is worth

hook.zh: 用眼前的奖励加上对后面的估计，一点点修正动作的价值。
hook.en: Each action's value is updated from the immediate reward plus a guess about what follows.

body.zh: 做了一个动作、拿到奖励，这个动作到底值多少？Q-learning 用眼前的奖励加上对后续价值的估计，来更新它的估值。1992 年的论文给出了收敛分析，针对的是表格情形：每个状态下的每个动作各记一个数。这个方法更早见于 Watkins 1989 年的博士论文。
body.en: You take an action and get a reward: how much was that action worth? Q-learning updates its estimate from the immediate reward plus an estimate of the value that follows. The 1992 paper analyzed convergence in the tabular case, where every action in every state has its own entry. The method had already appeared in Watkins's 1989 thesis.

limit.zh: 表格情形下的收敛条件，搬到深度网络上就不一定成立了。
limit.en: Convergence conditions for tables do not automatically hold once a neural network replaces the table.

title.zh: LSTM · 让循环网络记得更久
title.en: LSTM · helping networks remember longer

hook.zh: 给循环网络加上记忆和门控，前面的信息不容易丢。
hook.en: A memory state and gates help recurrent networks hold on to earlier information.

body.zh: 循环网络一步步读序列，读到后面，前面的信息很难留住。1997 年提出的 LSTM 加了一块专门的记忆状态，再配上门控，也就是控制信息进出的阀门。这样，相隔很远的信息也更容易学到。
body.en: A recurrent network reads a sequence step by step, and by the end it struggles to keep what came early. LSTM, introduced in 1997, adds a dedicated memory state plus gates, valves that control what flows in and out of that memory. This makes it easier to learn links between distant parts of a sequence.

limit.zh: 门控只是缓解，距离拉得足够长，照样可能忘。
limit.en: Gates ease the problem, but over long enough distances the network can still forget.

title.zh: AlexNet · 让网络自己学看图
title.en: AlexNet · Letting the network learn to see

hook.zh: 不再手工设计图像特征，交给卷积网络自己学。
hook.en: Instead of hand-designed image features, a convolutional network learned its own.

body.zh: 当时，大规模图像识别中常见的做法是先设计特征，再交给分类器；能学习特征的卷积网络也早已存在。AlexNet 把后者做大：八层、六千万参数，在两块 GPU 上训了五六天。团队在 ILSVRC 2012 中提交的集成系统，top-5 错误率是 15.3%，第二名是 26.2%。这次结果让更多人看到，数据、算力和深层网络放在一起能做到什么。
body.en: Hand-designed features were common in large-scale image recognition, though convolutional networks already learned features from data. AlexNet scaled that approach to eight layers and 60 million parameters, trained for five to six days on two GPUs. The team's ensemble entry achieved 15.3% top-5 error at ILSVRC 2012, against 26.2% for the runner-up. The result drew attention to what more data, compute, and deeper networks could achieve together.

detail.zh: 能训起来靠几处改动：激活函数换成 ReLU，训练快了好几倍；用 dropout 和随机裁剪对抗过拟合；一块显卡放不下，就把网络拆到两块卡上。
detail.en: A few changes made training work: ReLU activations trained several times faster; dropout and random crops fought overfitting; and since one GPU could not hold the network, it was split across two.

limit.zh: 它只会从一千个类别里挑一个答案，图里有什么、在哪、彼此什么关系，还管不了。
limit.en: It picks one answer from a thousand categories; what is in the picture, where, and how things relate were out of reach.

title.zh: DQN · 看游戏画面学会决策
title.en: DQN · Learning decisions from game pixels

hook.zh: 神经网络直接看 Atari 游戏画面，估计每个动作值多少。
hook.en: A neural network looks at raw Atari screens and estimates what each action is worth.

body.zh: 强化学习要让智能体在试错中学会选动作。DQN 用神经网络估计每个动作的价值，直接从 Atari 的游戏画面学起。它还把过去的交互存下来，训练时反复拿出来用，这叫经验回放。
body.en: Reinforcement learning has an agent learn which actions to take by trial and error. DQN used a neural network to estimate the value of each action, learning straight from the pixels of Atari games. It also stored past interactions and drew on them again and again during training, a technique called experience replay.

limit.zh: 游戏输了能重来，真机器人试错要付出另一种代价。
limit.en: A game can be reset after every failure; a physical robot pays a different price.

title.zh: Seq2Seq · 一个序列换成另一个序列
title.en: Seq2Seq · Turning one sequence into another

hook.zh: 先把输入编码，再生成输出，长短不一的序列都能学。
hook.en: Encode the input, then generate the output, whatever the two lengths are.

body.zh: 有些任务的输入和输出都是序列，长度还各不相同，机器翻译就是一例。Seq2Seq 分两步走：先把输入编码，再从编码生成输出。这样，长短不一的序列都能用同一套流程来学。
body.en: Some tasks take a sequence in and give a sequence out, and the two lengths differ; machine translation is one example. Seq2Seq works in two steps: encode the input, then generate the output from that encoding. Sequences of different lengths can then be learned in one shared setup.

limit.zh: 整句话被压成一个固定长度的向量；后来的 attention，让解码时能回头看输入的每个词。
limit.en: The whole sentence is squeezed into one fixed-length vector; attention later let the decoder look back at every input word.

title.zh: Transformer · 翻译只靠注意力
title.en: Transformer · Translation with attention alone

hook.zh: 不用循环，通过 attention 连接序列中的位置。
hook.en: It connects positions through attention rather than recurrence.

body.zh: 当时常见的循环翻译模型要沿序列逐步计算，也有卷积模型在尝试并行化。Transformer 不用循环和卷积，改用 attention 交换位置信息，训练时可以并行处理多个位置。论文在英德翻译上比此前最好成绩高出 2 BLEU 以上；英法实验在八块 GPU 上训练了三天半。后来的 BERT 和 GPT 分别发展了 encoder-only 和 decoder-only 路线。
body.en: Recurrent translation models processed sequences step by step; convolutional models also offered a route to parallelism. The Transformer used attention instead of recurrence and convolutions, allowing positions to be processed in parallel during training. The paper improved the previous English–German best by over 2 BLEU; its English–French experiment trained for 3.5 days on eight GPUs. BERT and GPT later developed encoder-only and decoder-only approaches.

detail.zh: 拿 50 个 token 来算：循环网络要串行走 50 步，双向 self-attention 一层就能连接任意两个位置。decoder 的 causal mask 则会挡住后面的 token，不能偷看。标准 dense attention 的分数矩阵是 50×50；固定隐藏维度时，这部分计算随序列长度按平方增长。训练能并行，不代表自回归生成也能一次吐出所有 token。
detail.en: For 50 tokens, a recurrent network takes 50 sequential steps. Bidirectional self-attention can connect any two positions in one layer; a decoder's causal mask blocks future positions. Standard dense attention forms a 50 × 50 score matrix, so this computation grows quadratically with sequence length at a fixed hidden size. Parallel training does not make autoregressive generation emit every token at once.

limit.zh: 生成时还是得一个词一个词往外吐；长文本的平方开销也留给了后人。
limit.en: Generation still emits one word at a time, and the quadratic cost on long inputs was left for later work.

sources: Attention Is All You Need · arXiv v1, 2017-06-12, §§1–2, 4–5, 7 and Figures 3–5
Attention Is All You Need · NIPS 2017 proceedings
BERT · arXiv v1, 2018-10-11, §3 on encoder and left-to-right Transformers
Pérez, Barceló & Marinković · Attention is Turing-Complete, JMLR 22(75), 2021

title.zh: PPO · 压住策略的大幅更新
title.en: PPO · Holding back large policy updates

hook.zh: 用裁剪压住策略大幅更新的动力，实现起来也不难。
hook.en: Clipping damps the incentive for large policy updates, and the method stays practical to implement.

body.zh: 在强化学习里，策略决定模型每一步怎么行动。PPO 用裁剪等设计，压住策略一次大幅更新的动力。它同时照顾两头：实现起来不难，训练效率也顾到了。后来，用人类反馈训练模型时也用上了它。
body.en: In reinforcement learning, a policy decides how an agent acts at each step. PPO uses clipping and related design choices to damp the incentive for large policy updates. It balances two concerns: it is not hard to implement, and training stays efficient. PPO was later used to train models from human feedback.

limit.zh: 裁剪只是收着更新的劲，新旧策略之间的实际差距（KL）还是可能跑大。
limit.en: Clipping only reins in each update; the actual KL gap between old and new policies can still grow.

title.zh: BERT · 一次预训练，适配多种任务
title.en: BERT · Pretrain once, adapt to many tasks

hook.zh: 遮住句子里的词让模型猜，学到的表示再拿去做别的任务。
hook.en: It learns by guessing hidden words, then adapts what it learned to other tasks.

body.zh: BERT 先做掩码语言建模：把句子里的一些词遮住，让模型根据上下文去猜。这样学到的表示，再拿去适配各种下游任务。预训练出来的模型，不再只为原来的一个任务服务。
body.en: BERT first learns representations through masked language modeling: some words in a sentence are hidden, and the model guesses them from the context. Those representations are then adapted to downstream tasks. A pretrained model is no longer tied to the single task it was trained for.

limit.zh: 它同时看左右两边，擅长理解；要一个词一个词往下写，还得靠只看前文的模型。
limit.en: It looks both ways, which suits understanding; writing text word by word still needs a model that only looks back.

sources: Nogueira & Cho · Passage Re-ranking with BERT, arXiv v1, 2019-01-13

title.zh: SAC · 用旧经验学连续控制
title.en: SAC · Reusing past experience for continuous control

hook.zh: 把最大熵和旧数据重用合在一起，学取值连续的动作。
hook.en: It combines a maximum-entropy objective with reuse of past data to learn continuous actions.

body.zh: 机器人和模拟控制都很在乎样本效率，也就是用尽量少的尝试学会。SAC 学的是取值连续的动作，靠两样东西：一是最大熵目标，让策略保留一些随机性；二是离策略的数据重用，以前收集的经验能反复拿来学。
body.en: Robotics and simulated control care about sample efficiency: learning from as few trials as possible. SAC learns continuous actions by pairing two ideas. A maximum-entropy objective keeps the policy somewhat random, and off-policy learning lets it reuse data collected earlier, again and again.

limit.zh: 在模拟器里学会了，放到真实硬件上未必安全可靠。
limit.en: Learning a skill in simulation does not make it safe on physical hardware.

title.zh: ZeRO · 把训练状态分给各张卡
title.en: ZeRO · Splitting training state across GPUs

hook.zh: 不再让每张 GPU 都存一整份训练状态。
hook.en: Each GPU stops keeping its own full copy of the training state.

body.zh: 普通的数据并行里，每张 GPU 都存一整份训练状态。模型一大，显存就浪费得厉害。ZeRO 分几个阶段，把优化器状态、梯度和参数切成片，各张卡分着存，用到时再互相传。
body.en: In plain data parallelism, every GPU keeps a full copy of the training state, which wastes a lot of memory once models get large. ZeRO shards optimizer state, gradients, and parameters in stages. Each GPU stores only its slice, and the GPUs exchange pieces when computation needs them.

detail.zh: 比如四张卡原本各存一份优化器状态，现在可以改成每张只管其中一部分。重复的副本省掉了，可计算用到的数据得及时交换。训练用的内存，也不会全部缩到原来的四分之一。
detail.en: Say four GPUs each hold a full copy of the optimizer state. ZeRO can instead give each GPU only part of it. The duplicate copies go away, but data has to be exchanged when computation needs it. Not every part of training memory shrinks to a quarter.

limit.zh: 省下显存的代价是更多通信，它也只是几种并行方式里的一种。
limit.en: The memory savings cost extra communication, and it is one of several ways to parallelize.

title.zh: GPT-3 · 看几个示例就能做新任务
title.en: GPT-3 · Learning tasks from examples in the prompt

hook.zh: 在提示里放几个示例，模型就照着做，不用重新微调。
hook.en: Show the model a few examples in the prompt, and it does the task without fine-tuning.

body.zh: 当时，按任务微调是常见做法，不更新权重直接做任务的研究也已出现。GPT-3 把预测下一个 token 的预训练做大，并系统比较 zero-shot、one-shot 和 few-shot 设置：只在提示里说明任务、放入示例，看看模型能做到哪一步，不为每项任务另改权重。
body.en: Task-specific fine-tuning was common, and research on using models without weight updates already existed. GPT-3 scaled up next-token pretraining and systematically compared zero-shot, one-shot, and few-shot settings: describe the task, optionally provide examples in the prompt, and test what the model can do without a separate weight update for each task.

limit.zh: 上下文学习不改权重，换个任务，效果可能就不灵了。
limit.en: In-context learning leaves the weights alone, and it may stop working on a different task.

title.zh: ViT · 把图像切块交给 Transformer
title.en: ViT · Feeding image patches to a Transformer

hook.zh: 图像切成小方块排成序列，交给 Transformer 读。
hook.en: It cuts an image into patches and reads them as a sequence with a Transformer.

body.zh: Transformer 原本是处理序列的结构。ViT 把图像切成一个个小方块，叫 patch，排成序列，交给 Transformer 编码。这套结构就这样搬到了视觉上。不过训练规模和归纳偏置，也就是结构里预先带的假设，依然要紧。
body.en: The Transformer was built to process sequences. ViT cuts an image into small patches, lines them up as a sequence, and feeds them to a Transformer encoder. The architecture carries over to vision, but training scale and inductive bias, the assumptions built into a model's structure, still matter.

limit.zh: 结构可以一样，图像和文字的数据特点却不一样。
limit.en: The architecture can be shared, but images and text are still different kinds of data.

title.zh: Diffusion · 从噪声里一步步生成
title.en: Diffusion · Generating by removing noise step by step

hook.zh: 从一团噪声出发，一步步去噪，最后生成样本。
hook.en: Start from noise and remove it step by step until a sample appears.

body.zh: DDPM 学的是一步步去噪：从一团噪声出发，每次去掉一点，最后得到生成的样本。它成了生成建模的一条重要路线。
body.en: DDPM learns to remove noise step by step: start from pure noise, take a little away each time, and end with a generated sample. It became an important route in generative modeling.

limit.zh: 扩散的想法早有人提过，DDPM 把它做成了代表作。
limit.en: The idea of diffusion came earlier; DDPM turned it into the landmark result.

title.zh: CLIP · 把图像和文字接起来
title.en: CLIP · Connecting images and text

hook.zh: 要识别什么，用一句话描述就能定下来。
hook.en: Recognition tasks can be defined in plain language instead of a fixed label list.

body.zh: 一套固定的类别标签，很难覆盖所有想识别的东西。CLIP 用成对的图片和文字训练两个编码器，一个看图，一个读文字，让配对的图和文在表示上靠得更近。这样一来，要识别什么，直接用一句自然语言描述就能定下来。
body.en: A fixed set of labels cannot cover everything people might want to recognize. CLIP trained two encoders on paired images and text, one for pictures and one for words, and pulled matching pairs closer together. As a result, a recognition task can be defined with a plain sentence.

detail.zh: 比如分辨自行车和汽车，就把“自行车的照片”“汽车的照片”两句话分别编码，再和图片的表示比一比。不用为这两个类别另训分类器。代价是描述换个说法，结果可能就变了，模型本身也不会给出解释。
detail.en: To tell a bicycle from a car, encode the phrases “a photo of a bicycle” and “a photo of a car,” then compare each with the image. No new classifier is needed for those two labels. But rewording the phrases can change the answer, and the model itself gives no explanation.

limit.zh: 图和文对齐了，但光靠对齐，还生成不了有依据的回答。
limit.en: Aligned images and text still do not, by themselves, produce grounded answers.

title.zh: InstructGPT · 用人的反馈调整回答
title.en: InstructGPT · Shaping answers with human feedback

hook.zh: 用人写的示范和人标的偏好，调整语言模型怎么回答。
hook.en: Human demonstrations and preference labels were used to shape how a language model answers.

body.zh: InstructGPT 把四样东西串成一条流程：人写的示范、人标的偏好、一个奖励模型，再加上 PPO 这种强化学习方法，用来调整语言模型怎么回答。这套做法叫 RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习），InstructGPT 把它完整、公开地做了一遍。
body.en: InstructGPT chained four pieces into one pipeline: human demonstrations, preference labels, a reward model, and PPO, a reinforcement learning method, to shape how a language model responds. The approach is called RLHF, reinforcement learning from human feedback, and InstructGPT ran it end to end, in public.

limit.zh: 标注员的偏好，代表不了所有人的需要。
limit.en: The preferences of a group of annotators do not stand for everyone's needs.

title.zh: FlashAttention · 减少显存来回读写
title.en: FlashAttention · Cutting memory traffic in attention

hook.zh: 分块计算 attention，少在显存里搬中间结果。
hook.en: It splits attention into tiles to cut the back-and-forth with GPU memory.

body.zh: 普通的 attention 实现会把很大的分数矩阵写进显存，再读回来接着算。FlashAttention 把计算分块，减少中间结果在显存和片上 SRAM 之间的来回读写。它算的仍是精确的 attention，前向和反向都支持，训练也能用。
body.en: A standard attention implementation writes a large score matrix to GPU memory and reads it back for the next steps. FlashAttention splits the work into tiles to cut the traffic of intermediate results between GPU memory and on-chip SRAM. It still computes exact attention and supports both the forward and backward passes, so training can use it too.

detail.zh: FlashAttention 一块一块地算，同时记下归一化要用的统计量，所以整张中间矩阵不用存下来。省下的是数据搬运和中间存储，没有靠丢掉 token 来省事。
detail.en: FlashAttention works tile by tile and keeps the statistics needed for normalization, so the full intermediate matrix never has to be stored. It saves data movement and storage; it does not drop tokens to save work.

limit.zh: 实际能快多少，还要看张量形状、硬件和实现版本。
limit.en: How much faster it runs still depends on tensor shapes, hardware, and implementation.

title.zh: DPO · 直接从偏好对里学
title.en: DPO · Learning directly from preference pairs

hook.zh: 不另训奖励模型，直接用“哪个回答更好”的数据调模型。
hook.en: It trains directly on which of two answers is better, skipping a separate reward model.

body.zh: 先收集偏好对：同一个问题的两份回答，标出哪份更好。DPO 直接用这些数据更新语言模型。它的损失函数，是从带 KL 约束的奖励优化目标推出来的。常规的离线流程里，既不用另训一个奖励模型，也不用边训练边采样。
body.en: First collect preference pairs: two responses to the same prompt, with the better one marked. DPO updates the language model directly on these pairs. Its loss is derived from a KL-regularized reward objective. In the usual offline workflow, it needs neither a separately trained reward model nor sampling during training.

detail.zh: 比如两份摘要，A 保留了关键事实，B 漏了一个重要条件，标签说 A 更好。训练时比较的是两份回答相对参考模型的概率比，并没有把 A 当成唯一正确的答案。偏好本身靠不靠得住，还得另外检查。
detail.en: Say summary A keeps the key facts, summary B drops an important condition, and the label prefers A. Training compares each response's probability ratio against a reference model; it does not treat A as the one correct answer. Whether the preference itself is reliable still has to be checked separately.

limit.zh: 离线 DPO 不算在线强化学习，偏好数据里的偏差也不会自己消失。
limit.en: Offline DPO is not online reinforcement learning, and bias in the preference data does not go away on its own.

title.zh: vLLM · 按需分配 KV cache
title.en: vLLM · Allocating the KV cache on demand

hook.zh: 把 KV cache 切成小块，用多少分多少，少浪费显存。
hook.en: It splits the KV cache into blocks and allocates them as needed, wasting less memory.

body.zh: KV cache 存的是注意力的键和值。有的请求几十个 token 就结束，有的要写很长；给每个请求预留一大块连续空间，显存很容易浪费。PagedAttention 借用分页管理内存的思路，把 KV cache 切成块，用多少分多少，服务调度也更有效率。
body.en: The KV cache holds attention keys and values. One request may end after a few dozen tokens while another keeps growing, so reserving a large contiguous buffer for each one wastes memory. PagedAttention borrows the idea of paged memory: it cuts the KV cache into blocks and allocates them as needed, which makes serving more efficient.

detail.zh: 名字里有 cache，但它和 CPU 的硬件缓存不是一回事。它存的是注意力的键和值张量，放在显存里，按块通过映射表来找。
detail.en: Despite the name, this cache has nothing to do with a CPU's hardware cache. It holds attention key and value tensors in memory, found block by block through a mapping table.

limit.zh: 省下的是显存，单个请求的延迟未必跟着降。
limit.en: It saves memory; the latency of any single request may not drop with it.

title.zh: RT-2 · 把视觉语言能力用到控制上
title.en: RT-2 · Turning vision-language skills toward robot control

hook.zh: 它把视觉语言预训练和机器人动作数据结合在一起。
hook.en: It combines vision-language pretraining with robot-action data.

body.zh: 机器人不光要看懂画面和指令，还得做出动作。RT-2 把视觉语言预训练和机器人的动作数据结合起来，想把模型已有的看图读字能力，用到控制任务上。
body.en: A robot has to act, not only understand images and instructions. RT-2 combines vision-language pretraining with robot-action data, trying to carry the vision and language abilities a model already has over to control tasks.

limit.zh: 它把视觉-语言模型直接接到动作上，没用强化学习；机器人怎么训，还没有统一的配方。
limit.en: It connects a vision-language model straight to actions, without reinforcement learning; there is still no single recipe for training robots.

title.zh: GRPO · 让同题的回答互相比
title.en: GRPO · Comparing answers within a group

hook.zh: 同一道题答几遍，拿它们互相比，省掉价值模型。
hook.en: Answer the same prompt several times and compare the answers, with no value model needed.

body.zh: 同一道题让模型生成几份回答，用它们的奖励高低互相比，估计每份回答比组内平均好多少，也就是优势。这样就不用另训一个价值模型。GRPO 由 DeepSeekMath 提出，后来 R1 用上了它，TRL 和 verl 也提供了实现。
body.en: Have the model write several answers to the same prompt, then compare their rewards to estimate how much better or worse each one is than the group average: its advantage. No separate value model needs training. GRPO came from DeepSeekMath; R1 later used it, and TRL and verl provide implementations.

detail.zh: 举个只看结果的简单例子：同一题的四个回答得分 1、1、0、0，平均 0.5，高于和低于平均的就分开了。要是四个全得 0，组内比较就分不出好坏。多采样要花成本，也不一定换来有用的反馈。
detail.en: Take four answers with outcome rewards of 1, 1, 0, and 0. The mean is 0.5, so above-average answers separate from below-average ones. If all four score zero, the group comparison has nothing to distinguish. Sampling more has a cost and does not always yield useful feedback.

limit.zh: 不用价值模型了，奖励还得设计，多采样的成本也省不掉。
limit.en: Dropping the value model still leaves reward design and the cost of sampling.

title.zh: 后训练配方 · 调出能力还没有定法
title.en: Post-training recipes · Still being worked out

hook.zh: SFT、DPO、PPO、GRPO 各有取舍，配方还在摸索。
hook.en: Post-training methods differ, and each recipe trades off tasks, budget, and stability.

body.zh: 模型里藏着的能力，很难一次就稳稳调出来。SFT、DPO、PPO、GRPO 用的数据和反馈各不相同。已有的报告给出了能用的配方，也摆明了取舍：覆盖哪些任务，花多少预算，训练稳不稳。
body.en: A capability hidden in a model is hard to bring out reliably in one pass. SFT, DPO, PPO, and GRPO each use different data and feedback. Published reports describe working recipes and spell out the trade-offs: which tasks they cover, what they cost, and how stable training is.

detail.zh: 比较方案时，先固定任务和评估，再问几个问题：高质量示范够不够？奖励能不能核验？每次 rollout 要花多久？这些选择，常常比算法叫什么更贴近实际工作。
detail.en: To compare approaches, fix the task and evaluation first. Then ask: are good demonstrations available, can rewards be checked, and how long does each rollout take? These choices often say more about the real work than the algorithm's name.

limit.zh: 同样的预算，该多收数据、多采样，还是多更新几步，仍没有统一答案。
limit.en: With a fixed budget, whether to buy more data, more samples, or more updates is still an open question.

title.zh: ResNet · 让很深的网络也训得动
title.en: ResNet · Making very deep networks trainable

hook.zh: 每组层只学“改多少”，再把原来的输入加回去。
hook.en: Each block learns only a change and adds the original input back.

body.zh: 网络越深，表达能力越强，可层数一多，连训练误差都可能变大。ResNet 加了残差连接：一组层学一个 F(x)，输出时再把原来的输入 x 加回去。如果某几层用不着改什么，只要把 F(x) 学到接近零，输入就差不多原样传下去。优化也就更容易了。
body.en: A deeper network can express more, yet adding layers can make even its training error worse. ResNet added residual connections: a block of layers learns F(x), then adds the original input x back. If some layers have nothing useful to change, they only need to push F(x) toward zero, and the input passes through almost unchanged. That makes optimization easier.

limit.zh: 能训得动之后，再往深加，也未必更好。
limit.en: Once networks were trainable, adding depth still did not always help.

title.zh: 图卷积网络 GCN · 从邻居那里学
title.en: Graph convolutional networks · Learning from neighbors

hook.zh: 把节点特征和连接关系放在一起，标签很少也能分类。
hook.en: It combines node features with graph links to classify nodes from only a few labels.

body.zh: 要给图里的节点分类，有时只有很少几个节点带标签。GCN 把节点自己的特征和图的连接关系放在一起，让每个节点从邻居那里学信息。它给图卷积找了一条简洁的传播规则，可以直接写成代码。
body.en: Sometimes only a few nodes in a graph carry labels, and the task is to classify the rest. GCN combines each node's own features with the graph's links, so nodes learn from their neighbors. It gave graph convolution a compact propagation rule that can be implemented directly.

limit.zh: 图神经网络的研究早就有了，GCN 只是其中一项代表工作。
limit.en: Research on graph neural networks came earlier; GCN is one representative paper.

title.zh: GraphSAGE · 给没见过的节点算表示
title.en: GraphSAGE · Representing nodes it has never seen

hook.zh: 不再给每个节点存一份向量，改学一个从邻居算表示的函数。
hook.en: It computes each node's vector from its neighbors instead of storing one per node.

body.zh: 如果给图上每个节点单独存一份 embedding，也就是一串代表它的数字，没见过的新节点就没有现成的表示。GraphSAGE 改学一个函数：采样一些邻居，把它们的特征聚合起来。新节点来了，用同一个函数也能算出表示。
body.en: If every node in a graph gets its own stored embedding, a list of numbers that stands for it, a node the model has never seen has nothing to use. GraphSAGE learns a function instead: sample some of a node's neighbors and aggregate their features. When a new node arrives, the same function computes its representation.

limit.zh: 能不能泛化，还要看节点特征、邻居信息和数据分布，新图不一定都能直接套用。
limit.en: Whether it generalizes still depends on node features, neighborhoods, and the data distribution; not every new graph will work.

title.zh: GAT · 给每个邻居不同的分量
title.en: GAT · Weighting each neighbor differently

hook.zh: 用 attention 决定每个邻居占多大分量，再汇总信息。
hook.en: Attention decides how much each neighbor counts before their information is combined.

body.zh: 图上一个节点要从邻居那里汇总信息，可邻居不必同样重要。GAT 先用 attention 学出每个邻居该占多大分量，再按这个权重把信息合到一起。当时做图表示学习的还有 GCN 和 GraphSAGE，GAT 是并列的另一种做法。
body.en: A node in a graph gathers information from its neighbors, but the neighbors need not matter equally. GAT uses attention to learn how much weight each neighbor gets, then combines their information by those weights. GCN and GraphSAGE were other approaches to graph representation learning at the time; GAT is one more design choice alongside them.

limit.zh: 它和 GraphSAGE 几乎同时出现，是两条并行的路。
limit.en: It appeared almost alongside GraphSAGE; the two are parallel paths.

title.zh: AlphaGo · 用神经网络给搜索减负
title.en: AlphaGo · Neural networks that narrow the search

hook.zh: 一个网络挑值得考虑的几步，另一个直接估胜率。
hook.en: One network picks moves worth considering; another estimates who is winning.

body.zh: 围棋每步约有 250 种走法，一盘约 150 步，没法穷举。之前最强的程序靠大量随机模拟估胜率，停在业余强手的水平。AlphaGo 加了两个神经网络：策略网络挑出值得考虑的几步，价值网络直接估计局面胜率。2016 年 3 月，它在首尔以 4:1 赢了李世石。
body.en: Go offers about 250 moves per turn over games of about 150 moves, far too many to search exhaustively. The strongest earlier programs estimated win rates from many random playouts and played at a strong amateur level. AlphaGo added two neural networks: a policy network proposes moves worth considering, and a value network estimates who is winning. In March 2016 it beat Lee Sedol 4–1 in Seoul.

detail.zh:
训练分三步。先用 3000 万个局面训练策略网络，模仿人类高手；再让它和自己的旧版本对弈，用强化学习继续改进；最后用自我对弈的局面训练价值网络。价值网络算一次，准确度接近用策略网络一路模拟到终局，计算量却少 15,000 倍。

后来的 AlphaGo Zero 去掉了人类棋谱，只靠规则和自我对弈学习。训练三天后，它以 100:0 赢了战胜李世石的那个版本。
detail.en:
Training had three stages. A policy network learned to imitate human experts from 30 million positions. Reinforcement learning then improved it through games against its earlier versions. Finally, a value network was trained on self-play positions. One value-network evaluation came close to the accuracy of playouts with the policy network while using 15,000 times less computation.

AlphaGo Zero later dropped the human games and learned from the rules and self-play alone. After three days of training it beat the version that had defeated Lee Sedol 100–0.

limit.zh: 围棋规则全知、局面全可见、能无限模拟，现实里的大多数决策没有这样的模拟器。
limit.en: Go has known rules, a fully visible board, and unlimited simulation; most real decisions come with no such simulator.

sources: Silver et al. · Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search, Nature, 2016
Same paper · DeepMind-hosted PDF, introduction, value-network section and Methods
DeepMind · AlphaGo overview, Lee Sedol match in Seoul, March 2016
DeepMind · AlphaGo Zero: Starting from scratch, 2017-10-18

title.zh: AlphaFold 2 · 用 AI 预测蛋白质结构
title.en: AlphaFold 2 · AI predicts protein structures

hook.zh: 在 CASP14 上，它让蛋白质结构预测往前跨了一大步。
hook.en: At CASP14 in 2020, it marked a major advance in protein structure prediction.

body.zh: 蛋白质折成什么形状，决定了它能做什么。2020 年的结构预测评测 CASP14 上，AlphaFold 2 交出的结果，被看作这一领域的重大进展。
body.en: A protein's shape decides what it can do. At the CASP14 structure-prediction assessment in 2020, AlphaFold 2's results were seen as a major advance for the field.

limit.zh: 预测出结构，还解释不了蛋白质的全部功能和动态，实验也省不掉。
limit.en: A predicted structure does not explain all of a protein's function or motion, and experiments are still needed.

title.zh: ChatGPT · 大模型走进对话框
title.en: ChatGPT · Language models move into a chat window

hook.zh: 打开网页就能聊天、追问，让更多人接触到语言模型。
hook.en: Ordinary people could now chat with a language model directly, ask follow-ups, and change requests.

body.zh: 2022 年 11 月，OpenAI 以研究预览的形式放出 ChatGPT。不用写代码，打开网页就能提问，还能接着追问、让它改。语言模型从论文和 API 里走出来，成了很多人每天在用的东西。
body.en: In November 2022, OpenAI released ChatGPT as a research preview. No code was needed: open a web page, ask a question, then follow up or ask it to change the answer. Language models moved out of papers and APIs and became something many people use every day.

limit.zh: 它会一本正经地答错，发布公告里就写了这一条。
limit.en: It can give wrong answers with a straight face, and the launch announcement said so.

title.zh: Stable Diffusion · 把图像生成交到用户手里
title.en: Stable Diffusion · Putting image generation in people's hands

hook.zh: 权重和代码都公开了，谁都能亲手试、亲手改。
hook.en: With public weights and code, people could try image generation and adapt it themselves.

body.zh: 2022 年，Stable Diffusion 公开模型权重和代码，并提供演示和工具入口，让更多人能自己运行、改造文本生成图像的模型。它不是第一个可下载的图像生成模型，但这次发布推动了围绕模型的工具和应用开发。
body.en: In 2022, Stable Diffusion released model weights, code, and demos, making text-to-image generation easier to run and adapt. It was not the first downloadable image-generation model, but its release encouraged a broad set of tools and applications.

limit.zh: 权重公开了，许可证、内容安全和训练数据来源的问题都还在。
limit.en: Open weights left licensing, content safety, and training-data concerns in place.

title.zh: DeepSeek-R1 · 用强化学习练推理
title.en: DeepSeek-R1 · Training reasoning with RL

hook.zh: 一份报告对照两种做法：直接上 RL，和先备数据再分阶段训。
hook.en: The report compares RL applied straight to a base model with a multi-stage recipe.

body.zh: DeepSeek-R1 的报告对比了两种设置。R1-Zero 直接在基座模型上做强化学习；R1 先加入冷启动数据，再分几个阶段训练。两者放在一起看，能看出强化学习怎样和数据、SFT（监督微调）、评估配合。
body.en: The DeepSeek-R1 report compares two setups. R1-Zero applies reinforcement learning directly to a base model; R1 adds cold-start data and trains in several stages. Read side by side, they show how RL fits together with data, supervised fine-tuning, and evaluation.

limit.zh: 报告里的奖励和结果来自特定任务，换到别的模型上还得重新验证。
limit.en: Its rewards and results come from specific tasks; other models need their own checks.

title.zh: 珍珠街电站 · 一座电站供一片街区
title.en: Pearl Street · one station powers a neighborhood

hook.zh: 一座中心电站，用地下线路给好几栋楼送电。
hook.en: One central station fed several buildings through underground cables on a shared supply.

body.zh: 1882 年，纽约珍珠街电站开始给曼哈顿下城的一个街区供电。电从一座中心电站出发，经地下线路送进好几栋楼。这些楼用的是同一套直流电。
body.en: In 1882, Pearl Street Station in New York began supplying electricity to a district in Lower Manhattan. Power left one central station and ran through underground cables into several buildings. All of those buildings drew on the same direct-current supply.

limit.zh: 它只供一个街区的直流电，离今天跨区域的交流电网还很远。
limit.en: It served one district with direct current, far from today's interconnected AC grid.

sources: Con Edison corporate history (2023), September 4, 1882 entry
Thomas A. Edison Papers: Pearl Street archival headnote

title.zh: ARPANET · 远程登录另一台主机
title.en: ARPANET · logging in to a distant computer

hook.zh: 第一次远程登录，只传出“lo”两个字母就崩了。
hook.en: The first remote login over ARPANET got only “lo” through before the system crashed.

body.zh: 1969 年 10 月，UCLA 的团队试着通过 ARPANET 登录斯坦福研究所的主机。第一次只传出“lo”就崩溃了，完整的登录后来才成功。远程登录让相隔很远的计算机能真正交互，跨机构共用计算资源也就有了试验的条件。
body.en: In October 1969, a UCLA team tried to log in to a Stanford Research Institute host over ARPANET. The first attempt got only “lo” through before it crashed; a full login came later. Remote login let distant computers actually interact, and gave researchers a way to try sharing computing resources across institutions.

limit.zh: 第一次尝试只传出 “lo” 就崩了；那时它还只是研究网络，离大众用的互联网还很远。
limit.en: The first attempt crashed after sending "lo"; it was a research network, far from the public Internet.

sources: Leonard Kleinrock: UCLA IMP log and participant account of October 29, 1969
McQuillan, Richer & Rosen · The New Routing Algorithm for the ARPANET, IEEE Trans. Communications, 1980

title.zh: Unix · 一套能开发自己的系统
title.en: Unix · a system used to develop itself

hook.zh: 为了留住交互式编程，贝尔实验室做了一套新系统。
hook.en: To keep interactive programming, a Bell Labs team built what became Unix on a PDP-7.

body.zh: 1969 年，贝尔实验室的一个团队想保住交互式的编程环境，就在 PDP-7 上做了一套系统，后来叫 Unix。文件系统、进程和命令解释器一点点长成一个能开发自身的环境。写程序和日常用工具，都在这同一套环境里。
body.en: In 1969, a Bell Labs team that wanted to keep an interactive programming environment built a system on the PDP-7, later named Unix. Its filesystem, processes, and shell grew into an environment that could be used to develop itself. Writing programs and running everyday tools happened in the same place.

limit.zh: 1969 年它才刚动工，连名字都还没有。
limit.en: In 1969 work had only just begun; the system did not even have a name yet.

sources: Dennis Ritchie: Unix evolution, participant history presented 1979, published 1980, reprinted 1984

title.zh: Ethernet · 一根电缆大家共用
title.en: Ethernet · computers sharing one cable

hook.zh: 附近的计算机共用一根同轴电缆，撞车了就重发。
hook.en: Nearby computers shared one coaxial cable and simply resent packets after a collision.

body.zh: 1976 年，Metcalfe 和 Boggs 发表论文，讲附近的计算机怎样共用一根同轴电缆收发数据包。什么时候发，由各台机器自己决定；两台撞上了，就各自重发。这样，局域网不需要一个中央控制器来安排每次发送。
body.en: In 1976, Metcalfe and Boggs published a paper on how nearby computers could share a coaxial cable to exchange packets. Each machine decided for itself when to send, and after a collision the packets were sent again. A local network therefore needed no central controller to hand out every chance to transmit.

limit.zh: 论文写的还是一个实验性的共享电缆网络。
limit.en: The paper describes an experimental shared-cable network.

sources: Metcalfe and Boggs: original CACM paper, July 1976 (Cambridge scan)
Computer History Museum: May 22, 1973 Ethernet memo archival account

title.zh: TCP/IP · 让不同网络说同一种话
title.en: TCP/IP · letting different networks speak one protocol

hook.zh: ARPANET 定下一天，从 NCP 切换到 TCP/IP。
hook.en: ARPANET set a single date to switch from its old NCP protocol to TCP/IP.

body.zh: 为了把用不同通信技术的网络连起来，ARPANET 把 1983 年 1 月 1 日定为从 NCP 切换到 TCP/IP 的目标日期。有了共同的协议，远程登录、文件传输和邮件都能跨过原来的网络边界。1983 年的主机调查，记下了这些服务实际跑起来的情况。
body.en: To connect networks built on different communication technologies, ARPANET set January 1, 1983 as the target date for switching from NCP to TCP/IP. With shared protocols, remote login, file transfer, and mail could cross the old network boundaries. Host surveys in 1983 recorded which of these services were actually running.

limit.zh: 切换日到了，还有主机没准备好；2 月的调查里，仍有服务没有响应。
limit.en: When the switch date came, some hosts were still not ready; February surveys found services that did not respond.

sources: Jon Postel: RFC 801 transition plan, November 1981
David Smallberg: RFC 842 operational survey, February 1983

title.zh: GNU · 让软件可以自由分享
title.en: GNU · making software free to share

hook.zh: Stallman 宣布：要做一套人人能自由分享的系统。
hook.en: Stallman announced a plan for a Unix-compatible system that anyone could freely share.

body.zh: 1983 年 9 月，Richard Stallman 宣布 GNU 计划，要做一套可以自由分享、和 Unix 兼容的系统。内核、编译器、编辑器和命令行工具都在计划里。目的是让大家协作时，不必再依赖禁止分享的软件。
body.en: In September 1983, Richard Stallman announced GNU, a plan for a Unix-compatible system that could be freely shared. The plan covered a kernel, a compiler, an editor, and shell tools. The aim was to let people work together without depending on software that forbade sharing.

limit.zh: 发公告时只有计划，没有现成的系统或编译器，真正动手要到 1984 年 1 月。
limit.en: The announcement came with no working system or compiler; actual work began in January 1984.

sources: GNU: original September 27, 1983 announcement with project historical notes

title.zh: Web · 用链接把分散的资料连起来
title.en: The Web · linking scattered information

hook.zh: 想用链接把 CERN 散落的文档、人和项目连在一起。
hook.en: A proposal to link CERN's scattered documents, people, and projects with hypertext.

body.zh: CERN 人来人往，资料又散在各处，信息常常就这么丢了。1989 年 3 月，Tim Berners-Lee 提出一个分布式超文本系统，也就是能顺着链接跳转的文档网络。文档和相关的人、项目、系统互相链接，跨团队找资料时，不用再挤进同一套目录层级。
body.en: CERN was losing information as staff came and went and records stayed scattered. In March 1989, Tim Berners-Lee proposed a distributed hypertext system to fix that. Documents would link to related people, projects, and systems, so people could find knowledge across teams without forcing everything into one directory hierarchy.

limit.zh: 这还只是一份提案：没有网站上线，连万维网这个名字都还没有。
limit.en: It was still only a proposal: no website was running, and the name World Wide Web did not exist yet.

sources: Tim Berners-Lee: original 1989 proposal, W3C transcription and author provenance note

title.zh: Linux · 补上自由系统缺的内核
title.en: Linux · the missing kernel anyone could change

hook.zh: GNU 只差一个内核，Linux 公开源码，补上了这块。
hook.en: GNU lacked only a kernel; Linux published its source and filled the gap.

body.zh: 1990 年代初，GNU 计划已写好大部分系统软件，唯独缺内核。1991 年，Linus Torvalds 公开了 Linux 源码，一个给 386 电脑用的免费内核，谁都能改。后来它改用 GNU 的许可，和 GNU 工具拼在一起，成了完整的自由操作系统。
body.en: By the early 1990s, the GNU project had written most of the software a free system needs, but still lacked a kernel. In 1991 Linus Torvalds released the source of Linux, a free kernel for 386 machines that anyone could read and change. It later moved to GNU's license, and combined with the GNU tools it made a complete free operating system.

detail.zh:
要分清三样东西：内核管进程、内存和设备；shell、编译器和 C 库跑在它上面；把这些配好、能直接安装的叫发行版。1991 年那版只有内核，发布说明自己写着，shell、编译器和库都得另找。

后来改许可时，还得等一起写代码的人同意，可见那时已经有别人参与。后面的故事里也常见到它：2004 年的 MapReduce 论文写道，Google 集群里的机器通常跑 Linux。
detail.en:
Three things are worth separating. The kernel handles processes, memory, and devices. Shells, compilers, and the C library run on top of it. A distribution packages them so they can be installed and used. The 1991 release was only a kernel; its release notes say the shell, compilers, and library had to be found elsewhere.

When the license changed, it waited on approval from the people who had helped write code, so others were already contributing. Linux also turns up in later stories: the 2004 MapReduce paper describes Google's cluster machines as typically running Linux.

limit.zh: 1991 年那版只有内核，要变得能用，得靠 GNU 的工具和许多贡献者。
limit.en: The 1991 release was only a kernel; making it usable took the GNU tools and many contributors.

sources: Linus Torvalds: original Linux 0.01 release notes, 1991, kernel.org archive
Linus Torvalds: Linux 0.12 release notes, license change, kernel.org archive
GNU Project · Linux and the GNU System (the GNU project's account)
Dean and Ghemawat · MapReduce, OSDI 2004, §3 execution environment
NVIDIA GeForce 8800 technical brief, 2006-11-08, p. 14 on the CUDA SDK

title.zh: MPI · 让并行程序说同一种话
title.en: MPI · one message-passing interface for parallel programs

hook.zh: 并行程序有了共同的消息接口，不必再绑死在一家机器上。
hook.en: Parallel programs got a common message-passing interface, less tied to any one machine.

body.zh: 并行程序靠消息在处理器之间传数据，以前常得绑在某一家机器的通信接口上。1994 年，MPI Forum 定下了一套共同的消息传递接口。它规定了点对点通信、一组进程一起参与的集体操作，以及 C 和 Fortran 怎么调用。
body.en: Parallel programs pass messages to move data between processors, and they were often tied to one vendor's communication interface. In 1994 the MPI Forum completed a common message-passing interface. It defined point-to-point communication, collective operations in which a whole group of processes takes part, and bindings for C and Fortran.

limit.zh: MPI 只规定接口，实现各家自己做；早期标准也不管任务管理和 I/O。
limit.en: MPI specifies interfaces, not a single implementation, and the early standard left out task management and I/O.

sources: MPI Forum: MPI 1.1 (1995), foreword identifying MPI 1.0 (1994)
MPI Forum: early standard scope, included interfaces
MPI Forum: early standard scope, excluded facilities

title.zh: MapReduce · 把分布式琐事交给系统
title.en: MapReduce · leaving cluster chores to the runtime

hook.zh: 程序员只写映射和归约，分片、调度、重跑都交给系统。
hook.en: Programmers write map and reduce; the system handles partitioning, scheduling, and reruns.

body.zh: 在集群上处理大规模数据，数据划分、调度、通信和失败重跑这些协调代码，以前常要重复写。2004 年，Dean 和 Ghemawat 发表 MapReduce，把处理过程写成映射和归约两类操作。协调的活交给运行系统，应用作者只管写这两类操作。
body.en: Processing large-scale data on a cluster meant writing repetitive coordination code: partitioning, scheduling, communication, and rerunning failed tasks. In 2004, Dean and Ghemawat published MapReduce, which expresses the processing as map and reduce operations. The runtime takes care of the coordination, so application authors write less of it.

detail.zh: 用词频统计最好懂：map 为每个词发出一次计数，系统把相同词的记录汇到一起，reduce 再相加。代价是计算得能写成这种批处理流程。
detail.en: Word counting makes it clear. Map emits a count for each word, the runtime groups the records by word, and reduce adds them up. The price is that the computation must fit this batch-processing pattern.

limit.zh: 它是批处理模型，装不下任意的交互式计算。
limit.en: It is a batch model and cannot cover arbitrary interactive computation.

sources: Dean and Ghemawat: original OSDI 2004 paper, especially sections 1, 3 and 6

title.zh: 仓库级计算 · 把整座机房当成一台计算机
title.en: Warehouse-scale computing · the datacenter as one computer

hook.zh: 服务器、网络、供电和冷却，要当成一台机器来设计。
hook.en: Servers, networking, power, and cooling should be designed as parts of one machine.

body.zh: 机房不只是把一堆服务器放在一起。2009 年，Barroso 和 Hölzle 在一本专著里，把整个数据中心看成一台计算机。服务器、网络、供电和冷却，都得放在一起设计。
body.en: A datacenter is more than a collection of servers sitting in one room. In their 2009 monograph, Barroso and Hölzle treated the whole datacenter as a single computer. In that view, servers, networking, power, and cooling all belong in the same design.

limit.zh: 书里那种一体化的服务模式，套不到所有托管机房上。
limit.en: The integrated-service model in the book does not describe every colocation facility.

sources: Barroso and Hölzle: original 2009 monograph, chapters 1, 4–6 (PDF mirror)

title.zh: Kubernetes 1.0 · 把容器交给集群来管
title.en: Kubernetes 1.0 · Managing containers at the cluster level

hook.zh: 调度、扩缩容和健康检查，都收到集群这一层来管。
hook.en: Scheduling, scaling, and health checks moved up to the cluster level.

body.zh: 容器应用跑在很多台主机上，运维工作散在各处，得一台台地管。2015 年 7 月，Kubernetes 发布 1.0 版，给跨主机的容器应用提供了一套共同的管理系统。调度、扩缩容、服务发现和健康检查，都集中到了集群这一层。
body.en: Container applications running across many hosts left operations work scattered, managed machine by machine. In July 2015 Kubernetes released version 1.0, a common system for managing container applications across hosts. Scheduling, scaling, service discovery, and health checks all moved up to the cluster level.

limit.zh: 编排只是容器工具链的一环，底下的计算资源是另一回事。
limit.en: Orchestration is only one part of the container toolchain, separate from the compute resources underneath.

sources: Google: original Kubernetes v1 announcement, July 21, 2015
Joe Beda: dated project history distinguishing June 6 commit and June 10, 2014 announcement

title.zh: 单晶体管 DRAM · 晶体管加电容存一位
title.en: Single-transistor DRAM · one transistor, one capacitor, one bit

hook.zh: 电容里的电荷代表一位，一个晶体管负责充放电。
hook.en: A capacitor's charge holds one bit, and a single transistor controls it.

body.zh: 1967 年，Dennard 提交了一项专利，描述一种存储单元：一个晶体管控制一个电容的充放电，电容里的电荷就代表一位信息。每个单元用的器件少了，同一颗芯片上就能排下更密的存储阵列。
body.en: In 1967, Dennard filed a patent for a memory cell in which one transistor controls the charging of a capacitor, and the capacitor's charge represents one bit. With fewer components per cell, a chip can hold a denser memory array.

limit.zh: 电荷会慢慢漏掉，所以每个单元都得定期刷新。
limit.en: The charge leaks away, so every cell must be refreshed periodically.

sources: Dennard, US3387286A: filing, abstract and claims

title.zh: Model 85 缓存 · 硬件自己管快慢存储
title.en: Model 85 cache · hardware manages the fast layer

hook.zh: 一块小而快的缓存放着正在用的数据，程序不用操心。
hook.en: A small, fast cache holds data in use, with no work from programs.

body.zh: 处理器常要等慢速的主存。IBM System/360 Model 85 加了一块小而快的缓存，存放主存里正在用的内容。数据什么时候装入、什么时候替换，都由硬件自动完成，程序不用管这一层。
body.en: A processor that fetches from slow main memory spends time waiting. The IBM System/360 Model 85 added a small, fast cache holding the main-memory contents in active use. Hardware decides on its own when to load and replace data, so programs do not have to manage this layer.

limit.zh: 缓存没命中时，还是得回主存去取。
limit.en: On a miss, the processor still has to go to main memory.

sources: Liptay, IBM Systems Journal 7(1), 1968, pp. 15–21; original paper scan

title.zh: Intel 4004 · 把 CPU 做进一颗芯片
title.en: Intel 4004 · putting a CPU on one chip

hook.zh: 运算、寄存器和执行程序都在一颗芯片上，换个程序就换个用途。
hook.en: Arithmetic, registers, and program execution on one chip; new programs gave it new jobs.

body.zh: 1971 年，Intel 4004 把四位运算器、寄存器和执行程序的功能做进了一颗 CPU 芯片。程序放在外面的存储器里。同一颗处理器，换一套程序，就能用在不同的控制设备上。
body.en: In 1971, Intel's 4004 put four-bit arithmetic, registers, and program execution onto a single CPU chip. The program itself sat in external memory outside the processor. Load a different program, and the same processor could run a different control device.

limit.zh: 程序还得放在外部 ROM 里，它还算不上一台完整的单芯片计算机。
limit.en: Programs still lived in external ROM, so it was not yet a complete computer on a chip.

sources: Intel MCS-4 announcement, 1971-11-15; original advertisement archive
Moore · No Exponential Is Forever, ISSCC plenary, 2003-02-10 (ETHW archive)

title.zh: CUDA · 让 GPU 不必假装画图
title.en: CUDA · GPU computing without pretending to draw

hook.zh: 用扩展过的 C 写 GPU 程序，不必把计算伪装成画图。
hook.en: Programmers could write GPU code in extended C instead of disguising computation as drawing.

body.zh: GPU 本来是画图用的。2000 年代初，有人拿它做线性代数和物理模拟，但得把数据打包成纹理、计算写成着色程序，再靠“画”图形来触发。2006 年 11 月，NVIDIA 公布 CUDA：用扩展的 C 写 GPU 程序，大量线程分组运行，显存也能任意读写。
body.en: GPUs were built to draw pictures. By the early 2000s, people were already using them for linear algebra and physics simulation, but only by packing data into textures, writing computation as shader programs, and launching work by “drawing” geometry. In November 2006, NVIDIA announced CUDA: GPU programs written in an extended C, with many threads running in groups and GPU memory readable and writable anywhere.

detail.zh:
拿向量相加 c = a + b 来比。走图形接口，要把 a、b 装进两张纹理，写着色程序，设好渲染目标，画一个铺满它的矩形，再从“画面”里读回结果。用 CUDA，每个线程按自己的编号 i 算一次 c[i] = a[i] + b[i] 就行。

后来的深度学习也走上这条路。2012 年 AlexNet 的作者自己写了 GPU 卷积代码；2014 年 NVIDIA 发表 cuDNN，接入 Caffe 后，一个标准模型快了 36%，内存也用得更少。
detail.en:
Compare vector addition, c = a + b. Through a graphics interface, you load a and b into two textures, write a shader, set up a render target, draw a rectangle covering it, and read the result back from the “image”. With CUDA, each thread uses its index i to compute c[i] = a[i] + b[i].

Deep learning later took the same road. The AlexNet authors wrote their own GPU convolution code in 2012, and in 2014 NVIDIA presented cuDNN; plugged into Caffe, it made one standard model 36% faster while using less memory.

limit.zh: CUDA 当时只支持 NVIDIA 自家的 GPU，写好的程序搬不到别家去。
limit.en: CUDA then ran only on NVIDIA's own GPUs, so programs could not simply move to another vendor's hardware.

sources: Buck et al. · Brook for GPUs, SIGGRAPH 2004, §§1–2 on programming through graphics APIs
NVIDIA CUDA Programming Guide 1.0, 2007-06-23, §§1.1–1.2 and Appendix A

title.zh: AMD GCN · 一套架构兼顾图形和计算
title.en: AMD GCN · Serving graphics and general computing alike

hook.zh: 换掉 VLIW，少靠编译器，图形和通用计算都顾得上。
hook.en: It replaced VLIW with compute units, relying less on the compiler for parallelism.

body.zh: AMD 之前的 GPU 用 VLIW 结构，要靠编译器找出能同时执行的指令。GCN 改用一个个计算单元，每个里面有标量单元和向量 SIMD 单元。这样少依赖编译器，图形和通用计算都能兼顾。2011 年 12 月公布的 HD 7970 用的就是它。
body.en: AMD's earlier GPUs used a VLIW design, which depended on the compiler to find instructions that could run in parallel. GCN replaced it with compute units, each holding a scalar unit and vector SIMD units. That made the chip less dependent on the compiler and let it serve both graphics and general-purpose computation. The HD 7970, announced in December 2011, was built on it.

limit.zh: HD 7970 在 2011 年底公布，要到 2012 年 1 月才开始零售。
limit.en: The HD 7970 was announced in late 2011 but did not reach retail until January 2012.

sources: AMD GCN whitepaper, June 2012, pp. 3–6; CMU mirror

title.zh: HBM · 把堆叠内存放进 GPU 封装
title.en: HBM · Stacking memory into the GPU package

hook.zh: DRAM 叠起来进了 GPU 封装，带宽靠宽接口和短连线。
hook.en: Stacked DRAM joins the GPU package, gaining bandwidth from wide interfaces and short connections.

body.zh: 2015 年，AMD 的 Fury X 用上 HBM，把堆叠的 DRAM 带进了 GPU 产品。这些存储层之间用穿透硅片的通孔相连，再通过一块中介层接到处理器上。带宽靠的是很宽的接口和很短的连线，不只是把引脚速率往上提。
body.en: In 2015 AMD's Fury X used HBM, bringing stacked DRAM into a GPU product. The memory layers are joined by through-silicon vias, and an interposer connects them to the processor. Bandwidth comes from a wide interface and short connections, not only from faster pins.

limit.zh: HBM 本身更早就有，2015 年只是它进入 GPU 产品的一年。
limit.en: HBM itself predates 2015; this was the year it entered a GPU product.

sources: SK hynix, Hot Chips 26, August 2014, slides 4–10

title.zh: Volta · 给矩阵乘法配专用单元
title.en: Volta · Adding dedicated units for matrix math

hook.zh: V100 加入 Tensor Core，专门做矩阵乘加。
hook.en: The V100 added Tensor Cores, units built only for matrix multiply-accumulate.

body.zh: Volta V100 在通用计算单元旁边，加了一组叫 Tensor Core 的硬件，只做矩阵乘加。输入用 FP16，累加用 FP32，两种精度混着用。深度学习里的密集矩阵运算，有了一条专门的硬件通道。
body.en: Volta's V100 added Tensor Cores next to its general-purpose units: hardware that does nothing but matrix multiply-accumulate. Inputs are FP16 and accumulation is FP32, a mix of two precisions. Dense matrix math in deep learning got its own path in hardware.

detail.zh: 合适的神经网络运算能用上它，可数据照样要搬进搬出，其他算子也照样要跑。所以拿矩阵峰值，推算不出整个程序有多快。
detail.en: Suitable neural-network operations can use it, but data still has to move in and out, and other operations still have to run. Peak matrix throughput does not tell you how fast a whole program will be.

limit.zh: 这一代 Tensor Core 不做 FP64 矩阵乘法，双精度它帮不上忙。
limit.en: This generation of Tensor Cores does not do FP64 matrix multiplication.

sources: NVIDIA V100 whitepaper v1.1, August 2017, pp. 14–16

title.zh: RDNA · 重新组织图形计算单元
title.en: RDNA · Reorganizing graphics compute units

hook.zh: 它为游戏图形的效率，重新组织了计算单元。
hook.en: It reorganized the GPU's compute units for efficient gaming graphics.

body.zh: RDNA 随 Radeon RX 5700 系列上市，主攻游戏图形的效率。它以 32 个线程为一组（叫波前）来执行，配上 32 通道的 SIMD 单元。缓存层次也重新设计过，为的是减少执行和访存的开销。
body.en: RDNA launched with the Radeon RX 5700 series and aimed at efficient gaming graphics. It runs threads in native groups of 32, called wavefronts, on 32-lane SIMD units, and its cache hierarchy was redesigned. Both changes cut the overhead of execution and data access.

limit.zh: 通用计算它也能做，只是设计重心放在了游戏图形上。
limit.en: It still handles general-purpose computing, but its design centers on gaming graphics.

sources: AMD RDNA whitepaper, 2019, pp. 4–5 and 12–16; original PDF mirror

title.zh: Ampere A100 · 让矩阵加速支持更多精度
title.en: Ampere A100 · Broadening matrix formats, splitting GPUs

hook.zh: 矩阵单元能算更多精度，一颗 A100 最多能切成七份。
hook.en: Its Tensor Cores handle more formats, and one A100 splits into up to seven instances.

body.zh: Ampere A100 的 Tensor Core 专做矩阵运算。这一代新增了 TF32、BF16 和 FP64 三种格式，AI 和科学计算能用上矩阵加速的地方更广了。MIG 则能把一颗 A100 切成最多七个独立实例，让不同任务共用一块硬件。
body.en: The A100's Tensor Cores handle matrix math. Ampere added TF32, BF16, and FP64 support to them, so more AI and scientific workloads can use matrix acceleration. A feature called MIG splits one A100 into up to seven independent instances, letting separate jobs share the same hardware.

limit.zh: TF32 能表示的数值范围和 FP32 一样，精度却低一些。
limit.en: TF32 covers the same range of values as FP32, but with lower precision.

sources: NVIDIA A100 architecture whitepaper, Tensor Core formats and MIG

title.zh: CDNA · 把计算架构单独分出来
title.en: CDNA · Splitting compute from graphics

hook.zh: AMD 把面向计算的架构从图形线里分出来，单独走。
hook.en: AMD split off a compute-focused architecture from its graphics line.

body.zh: AMD 用 MI100 推出 CDNA，面向高性能计算和 AI，和侧重图形的 RDNA 分成两条线。CDNA 在源自 GCN 的标量和向量单元旁边，加上了矩阵核心，专做混合精度的矩阵乘加。
body.en: With MI100, AMD launched CDNA for high-performance computing and AI, a line separate from the graphics-oriented RDNA. Next to scalar and vector units derived from GCN, CDNA adds matrix cores for mixed-precision matrix multiply-accumulate.

limit.zh: MI100 去掉了光栅化和显示硬件，不能当游戏显卡用。
limit.en: MI100 drops rasterization and display hardware; it is not a gaming card.

title.zh: Hopper · 专门给 Transformer 提速
title.en: Hopper · Built to speed up Transformers

hook.zh: H100 把加速 Transformer 定成了架构目标。
hook.en: The H100 made speeding up Transformer models an explicit design goal.

body.zh: Hopper H100 加入了 Transformer Engine 和 FP8 计算，把加速 Transformer 模型明确定为架构目标。互连也往外扩了：第四代 NVLink 加上外部交换系统，让高速 GPU 互连跨到多台服务器。
body.en: Hopper's H100 adds a Transformer Engine and FP8 computation, making Transformer acceleration an explicit goal of the architecture. It also reaches further: fourth-generation NVLink plus an external switch system extends high-speed GPU links across multiple servers.

limit.zh: 架构公布后，又过了半年才宣布全面量产。
limit.en: Full production was announced about six months after the architecture was unveiled.

title.zh: CDNA 3 与 MI300 · 把 CPU 和 GPU 装进一个封装
title.en: CDNA 3 and MI300 · CPUs and GPUs in one package

hook.zh: MI300A 把 CPU、GPU 封在一起，共享内存。
hook.en: MI300A puts CPUs and GPUs in one package that share memory.

body.zh: MI300 系列把 CDNA 3 架构、3D 封装和 HBM3 内存结合在一起，面向 AI 和科学计算。MI300A 在一个封装里放进 Zen 4 CPU 和 GPU，两者共享内存，异构编程因此简单了一些。MI300X 则不带 CPU。
body.en: The MI300 family combines the CDNA 3 architecture, 3D packaging, and HBM3 memory for AI and scientific computing. MI300A puts Zen 4 CPUs and GPUs in one package with shared memory, which simplifies programming across the two. MI300X leaves the CPUs out.

limit.zh: 开始供货时，部分整机还要等到 2024 年才上市。
limit.en: When shipments began, some complete systems were still scheduled for 2024.

title.zh: 图灵机 · 给“计算”下了定义
title.en: Turing machines · defining what computation is

hook.zh: 读写符号，加上有限条规则，就能说清什么叫计算。
hook.en: Symbols read and written under a finite set of rules pin down what computing means.

body.zh: 1936 年，图灵给“计算”下了一个精确的定义：读写符号，再加上有限条规则。按这个定义，一台通用机器能模拟其他机器。计算也有边界：有些数学问题，没有任何算法能解。
body.en: In 1936 Turing gave computation a precise definition: symbols read and written under a finite set of rules. Under that definition, a universal machine can simulate other machines. Computation also has a boundary: some mathematical problems have no algorithm at all.

limit.zh: 它回答能不能算，没回答算得多快。
limit.en: It answers what can be computed, not how fast.

title.zh: Dijkstra · 由近到远定下最短路
title.en: Dijkstra · settling shortest paths nearest first

hook.zh: 每次先定下离出发点最近的点，不用把所有路径都列一遍。
hook.en: Settle the nearest unsettled point each time, and you never need to list every path.

body.zh: 1959 年，Dijkstra 给出一种算最短路的顺序。每一步，从还没处理的点里挑出距离最短的那个定下来，再更新它邻居的距离。这样一点点往外推，不用把所有可能的路径都列一遍。
body.en: In 1959 Dijkstra described an order for computing shortest paths. At each step, take the closest vertex not yet settled, fix its distance, and update its neighbors. Working outward this way, there is no need to list every possible path.

limit.zh: 边的长度不能是负数，否则这个做法就不成立。
limit.en: It only works when no edge has a negative weight.

sources: Dijkstra · A Note on Two Problems in Connexion with Graphs (1959)

title.zh: ImageNet · 按概念层次收集图片
title.en: ImageNet · Collecting images concept by concept

hook.zh: 按 WordNet 的概念层次收集图片，再请人核验候选图。
hook.en: It gathered images by WordNet concepts and had people verify the candidates.

body.zh: 要做一个大规模图像数据集，难处不只在多下载些文件。ImageNet 按 WordNet 的概念层次收集图片，候选图片再交给人工核验。规模背后，是类别设计、检索、标注和质量检查一整套功夫。
body.en: A large image dataset takes more than downloading lots of files. ImageNet collected images under the hierarchy of concepts in WordNet, then had people check the candidate images. Reaching that scale took a whole pipeline of category design, retrieval, annotation, and quality checks.

limit.zh: 后来 ILSVRC 比赛用的只是其中的子集，和完整的 ImageNet 是两回事。
limit.en: The full ImageNet collection differs from the subsets later used in the ILSVRC competitions.

title.zh: Datasheets · 给数据集配说明书
title.en: Datasheets · Giving datasets a written manual

hook.zh: 数据为什么收集、怎么标注、能用在哪，都要写下来。
hook.en: Write down why a dataset was collected, how it was annotated, and what it suits.

body.zh: 如果一份数据只有文件名和一行下载说明，用的人只能猜它能用在哪、不能用在哪。Datasheets 主张把这些写清楚：数据为什么收集、怎么标注、适合哪些用途、之后由谁维护。
body.en: If a dataset comes with only a filename and a download link, users have to guess what it can and cannot be used for. Datasheets ask for the answers in writing: why the data was collected, how it was annotated, what uses it supports, and who maintains it.

limit.zh: 说明书让人有据可查，却证明不了数据就公平、准确、合用。
limit.en: Documentation supports scrutiny; it does not certify that data is fair, accurate, or fit for use.

sources: Gebru et al. · Datasheets for Datasets

title.zh: Model Cards · 发布模型时交代边界
title.en: Model Cards · Reporting what a model is for

hook.zh: 模型说明别只给一个总分，用途、表现和限制都要写清。
hook.en: A model report should state uses, test conditions, and known limits, not just one score.

body.zh: 只看一个总分，判断不了模型适不适合眼前的场景。Model Cards 要求把这些写清楚：模型做什么用、在什么条件下评估、在不同群体上表现如何、有哪些已知限制。这样开发者、使用者和受影响的人，才有依据做判断。
body.en: One aggregate score cannot tell you whether a model fits your situation. Model Cards ask for intended uses, evaluation conditions, performance broken down by group, and known limits in writing. Then developers, users, and the people affected have something to judge by.

limit.zh: 填好卡片只是第一步，安全审计和独立评估还得另做。
limit.en: Filling in a card is only a first step; safety audits and independent evaluation still have to be done.

sources: Mitchell et al. · Model Cards for Model Reporting

title.zh: MMLU · 用 57 个学科考模型
title.en: MMLU · Testing models across 57 subjects

hook.zh: 用 57 个学科的选择题，考模型预训练时学到了多少知识。
hook.en: Multiple-choice questions in 57 subjects test how much knowledge a model picked up in pretraining.

body.zh: 以前评估语言模型，常常只看单一的语言任务。MMLU 用 57 个学科的选择题，考模型在预训练中学到了多少知识。成绩还能按学科拆开看，总分盖住的短板就露出来了。
body.en: Language model evaluations often looked at a single language task. MMLU uses multiple-choice questions across 57 subjects to probe how much knowledge a model acquired during pretraining. Breaking the score down by subject exposes weaknesses that an overall number hides.

limit.zh: 选择题成绩，代替不了对开放式生成、工具使用和真实部署的评估。
limit.en: Multiple-choice scores cannot stand in for testing open-ended generation, tool use, or real deployment.

sources: Hendrycks et al. · Measuring Massive Multitask Language Understanding

title.zh: 晶体管 · 用半导体放大信号
title.en: The transistor · amplifying signals with a semiconductor

hook.zh: 贝尔实验室用一块半导体器件，放大了电信号。
hook.en: Bell Labs amplified electrical signals with a semiconductor device.

body.zh: 电话系统需要可靠的器件。1947 年，贝尔实验室做出点接触晶体管，用半导体器件放大电信号。它是为电话网造的，后来却成了计算机的基础。
body.en: The telephone system needed reliable components. In 1947 Bell Labs demonstrated a point-contact transistor, a semiconductor device that amplified electrical signals. It was built for the phone network and later became the basis of computers.

limit.zh: 点接触晶体管和今天芯片里的 MOS 晶体管，结构差得很远。
limit.en: A point-contact transistor is built very differently from the MOS transistors in today's chips.

sources: Bardeen & Brattain · Physical Review 74, 230 (1948), publication record

title.zh: 关系模型 · 把数据含义和存放方式分开
title.en: The relational model · separating data from its storage layout

hook.zh: 存储方式换了，应用程序最好不用跟着重写。
hook.en: When storage is reorganized, applications should need little or no rewriting.

body.zh: 1970 年，Codd 在论文里用“关系”来描述共享的数据。他主张，应用程序不该依赖记录的物理顺序、索引或访问路径。这叫数据独立性：存储的组织方式变了，应用尽量不用跟着改。
body.en: In a 1970 paper, Codd described shared data in terms of relations. He argued that applications should not depend on the physical order of records, on indexes, or on access paths. This is data independence: when storage is reorganized, applications should need as little rewriting as possible.

detail.zh: 后来有数据库直接跑起了机器学习。2012 年的 MADlib 在 PostgreSQL 和 Greenplum 里实现了回归和聚类，计算就在库里的数据旁边进行。
detail.en: Databases later ran machine learning themselves: the 2012 MADlib paper implemented regression and clustering inside PostgreSQL and Greenplum, so the computation stayed next to the data.

limit.zh: 关系模型没有规定分布式事务、物理执行计划，也不管数据质量。
limit.en: The model itself says nothing about distributed transactions, physical execution plans, or data quality.

sources: Codd · CACM, June 1970, original paper (university-hosted copy)
Hellerstein et al. · MADlib, PVLDB 2012, sections 3–4

title.zh: LLVM · 让各种语言共用一套优化
title.en: LLVM · compiler infrastructure any language can reuse

hook.zh: 一种通用的中间表示，让优化不再绑死在某一门语言上。
hook.en: A shared intermediate representation let optimizations work without being tied to one source language.

body.zh: 2004 年的 LLVM 论文提出一种低层的中间表示，也就是源代码和机器指令之间的一层通用写法。它带类型，每个变量只赋值一次。围绕它搭起的编译框架，能在编译、链接、运行时分析和改写程序，优化也不必绑在某一种源语言上。
body.en: The 2004 LLVM paper described a low-level intermediate representation, a common layer between source code and machine instructions. It is typed and in static single-assignment form, where each variable is assigned once, and a full compiler framework was built around it. Programs could be analyzed and transformed at compile, link, and run time, and optimizations were not tied to one source language.

detail.zh: 2018 年的 TVM 论文里，就有一条经由 LLVM 中间表示生成代码的路径。AI 编译器能复用这类通用工具，但张量布局、算子融合和硬件调度，还是得专门处理。
detail.en: TVM's 2018 system includes a code-generation path through LLVM's intermediate representation. AI compilers can reuse such general infrastructure, but tensor layouts, operator fusion, and hardware scheduling still need specialized work.

limit.zh: 它只是低层的中间表示，离完整的模型编译器还远，性能也得靠后面的优化。
limit.en: It is a low-level intermediate representation, far from a full model compiler, and performance still depends on later optimization.

sources: Lattner & Adve · LLVM, CGO 2004, original paper
LLVM · project archive, November 18, 2003 release entry
Chen et al. · TVM, OSDI 2018, figure 2 and sections 3–4

title.zh: RDMAP · 给远程读写内存定规矩
title.en: RDMAP · Setting rules for remote memory access

hook.zh: 让机器直接读写对方公布的缓冲区，少复制、少占 CPU。
hook.en: It lets a machine read and write buffers the other side has advertised, with fewer copies.

body.zh: 机器之间通信，数据要复制，CPU 也得陪着忙。2007 年 10 月的 RFC 5040 定义了 RDMAP：一台机器可以直接读写对方公布出来的缓冲区，内存保护照样保留。它建在直接数据放置协议 DDP 之上，为的是少复制、少占 CPU。
body.en: Moving data between machines means copying it and keeping the CPU busy. RFC 5040, published in October 2007, defines RDMAP: one machine can read and write buffers the other side has advertised, with memory protection preserved. Built on the Direct Data Placement protocol, it aims to cut copying and CPU overhead.

detail.zh: 2016 年的 TensorFlow 论文说，任务之间除了 TCP 上的 gRPC，还可以用 RoCE 通信，可见 RDMA 确实进了机器学习系统。但 RoCE 走的是另一条协议路线，不能据此说 TensorFlow 用了 RDMAP。
detail.en: The 2016 TensorFlow paper lists RoCE alongside gRPC over TCP for communication between tasks, so RDMA did reach machine-learning systems. RoCE is a different protocol path, though, so this does not show that TensorFlow used RDMAP.

limit.zh: 复制少了，通信、同步和管理缓冲区的成本还在。
limit.en: Fewer copies still leave the costs of communication, synchronization, and buffer management.

sources: Recio et al. · RFC 5040, October 2007, sections 1–3
Abadi et al. · TensorFlow, OSDI 2016, section 5

title.zh: 能耗比例性 · 活少时电也该少用
title.en: Energy proportionality · power that follows the work

hook.zh: 服务器闲下来，耗电也应该跟着降下来。
hook.en: When a server has little to do, its power use should drop too.

body.zh: 服务器没干多少活，也可能照样耗不少电。2007 年，Barroso 和 Hölzle 提出：负载降下来时，整台服务器的功耗也应该跟着降。光提高满载时的能效，还不够。
body.en: An almost-idle server can still draw substantial power. In 2007, Barroso and Hölzle argued that as the workload falls, the power use of the whole server should fall with it. They asked for more than better efficiency at full load.

detail.zh: 满载时每瓦算得多，和闲下来时省不省电，是两回事。2017 年的 TPU 研究专门测了不同负载下的功耗。
detail.en: High performance per watt at full load and low power during quiet periods are different properties. The 2017 TPU study measured power across a range of loads.

limit.zh: 这是一个设计目标，提出时行业里还没做到。
limit.en: It was a design goal; when it was proposed, the industry had not achieved it.

sources: Barroso & Hölzle · IEEE Computer, December 2007, original article
Meisner, Gold & Wenisch · PowerNap, ASPLOS 2009, independent follow-up
Jouppi et al. · TPU study, April 2017 v1, sections 5–6

title.zh: Roofline · 看清程序卡在哪
title.en: Roofline · Showing where a program gets stuck

hook.zh: 把计算上限和内存带宽放在一起，看程序卡在哪一头。
hook.en: It sets compute limits beside memory bandwidth to show what holds a program back.

body.zh: 同一颗 CPU 跑不同的程序，有的卡在计算，有的卡在等数据。2008 年 Berkeley 的一份技术报告用 Roofline 模型把两头放在一起看。关键是运算强度：每从内存读写一个字节能做几次运算。性能上限取计算峰值和“带宽 × 运算强度”中较小的那个。
body.en: Run different programs on the same CPU and some are limited by arithmetic, others by waiting for data. A 2008 Berkeley technical report used the Roofline model to look at both together. The key quantity is operational intensity: how many operations a program does per byte moved to or from memory. The performance ceiling is the smaller of peak compute and bandwidth times operational intensity.

detail.zh: 2017 年的 TPU 论文改造了这个模型，用来比较神经网络在 CPU、GPU 和 TPU 上的瓶颈，还按量化计算重新数了运算和字节。
detail.en: The 2017 TPU paper adapted the model to compare neural-network bottlenecks on CPUs, GPUs, and TPUs, recounting operations and bytes for quantized computation.

limit.zh: 它只给上限，实际能跑多快，还要看延迟、依赖和并行度。
limit.en: It gives only a ceiling; actual speed still depends on latency, dependencies, and available parallelism.

sources: Williams, Waterman & Patterson · UCB/EECS-2008-134, original report
Berkeley Lab · publication list, April 2009 journal article
Jouppi et al. · TPU study, April 2017 v1, section 4

title.zh: HDFS · 把大文件分散到多台机器上
title.en: HDFS · Spreading large files across machines

hook.zh: 一台机器管目录，许多台机器存数据块，坏一台也不丢。
hook.en: One node tracks the files, while many others store the blocks with copies to survive failures.

body.zh: 大文件分散存到很多机器上，就得应付机器故障。2010 年的 HDFS 论文给出了分工：NameNode 管目录和数据块的位置，DataNode 保存数据块，每块存多份副本。存储和计算放在同一批服务器上，任务就能在数据旁边运行。
body.en: Spreading large files over many machines means coping with machine failures. The 2010 HDFS paper set out a division of labor: a NameNode tracks the directory tree and where each block lives, DataNodes store the blocks, and each block is kept in several replicas. Storage and computation share the same servers, so tasks can run next to their data.

limit.zh: 它只允许一个写者、多个读者，为大文件吞吐而设计，给不了数据库那样的事务。
limit.en: Its single-writer, many-reader model targets large-file throughput and offers no database-style transactions.

sources: Shvachko et al. · HDFS, MSST 2010, original paper, sections II–III
Shvachko · author publication list, May 2010 entry
Zaharia et al. · RDDs, NSDI 2012, section 6.1

title.zh: HMM · 从声音反推看不见的状态
title.en: HMM · inferring hidden states from what you hear

hook.zh: 听到一串声音，反推背后最可能的那串隐藏状态。
hook.en: From a sequence of sounds, infer the hidden states most likely behind them.

body.zh: 语音有长有短，变化也多，没法把每一帧声音拆开单独分类。Rabiner 1989 年的教程系统地介绍了 HMM：隐藏状态按概率相互转移，每个状态产生声音特征这样的观测。有了一整段观测，就能反推背后可能的过程。
body.en: Speech varies in length and form, so you cannot classify each frame of sound on its own. Rabiner's 1989 tutorial laid out HMMs systematically: hidden states switch according to transition probabilities, and each state produces observations such as sound features. Given a whole sequence of observations, you can infer the process most likely behind it.

detail.zh: 用它要分清三个问题：这段观测有多大可能，哪条状态路径最可能，参数怎么从数据里学。第一个要把所有路径加起来，第二个要找出最好的一条，第三个是估计参数，三种算法各不相同。
detail.en: Three problems need to be kept apart: how likely an observation sequence is, which state path is most likely, and how to learn the parameters from data. The first sums over all paths, the second picks the best one, and the third estimates parameters; each needs its own algorithm.

limit.zh: 它假设下一个状态只看当前状态，算起来简单，能表达的依赖关系也就有限。
limit.en: It assumes the next state depends only on the current one, which keeps computation simple but limits the dependencies it can express.

sources: Rabiner · HMM tutorial, IEEE 1989, sections II–III
CMU AI Repository · HMM speech implementation, 1994 release

title.zh: LeNet-5 · 让识别器自己学特征
title.en: LeNet-5 · a recognizer that learns its own features

hook.zh: 卷积、权重共享和下采样配在一起，认手写数字。
hook.en: Convolution, shared weights, and subsampling worked together to read handwritten digits.

body.zh: 手写数字的写法和位置都不固定。1998 年那篇文档识别论文用 LeNet-5 展示了卷积、权重共享和下采样怎样配合，下采样就是把特征图缩小。参数靠梯度自己学出来，不用把识别规则全部手写。
body.en: Handwritten digits vary in shape and position. The 1998 document-recognition paper used LeNet-5 to show convolution, shared weights, and subsampling, which shrinks feature maps, working together. Its parameters were learned through gradients, so nobody had to write every recognition rule by hand.

detail.zh: 权重共享的意思是：同一组局部检测器在图像每个位置都用一遍，不用每个位置各学一套。后面的层再把这些局部特征组合起来。
detail.en: Weight sharing means using the same local detectors at every position in an image instead of learning a separate set for each position. Later layers then combine those local features.

limit.zh: 它的下采样和输出层，和今天常用的 max pooling、softmax 做法不同。
limit.en: Its subsampling and output layers work differently from today's usual max pooling and softmax.

sources: LeCun et al. · Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition, 1998

title.zh: Google 原型 · 把链接也用来排序
title.en: Google prototype · ranking pages by their links

hook.zh: 排序不只数关键词，还看谁链接了你、怎么描述你。
hook.en: Ranking looked beyond keyword counts to who links to a page and how they describe it.

body.zh: 1998 年的 Google 原型论文，把抓取、存储、索引和排序放在一个系统里讲。排序不只看关键词出现几次：PageRank 利用网页之间的链接关系，anchor text 借用别的页面对目标的描述，也就是指向它的链接上写的字。
body.en: The 1998 Google prototype paper described crawling, storage, indexing, and ranking as one system. Ranking went beyond counting query terms. PageRank used the link structure between pages, and anchor text, the words on links pointing to a page, supplied descriptions written by other pages.

detail.zh: 链接数量相同，分数也未必一样：链接来自哪些页面、这些页面又有多少出链，都会影响传过来的权重。PageRank 也只是排序的一部分，替代不了文本匹配和索引。
detail.en: Two pages with the same number of incoming links need not score the same: which pages the links come from, and how many outgoing links those pages have, change how much weight passes along. PageRank is still only one ranking signal and cannot replace text matching or indexing.

limit.zh: 链接多只说明受关注，内容对不对、和查询相不相关，是另一回事。
limit.en: Many links show attention; whether a page is right, or relevant to a query, is a separate question.

sources: Brin & Page · The Anatomy of a Large-Scale Hypertextual Web Search Engine, 1998

title.zh: word2vec · 从上下文里学词向量
title.en: word2vec · Learning word vectors from context

hook.zh: 把训练任务做简单，好用上大量文本学词向量。
hook.en: A deliberately simple prediction task let it learn word vectors from large amounts of text.

body.zh: 想从大量文本里学词向量，训练就得高效。word2vec 把预测任务做得很简单：CBOW 用周围的词猜中间的词，Skip-gram 反过来，用当前词猜附近的词。一个词每在新的上下文里出现一次，训练就把它的向量调一调。
body.en: Learning word vectors from large amounts of text calls for efficient training. word2vec made the prediction task simple. CBOW predicts a word from its surrounding words; Skip-gram does the reverse, predicting nearby words from the current one. Each time a word appears in a new context, training nudges its vector.

limit.zh: 每个词只有一个固定的向量，换个句子也不会跟着变。
limit.en: Each word gets one fixed vector that does not adapt to the sentence it appears in.

sources: Mikolov et al. · Efficient Estimation of Word Representations, January 2013 v1

title.zh: Sojourner · 在火星上自己绕开障碍
title.en: Sojourner · steering around obstacles on Mars

hook.zh: 地面只给目标，路上的障碍由它自己绕开。
hook.en: Ground controllers set the goal; the rover worked its own way around obstacles.

body.zh: 1997 年 7 月 4 日，Sojourner 随 Pathfinder 在火星着陆。地面给它目标，它结合对地形和自身位置的感知，自己绕开障碍。传感器、移动和通信，全靠有限的机载算力撑着。
body.en: Sojourner landed on Mars with Pathfinder on July 4, 1997. The ground gave it goals, and it combined those with its own sensing of terrain and position to steer around obstacles by itself. Its sensors, mobility, and communication all ran on limited onboard computing.

limit.zh: 它靠导航行为和地面配合，没有用强化学习训练。
limit.en: It relied on navigation behaviors and support from the ground, not on reinforcement-learning training.

sources: JPL Robotics · Sojourner software and electronics
JPL mission archive · rover description and navigation subsystem

title.zh: IBM 翻译模型 · 从双语句对里学词的对应
title.en: IBM translation models · learning word correspondences from sentence pairs

hook.zh: 不写规则，从约 178 万对英法句子里学出词的对应。
hook.en: It learned word correspondences from about 1.78 million English–French sentence pairs instead of hand-written rules.

body.zh: 按直觉，翻译是先读懂原文，再换种语言说出来。IBM 的四位作者反过来问：看到一句法语，哪句英语最可能是它的“原文”？这拆成两件事：英语通不通顺，词和词怎么对应。后者不靠人写规则，从加拿大议会记录的约 178 万对英法句子里学出来。
body.en: The intuitive picture of translation is to understand the source, then say it in another language. Four IBM authors asked a different question: given a French sentence, which English sentence most likely produced it? That splits into two jobs: a language model judges whether the English reads well, and a translation model says how words correspond. The translation model was not hand-written; it was estimated from about 1.78 million English–French sentence pairs from the Canadian parliamentary record.

detail.zh:
论文举过一个例子：英语 nodding 对应法语短语 faire signe que oui。Model 1 到 3 只把 nodding 连到 signe 和 oui 两个词，到了 Model 5，才连上整个短语。

后来的统计翻译常把词对齐当作中间一步。2003 年 Koehn 等人的短语翻译模型，先用训练 IBM 模型的工具 Giza++ 给语料做词对齐，再从结果里抽出成对的短语。
detail.en:
The paper gives an example: English nodding corresponds to the French phrase faire signe que oui. Models 1 to 3 link nodding only to signe and oui; Model 5 links it to the whole phrase.

Later statistical translation often treated word alignment as an intermediate step. The 2003 phrase-based model of Koehn, Och, and Marcu first word-aligned a corpus with Giza++, a toolkit for training the IBM models, then extracted phrase pairs from the result.

limit.zh: 它不管词形变化，法语动词的几十种形式各学各的，也只试了英法一对语言。
limit.en: It ignores word forms, so each of a French verb's dozens of forms is learned separately, and it was tested only on French and English.

sources: Brown et al. · The Mathematics of Statistical Machine Translation: Parameter Estimation, Computational Linguistics 19(2), 1993, §§1–2, 5–7 and Figure 5
Koehn, Och & Marcu · Statistical Phrase-Based Translation, HLT-NAACL 2003, §§3.1, 4.6

title.zh: SIFT · 换个角度也认得出
title.en: SIFT · Matching features across changes of view

hook.zh: 照片拍远了、转了，同一个点也能对得上。
hook.en: It finds points that still match when a photo is taken farther away or rotated.

body.zh: 同一个东西拍两次，远近、角度一变，像素就全不一样。当时常用的 Harris 角点，换个远近就对不上。SIFT 在不同尺度上找稳定的关键点，按周围梯度的方向把它摆正，再把附近的梯度统计成一串数字。一张 500×500 的图，通常能取出约 2000 个这样的特征。
body.en: Two photos of the same thing can differ in every pixel once distance or angle changes. The widely used Harris corner detector failed to match when the scale changed. SIFT finds keypoints that stay stable across scales, turns each to the dominant direction of its local gradients, and summarizes nearby gradients as a list of numbers. A typical 500×500 image yields about 2,000 such features.

detail.zh:
这串数字有 128 个：关键点周围取 16×16 的采样，分成 4×4 个小格，每格统计 8 个方向的梯度。比对时有条实用的规矩：最近的匹配距离超过第二近的 0.8 倍，就扔掉。在 4 万个关键点的数据库上，这条规矩去掉了 90% 的错配。

到 2012 年的 ImageNet 比赛，SIFT 还在前列：用 SIFT 加 Fisher 向量的方法拿了第二名，top-5 错误率 26.2%，AlexNet 是 15.3%。
detail.en:
The list has 128 numbers: a 16×16 sample grid around the keypoint, split into 4×4 cells, each with an 8-direction gradient histogram. Matching uses a practical rule: discard a match if the nearest distance is more than 0.8 times the second nearest. On a database of 40,000 keypoints, this removed 90% of false matches.

SIFT was still among the leaders at the 2012 ImageNet competition. A method built on SIFT and Fisher vectors took second place with 26.2% top-5 error, against AlexNet's 15.3%.

limit.zh: SIFT 只看灰度，不看颜色；它认的是登记过的具体物体，分不出“这是一只猫”这样的类别。
limit.en: SIFT ignores color, and it recognizes specific objects already in a database, not categories like “cat.”

sources: Lowe · Distinctive Image Features from Scale-Invariant Keypoints, author's copy dated 2004-01-05, §§1–2, 6–7, 9 and Figure 11
Same paper · IJCV 60(2), November 2004, DOI record
AlexNet · NeurIPS 2012 paper, Tables 1–2 with SIFT + FV entries
OpenCV 4.x · features2d.hpp, SIFT class documentation citing Lowe 2004

title.zh: 深度声学模型 · 用深度网络换掉 GMM
title.en: Deep acoustic models · Replacing the GMM with a deep network

hook.zh: 四个团队都发现：把 GMM 换成深度网络，语音识别更准。
hook.en: Four research groups found that deep networks beat well-tuned GMMs at recognizing speech.

body.zh: 多年来，语音识别靠 GMM-HMM：HMM 管语音在时间上的伸缩，GMM 判断每一帧像哪个状态。GMM 调得很成熟，新方法很难超过。这篇综述汇总了四个团队的结果：把 GMM 换成深度网络，同样的训练数据下，电话对话的词错误率从 27.4% 降到 18.5%。
body.en: For years speech recognition used the GMM-HMM: hidden Markov models handled how speech stretches in time, and Gaussian mixture models scored which state each frame of sound fit. GMMs were so well tuned that new methods struggled to beat them. This review gathers results from four groups that replaced the GMM with a deep network of several hidden layers. With the same training data, word error on telephone conversations fell from 27.4% to 18.5%.

detail.zh:
作者回头看也说得直白：大部分收益来自让网络利用相邻的几帧，以及直接预测上下文相关的状态。逐层预训练能减少过拟合，但训练时间上的好处，仔细设置初始权重的尺度也能做到。

代价在计算上。深度网络每一帧几乎要用上全部参数，识别 1 秒语音原本要 1.6 秒。把权重量化、改用 CPU 的定点指令后，降到 210 毫秒；用 GPU 是 66 毫秒。
detail.en:
Looking back, the authors were direct: most of the gain came from letting the network use neighboring frames and from predicting context-dependent states directly. Layer-wise pre-training reduced overfitting, but similar savings in training time could come from carefully scaling the initial weights.

The cost was computation, since a deep network uses nearly all its parameters for every frame. Recognizing 1 second of speech took 1.6 seconds. Quantizing the weights and using fixed-point instructions on a CPU brought that to 210 ms; a GPU took 66 ms.

limit.zh: 深度网络只换掉了 GMM，HMM、语言模型和解码器都还在，离端到端还远。
limit.en: The deep network replaced only the GMM; the HMM, language model, and decoder stayed, so end-to-end recognition was still far off.
