sources: Hinton et al. · Deep Neural Networks for Acoustic Modeling in Speech Recognition, IEEE Signal Processing Magazine 29(6), November 2012, DOI record
Same article · author-hosted magazine proof, Switchboard, Voice Input and summary tables
Same article · Google-archived draft dated 2012-04-27, §§I, II.E, IV and VI

title.zh: Faster R-CNN · 候选框也交给网络
title.en: Faster R-CNN · Letting the network propose the boxes

hook.zh: 让网络自己提候选框，提框从约 2 秒降到约 10 毫秒。
hook.en: Letting the network propose boxes cut proposal time from about 2 seconds to 10 milliseconds.

body.zh: 物体检测要说出是什么，还要框出在哪。主流做法先用 Selective Search 提出约两千个候选框，再由卷积网络逐个判断。网络已接近实时，提框反倒成了瓶颈，每张图约 2 秒。Faster R-CNN 用网络提框，和检测共用特征，每张图只多花约 10 毫秒。
body.en: Object detection must say what an object is and where it is. In 2015 the leading approach first used Selective Search to propose about two thousand candidate boxes, then had a convolutional network classify each one. The network was nearly real-time, so proposals became the bottleneck at about 2 seconds per image. Faster R-CNN added a Region Proposal Network that shares the detector's convolutional features, so proposals cost only about 10 milliseconds more per image.

detail.zh:
提框网络的关键是锚框：在特征图的每个位置预先放 9 个参考框，3 种大小乘 3 种长宽比。网络对每个锚框回答两件事：里面有没有物体，框该怎么挪、怎么缩放。

论文的计时表里，原来每张图共 1830 毫秒，提框占 1510 毫秒；换成提框网络后共 196 毫秒。准确率也没掉：在 PASCAL VOC 2007 测试集上，mAP 是 73.2%，Selective Search 方案是 70.0%。
detail.en:
The key to the proposal network is the anchor. Each position on the feature map gets 9 reference boxes: 3 sizes times 3 aspect ratios. For every anchor the network answers two questions: does it contain an object, and how should the box shift and resize?

In the paper's timing table, the old pipeline took 1,830 ms per image, 1,510 of them for proposals; with the proposal network the total was 196 ms. Accuracy held up too: on the PASCAL VOC 2007 test set, mAP was 73.2%, against 70.0% for the Selective Search version.

limit.zh: 它仍是先提框、再分类的两阶段做法，框也只能是矩形，描不出物体轮廓。
limit.en: It is still two-stage, propose then classify, and its rectangular boxes cannot trace an object's outline.

sources: Faster R-CNN · arXiv v1, 2015-06-04, §§1, 3–5 and Tables 2–4
ResNet · arXiv v1, 2015-12-10, §4.3 on detection with Faster R-CNN

title.zh: WaveNet · 一个点一个点地生成声音
title.en: WaveNet · Generating audio one sample at a time

hook.zh: 直接生成声音波形，用感受野内的历史预测下一个采样点。
hook.en: It predicts each waveform sample from earlier samples within its receptive field.

body.zh: 当时常见的语音合成方法会拼接录音片段，或先预测参数，再交给声码器合成。WaveNet 直接生成原始波形：先根据历史预测下一个采样点，再把它接回输入。概率分解写的是全部历史，实际网络只能看到感受野内的部分。在论文的英语和普通话测试中，听众给它的自然度打分高于所比较的参数式与拼接式系统。
body.en: Common speech synthesis systems stitched together recordings or predicted parameters for a vocoder. WaveNet generated the waveform directly, predicting one sample and feeding it back before the next. The probability factorization conditions on the full history; the actual network sees only its receptive field. In the paper's English and Mandarin tests, listeners rated it more natural than the parametric and concatenative baselines.

detail.zh:
为了看得够远，它用“空洞因果卷积”：每层只看前面的点，间隔逐层翻倍，从 1 一直到 512。这样一组层能看到 1024 个采样点。训练时可以并行算；生成时只能算完一个点，喂回网络，再算下一个。

自然度按 5 分制打分。美式英语里 WaveNet 得 4.21，真人录音是 4.55。逐点生成难以用上并行硬件，很难做到实时。后来的 Parallel WaveNet 从 WaveNet 教出一个能并行生成的网络，比实时快 20 倍以上。
detail.en:
To see far enough back, it uses dilated causal convolutions: each layer looks only at earlier samples, and the gap doubles from layer to layer, from 1 up to 512. One such block sees 1,024 samples. Training runs in parallel; generation must compute each sample and feed it back before the next.

Naturalness was rated on a five-point scale. In US English WaveNet scored 4.21, against 4.55 for real recordings. Generating one sample at a time suited parallel hardware poorly and made real-time use hard. The later Parallel WaveNet trained a network from a WaveNet that generates in parallel, running more than 20 times faster than real time.

limit.zh: 它只管把语言学特征变成波形，从文字得到这些特征，还得靠别的模型。
limit.en: It only turns linguistic features into a waveform; getting those features from text still needed separate models.

sources: WaveNet · arXiv v1, 2016-09-12, §§1–2.2, 3.1–3.2, Table 1 and Appendix A

title.zh: 稀疏混合专家 · 参数很多，每次只用几个
title.en: Sparse mixture of experts · Many parameters, few used at once

hook.zh: 成百上千个专家网络待命，每个位置只挑几个来算。
hook.en: Hundreds to thousands of expert networks wait, and each position calls on only a few.

body.zh: 普通网络里，每个样本都要过一遍全部参数，模型和数据一起变大，代价约按平方涨。只激活一部分网络的想法，一直没做出大效果。这篇论文的 MoE 层有成百上千个小网络，叫“专家”，由门控网络给每个位置挑几个。它用更少的计算，在语言建模和翻译上超过了当时最好的结果。
body.en: In an ordinary network, every example passes through every parameter, so as models and data grow together, training cost grows roughly with the square. Activating only part of the network per example had not delivered large gains. This paper's MoE layer holds hundreds to thousands of small networks, the experts, and a trainable gate picks a few of them, such as four, for each position. It beat the best published language modeling and translation results with less computation.

detail.zh:
门控先给每个专家打分，加一点噪声，只留最高的几个，没选中的专家完全不用算。麻烦在于门控会偏向少数专家：被选得多的训练得快，就更容易被选中。作者加了额外的损失，让各专家的负担尽量均衡。

在 1000 亿词的语料上，专家加到 65536 个，参数达 680 亿。同等计算量下，它的困惑度比基线低 39%，困惑度越低越好。再加到 131072 个反而变差，作者猜是太稀疏了。
detail.en:
The gate scores every expert, adds a little noise, and keeps only the top few; experts not chosen do no work. The catch is that the gate drifts toward a few experts, which then train faster and get picked even more. The authors added extra losses to spread the load evenly.

On a 100-billion-word corpus, the model grew to 65,536 experts and 68 billion parameters. At equal compute, its perplexity, where lower is better, was 39% below the baseline. Going to 131,072 experts made it worse, possibly from too much sparsity.

limit.zh: 计算省了，参数却照样要放进显存、在机器之间传，带宽和批量都成了难题。
limit.en: Computation shrank, but the parameters still had to sit in memory and move between machines, making bandwidth and batch size hard problems.

sources: Shazeer et al. · Outrageously Large Neural Networks: The Sparsely-Gated Mixture-of-Experts Layer, arXiv v1, 2017-01-23, §§1–5

title.zh: ELMo · 让词义跟着句子变
title.en: ELMo · Word vectors that change with the sentence

hook.zh: 同一个词放进不同句子，得到的向量也不一样。
hook.en: The same word gets a different vector in each sentence it appears in.

body.zh: word2vec 这类词向量给每个词一个固定向量。play 在体育报道和戏剧评论里意思不同，向量却一样。ELMo 先在约 3000 万个句子上训练语言模型，从左往右、从右往左各读一遍。用的时候，词的表示由整句话算出来。接进现有模型后，六个任务都刷新了最好成绩。
body.en: Word vectors such as word2vec give each word one fixed vector. “Play” means different things in a sports report and a theater review, yet gets the same vector. ELMo first trained a language model on about 30 million sentences, one direction reading left to right and the other right to left. In use, a word's representation is computed from the whole sentence. Added to existing models, it set new best results on all six tasks the paper tried.

detail.zh:
论文拿 play 对比过。用 GloVe 查，离它最近的是 playing、game、football，几乎全是体育。用 ELMo，棒球报道里的 play 找到的句子在夸球员打得好；百老汇 play 找到的句子，讲演员在一部成功的戏里演出。

各层学到的东西也不同。做词义消歧，第二层比第一层好；做词性标注，第一层更好。所以 ELMo 让每个任务自己学怎么混合各层。接进 SQuAD 问答的基线模型，F1 从 81.1 提到 85.8。
detail.en:
The paper compares neighbors of “play”. With GloVe, the closest words are playing, game, and football, nearly all about sports. With ELMo, “play” in a baseball sentence finds a sentence praising a player's play, while “play” in a sentence about a Broadway production finds one about actors in a successful stage play.

Different layers learn different things. For word sense, the second layer does better; for part-of-speech tagging, the first does. So ELMo lets each task learn its own mix of layers. Added to a baseline for SQuAD question answering, it raised F1 from 81.1 to 85.8.

limit.zh: 每个任务仍要自己设计模型；所谓双向，也只是两个单向模型拼在一起。
limit.en: Each task still needed its own model, and the two directions were separate one-way models joined together.

sources: Peters et al. · Deep contextualized word representations, arXiv v1, 2018-02-15, §§1–5 and Tables 1, 4–6
BERT · arXiv, §§1–2 and Figure 3 on ELMo as a feature-based approach

title.zh: 缩放定律 · 按规模预测语言模型的损失
title.en: Scaling laws · Predicting language-model loss from scale

hook.zh: 损失随模型、数据和算力按幂律下降，可以提前算出来。
hook.en: Loss falls predictably, as a power law in model size, data, and compute.

body.zh: 给定一笔算力，模型该多大、数据该多少？Kaplan 等人训练了一批 Transformer 语言模型，发现测试损失分别随参数量、数据量和算力按幂律下降，有的趋势跨了七个数量级以上。由此能算出最划算的分配：算力主要用来扩大模型，数据适度增加，而且不必训到收敛。
body.en: Given a compute budget, how big should a model be and how much data should it see? Kaplan and colleagues trained a range of Transformer language models and found that test loss falls as a power law in parameters, data, and compute, each taken separately, with some trends spanning more than seven orders of magnitude. The best split follows: spend compute mainly on a bigger model, add data moderately, and stop before convergence.

detail.zh:
几条结论可以直接用。模型每大 8 倍，数据只要多约 5 倍，就不会因为数据不够吃亏。算力增加时，最优模型大小约按算力的 0.73 次方增长，训练步数只按 0.03 次方。多出来的算力，主要该换成更大的模型。

2022 年的 Chinchilla 论文给出另一种分配。作者训了 400 多个模型，认为模型和数据应同比例增长。据此训练的 Chinchilla 有 700 亿参数，和 2800 亿参数的 Gopher 算力相同，在大量下游任务上胜过它。
detail.en:
Several results could be used directly. Each time the model grows 8 times, about 5 times more data avoids a penalty from too little data. As compute grows, the best model size grows roughly as compute to the power 0.73, and training steps as only 0.03. Extra compute should mostly buy a larger model.

In 2022, DeepMind's Chinchilla paper reached a different split. After training more than 400 models, its authors concluded that model size and training data should grow in equal proportion. Chinchilla itself, with 70 billion parameters, used the same compute as the 280-billion-parameter Gopher and outperformed it across a large range of downstream tasks.

limit.zh: 这是在一个数据集上拟合出的经验规律，预测的是损失，不直接预测下游能力。
limit.en: These are empirical fits on one dataset, not derived laws, and they predict loss, not downstream ability.

sources: Kaplan et al. · Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models, arXiv v1, 2020-01-23, abstract, §1 and Figure 3
GPT-3 · arXiv, §2 and Figures 2.2, 3.1 citing this analysis
Chinchilla · Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models, arXiv v1, 2022-03-29, abstract, §§1–2 and Table 2, App. D.2

title.zh: Whisper · 让语音识别不微调也能用
title.en: Whisper · Speech recognition without fine-tuning

hook.zh: 用 68 万小时带文字稿的网络音频训练，不微调也能用。
hook.en: Trained on 680,000 hours of transcribed web audio, it works on new datasets without fine-tuning.

body.zh: 以前的语音识别，常先用大量没标注的语音预训练，但用之前还得在具体数据集上微调。微调要有经验的人来做，模型还容易学到只在那个数据集里成立的规律。Whisper 直接用网上带文字稿的音频训练，共 68 万小时。模型不微调，直接拿去测别的数据集。
body.en: Speech recognition often started with self-supervised pre-training on unlabeled audio, but the model still had to be fine-tuned on each target dataset. Fine-tuning takes a skilled practitioner, and the model can learn patterns that hold only in that dataset. Whisper trained directly on 680,000 hours of web audio paired with transcripts, then was tested on other datasets with no fine-tuning.

detail.zh:
一个模型做好几件事，靠的是解码器开头的几个特殊词元。音频切成 30 秒一段，交给编码器—解码器 Transformer。解码器先预测语种，没人说话就输出“无语音”；再用一个词元指定是转写还是译成英语，然后才开始出文字。

论文最想说明的是稳健性。找一个在 LibriSpeech 上和 Whisper 成绩相差不到 0.1% 的有监督模型，换到其他数据集上测，Whisper 的错误平均少 55.2%。作者因此提醒，只在一个数据集上拿模型和人比，容易高估模型。
detail.en:
One model handles several jobs through a few special tokens at the start of the decoder. Audio is cut into 30-second segments and fed to an encoder–decoder Transformer. The decoder first predicts the language, or outputs a no-speech token if no one is talking; another token picks transcription or translation into English, and only then does text begin.

The paper's main point is robustness. Take a supervised model whose LibriSpeech score is within 0.1% of Whisper's and test both on other datasets: Whisper makes 55.2% fewer errors on average. The authors warn that comparing models with humans on a single dataset can overstate what the models can do.

limit.zh: 长音频里它还会陷入重复、漏词，甚至编出和音频无关的话。
limit.en: In long recordings it can still loop, skip words, or output text unrelated to the audio.

sources: Radford et al. · Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision, arXiv v1, 2022-12-06, §§1–2, 3.3, 6 and Tables 1–2
openai/whisper · official code and model release, MIT license, initial commit 2022-09-21

title.zh: Segment Anything · 点一下，就把东西抠出来
title.en: Segment Anything · Click once to cut out an object

hook.zh: 点一个点或画一个框，模型就把那个物体抠出来。
hook.en: Click a point or draw a box, and the model cuts out the object.

body.zh: 图像分割要逐个像素标出物体的范围，标起来很费工夫。SAM 让模型听提示：给一个点、一个框或一块粗略的掩码，都要返回合理的掩码。每张图只编码一次，之后每个提示在浏览器里约 50 毫秒出结果。训练数据 SA-1B 由模型和标注员一起攒出，有 11 亿个掩码。
body.en: Segmentation marks exactly which pixels belong to an object, and labeling it by hand is slow. SAM defined promptable segmentation: given a point, a box, or a rough mask, the model must return a sensible mask. The image is encoded once, then each prompt takes about 50 milliseconds in a web browser. Its training set, SA-1B, built by the model and annotators together, holds 1.1 billion masks.

detail.zh:
提示常有歧义：在衬衫上点一下，指的可能是衬衫，也可能是穿衬衫的人。SAM 的办法是一次给出 3 个掩码，大致对应整体、部分和更小的部分，另有一个分支给每个掩码的质量打分。

数据分三个阶段攒起来。先是标注员在浏览器里点选，SAM 实时出掩码，人再修，标一个掩码的平均时间从 34 秒降到 14 秒。接着模型自动填上有把握的，人只补漏。最后完全自动，SA-1B 里 99.1% 的掩码都是这样生成的。
detail.en:
Prompts are often ambiguous: a click on a shirt could mean the shirt or the person wearing it. SAM returns 3 masks at once, roughly the whole, a part, and a subpart, and a separate head scores each mask's quality.

The data came in three stages. First, annotators clicked points in a browser while SAM drew masks in real time, then touched them up; average time per mask fell from 34 to 14 seconds. Next, the model filled in confident masks and people added what was missing. Finally, the process ran fully automatically, producing 99.1% of the masks in SA-1B.

limit.zh: 它能把东西抠出来，却不知道抠出的是什么。
limit.en: It can cut out an object without knowing what the object is.

sources: Kirillov et al. · Segment Anything, arXiv v1, 2023-04-05, §§1–5, 8

title.zh: FORTRAN · 让程序照着公式写
title.en: FORTRAN · writing programs like formulas

hook.zh: 照着数学公式写计算，机器指令交给翻译程序去生成。
hook.en: Write the math, and let a translator produce the machine instructions.

body.zh: 1950 年代给 IBM 704 编程，得一条条手写机器指令。FORTRAN 团队说，解一道科学计算题，约三分之二的成本花在准备程序上。多数程序员也不信机器写的代码能和手写的一样快。FORTRAN 让人照着公式写，翻译程序生成机器码，代码效率是核心目标。
body.en: Programming the IBM 704 in the 1950s meant writing machine instructions by hand. The FORTRAN team noted that about two-thirds of the cost of solving a scientific problem went into preparing the program. Most programmers also doubted that generated code could run as fast as hand-written code. FORTRAN let people write in notation close to mathematics, and a translator produced the machine program, with the efficiency of that output as a central goal.

detail.zh: 论文里有个例子，作者自己也说说明不了太多。一位程序员上了一天 FORTRAN 课，用四小时写出 47 条语句。704 花六分钟，把它编译成约 1000 条机器指令。他估计手写要三天，调试还不算。
detail.en: The paper offers a case the authors admit proves little on its own. A programmer took a one-day FORTRAN course and wrote a job in 47 statements in four hours. The 704 compiled it in six minutes into about 1,000 machine instructions. He estimated three days to code it by hand, not counting debugging.

limit.zh: 它只为 IBM 704 而写；在它之前已有别的公式翻译系统在运行，只是大多不追求优化。
limit.en: It was written for the IBM 704 alone, and other formula translators were already running before it, though most did not try to optimize.

sources: Backus et al. · The FORTRAN Automatic Coding System, 1957 Western Computer Proceedings, pp. 188–198
Backus · FORTRAN session transcript, ACM History of Programming Languages conference, 1978
MPI Forum: early standard scope, language bindings
Harris et al. · Array programming with NumPy, arXiv v1, 2020-06-18, section on NumPy arrays
Backus · Can Programming Be Liberated from the von Neumann Style?, 1977 Turing Award lecture, CACM 21(8), August 1978, §§3–4

title.zh: C · 用高级语言重写 Unix 内核
title.en: C · taking the Unix kernel out of assembly

hook.zh: 给 B 语言加上类型，Unix 内核从此不用汇编写。
hook.en: Adding types to the B language let the Unix kernel move from assembly to C.

body.zh: Unix 起初用汇编写。Thompson 做的高级语言 B 没有类型，数据全是机器字，在按字节寻址的 PDP-11 上处理字符和指针很别扭。Ritchie 从 1971 年起给 B 加字符类型、数组、指针和结构，改名叫 C。1973 年夏天，内核用 C 重写。
body.en: Unix was first written in assembly. Ken Thompson created the higher-level language B, but B was typeless: every piece of data was a single machine word. On the byte-addressed PDP-11, that made characters and pointers awkward. From 1971 Dennis Ritchie added a character type, arrays, pointers, and structures, and renamed the language C; in the summer of 1973 the Unix kernel was rewritten in it.

detail.zh: 看一个字符串就明白差别。B 只有“字”，几个字符打包塞进一个字里；想逐个处理，得调库函数拆开，处理完再装回去。C 有了 char 类型，第 i 个字符就是一个字节，可以直接读。
detail.en: A string shows the difference. B had only the word, so several characters were packed into one word; to handle them one at a time, a program called library routines to unpack them and then packed them back. With C's char type, the i-th character is simply a byte that can be read directly.

limit.zh: Ritchie 说 C 古怪、有缺陷：声明要由内向外读，数组和指针的关系常让初学者卡住。
limit.en: Ritchie himself called C quirky and flawed: declarations read inside out, and arrays and pointers often trip up beginners.

sources: Dennis Ritchie · The Development of the C Language, HOPL-II, April 1993 (author's page)
Same paper · CS:APP mirror used for reading
MPI Forum: early standard scope, language bindings
Harris et al. · Array programming with NumPy, arXiv v1, 2020-06-18, history and array layout

title.zh: Python · 让脚本语言能用 C 扩展
title.en: Python · a scripting language built to be extended

hook.zh: 它的语法学 ABC，又能调用系统接口，还能用 C 扩展。
hook.en: Van Rossum wanted ABC-like syntax, access to system calls, and a language he could extend.

body.zh: 1980 年代末，Guido van Rossum 在 CWI 做分布式操作系统 Amoeba。管理它只能写 C 程序或 shell 脚本，都不顺手。他喜欢自己参与实现的 ABC 语言，可 ABC 没法扩展。他 1989 年底动手，1991 年 2 月公开。
body.en: In the late 1980s, Guido van Rossum worked in the Amoeba distributed operating system group at CWI. Administering the system meant writing C programs or shell scripts, neither a good fit. He liked ABC, a language he had helped implement, but ABC could not be extended. He started a new language over the 1989 Christmas holidays and posted it to USENET in February 1991.

detail.zh:
不少特点能找到出处：用缩进分组、内置高层数据类型，来自 ABC；异常来自 Modula-3，他说 Amoeba 里处理错误的经验让他格外看重异常。官方 FAQ 至今把“能用 C 或 C++ 扩展”列为它的基本特点。

后来的科学计算和机器学习正借了这种可扩展性。2019 年的 PyTorch 论文说，从 2014 年起，大多数深度学习框架都把 Python 接口当作必备。
detail.en:
Several traits trace back to this history. Indentation for grouping and high-level built-in data types came from ABC; exceptions came from Modula-3, and van Rossum says error handling in Amoeba taught him how much they matter. The official FAQ still lists extensibility in C or C++ among its basic traits.

Scientific computing and machine learning later leaned on that extensibility. The 2019 PyTorch paper observes that since 2014 most deep learning frameworks have treated a Python interface as essential.

limit.zh: 它起初没打算做数值计算，快的数组运算得靠 C 写的扩展。
limit.en: It was not first meant for numerical work; fast array operations come from extensions written in C.

sources: Python FAQ · Why was Python created in the first place?
Python documentation · History of the software
Guido van Rossum · A Brief Timeline of Python, 2009-01-20
Harris et al. · Array programming with NumPy, arXiv v1, 2020-06-18, scientific Python ecosystem
Paszke et al. · PyTorch, NeurIPS 2019, arXiv v1, §§2 and 5

title.zh: NumPy · 把两派数组合成一个
title.en: NumPy · merging two array libraries into one

hook.zh: 把分成两派的 Python 数组库合成一个。
hook.en: NumPy merged the two array packages that had split the Python community.

body.zh: 1990 年代中期，Python 有了用 C 写的数组库 Numeric。为了处理哈勃望远镜的图像，有人重写出 Numarray，社区就此分成两派。2005 年的 NumPy 把两边合起来，兼顾 Numarray 的功能和 Numeric 在小数组上的速度。
body.en: By the mid-1990s Python had Numeric, an array object and functions written in C. To handle large astronomical images from the Hubble Space Telescope, a rewrite called Numarray added features such as structured arrays and memory mapping. The two were largely compatible, but different enough to divide the community. In 2005 NumPy brought them together, keeping Numarray's features and Numeric's speed on small arrays.

detail.zh:
NumPy 数组就是一块内存，加上元素类型、形状和步长几项说明。在这之上是向量化：对整个数组做加减、求和，在 C 里可能要写几十行循环，在 Python 里常常一句就够。

到 2020 年，SciPy、Matplotlib、pandas、scikit-learn 都建在 NumPy 上，探测引力波、拍出第一张黑洞照片的软件里也有它。
detail.en:
A NumPy array is a block of memory plus a few pieces of metadata: element type, shape, and strides. On top of this sits vectorization: arithmetic or sums over a whole array, which might take tens of lines of loops in C, are often one Python expression.

By 2020, SciPy, Matplotlib, pandas, and scikit-learn were built on NumPy, and it was part of the software used to detect gravitational waves and produce the first image of a black hole.

limit.zh: 它只管一台机器内存里、用 CPU 算的数组，GPU 和超大数据得靠别的库。
limit.en: NumPy handles arrays in one machine's memory on the CPU; GPUs and data beyond one machine need other libraries.

sources: Harris et al. · Array programming with NumPy, arXiv v1, 2020-06-18
NumPy · About us, project history and governance
Paszke et al. · PyTorch, NeurIPS 2019, arXiv v1, §4.2 on NumPy interoperability

title.zh: TensorFlow · 把计算和状态画进同一张图
title.en: TensorFlow · Drawing computation and state into one graph

hook.zh: 运算、参数和更新都是图里的节点，由运行时分到各台机器上。
hook.en: Operations, parameters, and updates all become nodes in one graph that the runtime spreads across machines.

body.zh: Google 原来用 DistBelief 训练神经网络：试新的层得换语言，换优化方法得改参数服务器，循环网络和强化学习也塞不进固定流程。TensorFlow 把运算、参数和参数更新都画进一张数据流图，由运行时分到多台机器上。2015 年 11 月，它开源了。
body.en: From 2011 Google trained neural networks with DistBelief. Trying a new layer meant switching languages, trying a new optimizer meant changing the parameter server, and recurrent networks and reinforcement learning did not fit its fixed cycle. TensorFlow represents operations, parameters, and the operations that update them as nodes in one dataflow graph, which the runtime places across machines. Google open-sourced it in November 2015.

detail.zh:
论文用一个手写数字分类程序说明写法：先搭图，声明输入、权重、矩阵乘法、ReLU、损失和优化器，这时什么都还没算；再开一个会话，一批批喂数据，执行训练节点。整个程序写完才执行，运行时就能统筹安排。

参数服务器不再单独存在，一部分任务担任这个角色，但能运行任意计算图。2019 年的 PyTorch 论文把 TensorFlow 归为先建静态图的框架，用来对照自己边写边算的设计。
detail.en:
The paper illustrates the style with a handwritten-digit classifier. First the program builds the graph: inputs, weights, a matrix multiplication, ReLU, a loss, and an optimizer, with nothing computed yet. Then it opens a session, feeds in batches, and runs the training node. Because execution waits until the whole program is known, the runtime can plan globally.

The parameter server is no longer a separate system: some tasks take on that role, but they can run any graph. The 2019 PyTorch paper groups TensorFlow with frameworks that build a static graph first, the contrast for its own eager design.

limit.zh: 图得先建好再运行，结构在运行中才展开的算法，比如深度强化学习，用起来束手束脚。
limit.en: The graph is built before it runs, which constrains algorithms like deep reinforcement learning whose structure unfolds at run time.

sources: Dean and Monga · Google Research blog, open-source release of TensorFlow, 2015-11-09
Abadi et al. · TensorFlow: A system for large-scale machine learning, OSDI 2016, §§2–3, 5–6 and Figure 1
Sergeev and Del Balso · Horovod, arXiv v1, 2018-02-15, §§1–3
Paszke et al. · PyTorch, NeurIPS 2019, arXiv v1, §1

title.zh: PyTorch · 写一句，算一句
title.en: PyTorch · Writing models as plain Python programs

hook.zh: 张量运算写一句就执行一句，还能自动求导、用 GPU 加速。
hook.en: Each tensor operation runs as soon as it is written, with automatic gradients and GPU speed.

body.zh: 2010 年代中期的主流框架，要先搭一张静态的计算图，再拿数据反复去跑。这样便于优化，却难调试，能写的计算也受限。PyTorch 是一个 Python 库，写一句就算一句，同时能自动求导、用 GPU 加速，速度和当时最快的库相当。
body.en: Major frameworks of the mid-2010s first built a static computation graph, then ran it repeatedly on data. That helps optimization but makes debugging hard and limits what can be expressed. PyTorch is a Python library that runs each tensor operation as it is written, with automatic differentiation and GPU acceleration, at speeds comparable to the fastest libraries of the time.

detail.zh:
论文里的例子很直白：一个层就是一个 Python 类，构造函数里建好权重，forward 方法里做矩阵乘法、加偏置。因为每句都立刻执行，print、调试器和 matplotlib 都照常能用，中间结果随时能看。

快靠的是底下：核心库 libtorch 用 C++ 写，算子和自动求导都在里面跑；GPU 显存由缓存分配器反复复用。在作者测的 6 个模型上，PyTorch 的训练速度都在最快框架的 17% 以内。
detail.en:
The paper's examples are plain. A layer is a Python class: the constructor creates the weights, and the forward method multiplies and adds a bias. Because each line runs immediately, print statements, standard debuggers, and matplotlib all work, and intermediate results can be inspected at any point.

Speed comes from what sits underneath. The core library, libtorch, is written in C++ and runs operators and automatic differentiation, and a caching allocator reuses GPU memory. On the six models the authors measured, PyTorch trained within 17% of the fastest framework.

limit.zh: 一句一句执行，就丢了看到整个程序才有的优化；作者当时正在做 JIT 来补。
limit.en: Running line by line gives up optimizations that need the whole program; the authors were building a JIT to optimize outside Python.

sources: Paszke et al. · PyTorch: An Imperative Style, High-Performance Deep Learning Library, NeurIPS 2019, arXiv v1, §§1–7
Shoeybi et al. · Megatron-LM, arXiv v1, 2019-09-17, abstract and §3
Rajbhandari et al. · ZeRO, arXiv v3, 2020-05-13, §10.1

title.zh: Spark RDD · 把中间结果留在内存里
title.en: Spark RDDs · Keeping intermediate results in memory

hook.zh: 数据留在内存里反复用，丢了就照着来历重算。
hook.en: Data stays in memory between steps, and lost pieces are recomputed from their recorded history.

body.zh: 在 MapReduce 上，两个作业要复用数据，只能先写进分布式文件系统再读出来。逻辑回归这类反复迭代的算法，就被拖慢了。RDD 把数据留在内存里，只记下每份数据是怎么算出来的，丢了就照着重算。第一轮之后，逻辑回归每轮比 Hadoop 快 25.3 倍。
body.en: On MapReduce, reusing data between two jobs meant writing it to a distributed file system and reading it back. Iterative algorithms such as logistic regression and k-means paid that cost every round. RDDs keep data in memory, and the system records only how each dataset was derived, recomputing any lost piece from that record. After the first iteration, logistic regression ran 25.3 times faster than Hadoop.

detail.zh:
论文的日志排查例子只有三行：从 HDFS 读入日志，筛出以 ERROR 开头的行，把结果留在内存里。之后再查含 MySQL 的错误，就直接在内存里算。存着部分错误行的机器坏了，只把对应的那段原始日志重筛一遍。

在一次 75 台机器的 k-means 实验里，作者在第 6 轮开始时杀掉一台机器。那一轮从约 58 秒变成 80 秒；丢失的部分重算完，下一轮又回到 58 秒。
detail.en:
The paper's log-mining example takes three lines: read logs from HDFS, keep the lines that start with ERROR, and ask for the result to stay in memory. Later queries for errors mentioning MySQL run on the in-memory data. If a machine holding some of those lines fails, Spark refilters just the matching part of the original logs.

In a k-means run on 75 machines, the authors killed one machine at the start of the sixth iteration. That iteration rose from about 58 seconds to 80; once the lost partitions were rebuilt, the next one was back to 58.

limit.zh: 它适合对整批数据做同一种操作，不适合细粒度地改共享状态，比如 Web 应用的存储。
limit.en: It suits batch work that applies one operation to a whole dataset, not fine-grained updates to shared state like web-app storage.

sources: Zaharia et al. · Resilient Distributed Datasets, NSDI 2012, §§1–3, 6–7
Li et al. · Parameter Server, OSDI 2014, §1.3

title.zh: 参数服务器 · 让上千台机器共用一份模型
title.en: Parameter server · Sharing one model across a thousand machines

hook.zh: 参数分片存在服务器上，工作节点推梯度、拉新参数。
hook.en: Servers hold slices of the model; workers compute gradients and push and pull updates.

body.zh: 每台机器只管部分数据，却要不停读写共享参数：网络吃紧，一台慢了全都得等。2014 年 Li 等人的参数服务器把机器分成两种：服务器分片存参数，工作节点算梯度，再和服务器交换。同步多严由算法设计者定，在 1000 台机器上，工作节点空等时间从一半降到 1.7%。
body.en: Each machine handles part of the data but must keep reading and updating shared model parameters, so bandwidth runs short and one slow machine holds up the rest. The parameter server Li and colleagues described in 2014 splits machines into two roles: servers hold shards of the parameters, and workers compute gradients and exchange them through push and pull. The algorithm designer sets how strict synchronization is; on 1,000 machines, worker idle time fell from half to 1.7%.

detail.zh:
以梯度下降为例：工作节点算出梯度 push 给服务器，服务器加总后更新权重，工作节点再 pull 回新权重。每个工作节点只拉自己数据里出现过的参数，100 个工作节点时，每个只要总参数的 7.8%。

同步程度用最大延迟 τ 来调：τ=0 每轮都等齐，τ 越大等得越少。作者在稀疏逻辑回归上发现 τ=8 最划算。同样的算法，他们的系统只用 300 行代码，对照的专用系统都超过一万行。
detail.en:
Take gradient descent. Workers push gradients to the servers, the servers sum them and update the weights, and the workers pull the new weights back. Each worker pulls only the parameters that appear in its own data; with 100 workers, each needed 7.8% of the total.

Synchronization is tuned with a maximum delay τ: τ = 0 waits for everyone every round, and a larger τ waits less. On sparse logistic regression the authors found τ = 8 the best trade-off. Their system needed 300 lines of code for an algorithm that took more than 10,000 lines in the special-purpose systems they compared against.

limit.zh: 放宽同步不白来：等得少了，收敛要跑的轮数就多了。
limit.en: Relaxed synchronization is not free: less waiting means more iterations to converge.

sources: Li et al. · Scaling Distributed Machine Learning with the Parameter Server, OSDI 2014, §§1–5
Sergeev and Del Balso · Horovod, arXiv v1, 2018-02-15, §3

title.zh: Horovod · 改几行代码扩到多机
title.en: Horovod · Scaling to many GPUs with few changes

hook.zh: 每张卡跑同一份程序，梯度在卡之间直接求平均。
hook.en: Every GPU runs the same program, and gradients are averaged directly among the GPUs.

body.zh: Uber 的数据越来越多，有的训练要跑一周以上。TensorFlow 自带的方案用参数服务器，得自己起进程、改程序，在 128 张 GPU 上约一半算力耗在通信上。Horovod 改用 ring-allreduce：各卡算完自己那批数据的梯度，直接互相求平均。
body.en: Uber's datasets kept growing, and some training runs took a week or more. TensorFlow's standard distributed training used parameter servers, which meant starting extra processes and restructuring programs around new concepts; on 128 GPUs, about half the capacity was lost to communication. Horovod used ring-allreduce instead: each GPU computes gradients on its own batch, and the gradients are averaged directly among the GPUs.

detail.zh:
ring-allreduce 把 N 个节点连成一圈，每个节点只和两个邻居通信。前一半步骤把收到的值加到自己的缓冲区上，后一半用收到的值覆盖。缓冲区够大时，网络带宽能用满。

单卡程序只要改四处：初始化，给每个进程分一张 GPU，包住原来的优化器，开始时广播初始变量。按 Uber 的测试，Inception V3 和 ResNet-101 的扩展效率达到 88%，约为标准分布式 TensorFlow 的两倍。
detail.en:
Ring-allreduce arranges N nodes in a ring, and each node talks only to its two neighbors. In the first half of the steps, received values are added to the local buffer; in the second half, they replace it. With a large enough buffer, this uses the full network bandwidth.

Converting a single-GPU TensorFlow program takes four changes: initialize, give each process one GPU, wrap the existing optimizer, and broadcast the starting variables. In Uber's benchmarks, Inception V3 and ResNet-101 reached 88% scaling efficiency, about twice standard distributed TensorFlow.

limit.zh: 当时只支持一台服务器装得下的模型，在集群上装 MPI 也还麻烦。
limit.en: At first it handled only models that fit in one server, and installing MPI on a cluster still took effort.

sources: Sergeev and Del Balso · Horovod: fast and easy distributed deep learning in TensorFlow, arXiv v1, 2018-02-15

title.zh: Megatron-LM · 把一层网络拆到多张卡上
title.en: Megatron-LM · Splitting each layer across GPUs

hook.zh: 把每层的矩阵乘法切开，分到同一台机器的几张卡上。
hook.en: It split the matrix math inside each Transformer layer across the GPUs of one server.

body.zh: 2019 年，语言模型大到一张 GPU 装不下，现成的并行方案又得重写模型。Megatron-LM 只在 PyTorch 里加几处通信，就把每层的矩阵乘法切到同一台服务器的几张卡上。NVIDIA 用它在 512 张 V100 上训出了 83 亿参数的模型。
body.en: By 2019, language models were outgrowing the memory of a single GPU, and existing model-parallel frameworks required rewriting the model. Megatron-LM added only a few communication operations in native PyTorch to split each layer's matrix multiplications across the GPUs of one server. NVIDIA used it to train an 8.3-billion-parameter language model on 512 V100 GPUs.

detail.zh:
拿 MLP 来说：先乘矩阵 A，再过 GeLU。把 A 按列切，每张卡各算一半输出、各自过 GeLU，中间不用通信。第二个矩阵按行切，直接接住这些输出，最后做一次 all-reduce，把各卡的结果加起来。

实际训练时，一台服务器里的 8 张卡组成一个模型并行组，再拿 64 组做数据并行。整套系统的扩展效率是 76%。这个 83 亿参数的模型训了 9.2 天。
detail.en:
Take the MLP: multiply by a matrix A, then apply GeLU. Split A by columns, and each GPU computes half the outputs and applies GeLU on its own, with no communication. Split the second matrix by rows to take those outputs directly, then one all-reduce sums the results across GPUs.

In training, the eight GPUs in one server formed a model-parallel group, and 64 such groups ran data parallelism. The full system reached 76% scaling efficiency. The 8.3-billion-parameter model trained for 9.2 days.

limit.zh: 层内切分通信太频繁，只在一台机器内部划算，跨机器效率掉得很快。
limit.en: Splitting inside a layer communicates constantly, so it pays off only within one server; across machines, efficiency drops fast.

sources: Shoeybi et al. · Megatron-LM: Training Multi-Billion Parameter Language Models Using Model Parallelism, arXiv v1, 2019-09-17, §§1–3, 5–6
Rajbhandari et al. · ZeRO, arXiv v3, 2020-05-13, §§1 and 10

title.zh: 感知机 · 让随机连线的网络学会分类
title.en: Perceptron · a randomly wired network learns to classify

hook.zh: 连线是随机的，靠强化，网络学会对同一刺激给出同样的反应。
hook.en: A randomly wired network learned, through reinforcement, to give the same response to the same stimulus.

body.zh: 当时不少大脑模型借用开关电路，把回忆写成预先接好的线路。Rosenblatt 认为，这不适合连线随机、元件不完美的网络。1958 年他提出感知机：感光点连到随机连线的联想单元，再连到几个响应单元。被强化的联想单元“价值”升高，同一刺激再来，原来的响应更易胜出。
body.en: Many brain models of the time borrowed from switching circuits and symbolic logic, treating recall and comparison as wiring laid out in advance. Rosenblatt argued that this language did not suit a network of random connections and imperfect parts. In 1958 he proposed the perceptron: light-sensitive points feed randomly connected association units, which feed a few response units. Reinforced association units gain “value”, so when the same stimulus returns, the same response is more likely to win.

detail.zh:
设想一个只有两个响应的感知机，一个代表“方”，一个代表“圆”。图照到感光点上，点亮一部分联想单元；两个响应各自汇总，强的一方胜出，并压住对方。同类图形彼此相似时，没见过的新图也能以高于随机的概率归对类。

Rosenblatt 也写明了边界：具体的刺激它能学，可一旦要判断刺激之间的关系，比如“说出方块左边那个东西”，问题就变得极难。
detail.en:
Picture a perceptron with two responses, one for “square” and one for “circle”. An image on the sensory points activates some association units; each response sums the units wired to it, and the stronger wins and suppresses its rival. When images in a class resemble one another, an unseen image can be classified correctly with better-than-chance probability.

Rosenblatt also stated a boundary. A perceptron could learn responses to concrete stimuli, but once a response required a relation between stimuli, such as “name the object left of the square”, the problem became excessively difficult.

limit.zh: 它处理不了刺激之间的关系判断，Rosenblatt 自己也承认。
limit.en: It could not handle judgments about relations between stimuli, as Rosenblatt himself admitted.

sources: Rosenblatt · The Perceptron, Psychological Review 65(6), 1958, pp. 386–408 · DOI record
Same article · scan of the journal pages hosted at UIC; organization, learning rules, IBM 704 note, conclusions
Hopfield · PNAS 1982, p. 2555 comparison with perceptrons · CaltechAUTHORS PDF

title.zh: Hopfield 网络 · 凭残缺线索找回记忆
title.en: Hopfield network · recalling a memory from a fragment

hook.zh: 只给半条线索，网络也能落回整条记忆。
hook.en: Give it part of a memory, and the network settles back onto the whole thing.

body.zh: 除了按地址取数据，能不能凭残缺内容找回完整记忆？1982 年，Hopfield 提出由二值单元组成的网络，用连接强度存储模式。在对称连接、无自连接等条件下，按规则逐个更新单元，能量不会增加。它可以从受损输入恢复记忆，也可能停在错误的稳定状态，并不保证每次都找对。
body.en: Could a computer retrieve a memory from incomplete content rather than an address? Hopfield's 1982 network stored patterns in connections between binary units. With symmetric connections, no self-connections, and appropriate asynchronous updates, its energy does not increase. It can recover a memory from a corrupted input, but can also settle into an unwanted stable state; successful recall is not guaranteed.

detail.zh:
模拟里，30 个单元存 5 条记忆。从离某条记忆不超过 5 位的状态出发，九成以上能回到它。给它两条记忆按六比四混合的输入，它多半直接给出占六成的那条，不像线性网络那样输出混合。

2024 年，Hopfield 和 Hinton 获得诺贝尔物理学奖。公告说，Hopfield 网络借用描述原子自旋的物理，让存好的图像处在能量低处；Hinton 以它为基础，发展出玻尔兹曼机。
detail.en:
In simulations with 30 units and five stored memories, a start within 5 bits of a memory returned to it more than 90% of the time. Fed a 60–40 mix of two memories, it usually picked the larger one; a linear network would have returned a blend.

In 2024 Hopfield and Hinton received the Nobel Prize in Physics. The announcement says the Hopfield network borrows the physics of atomic spin to give stored images low energy, and that Hinton built on it to develop the Boltzmann machine.

limit.zh: 它只会联想，学不出隐藏特征；存的记忆一多，就取不准了。
limit.en: It only associates; it cannot learn hidden features, and recall breaks down once too many memories are stored.

sources: Hopfield · Neural networks and physical systems with emergent collective computational abilities, PNAS 79(8), April 1982
Same paper · CaltechAUTHORS PDF; model, storage rule, energy function, simulations, Discussion
Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences · Nobel Prize in Physics 2024 press release, 2024-10-08

title.zh: 翻译里的 attention · 不再把整句压成一个向量
title.en: Attention for translation · Looking back at every source word

hook.zh: 译每个词之前，先回头看原句的每个词，按需取用。
hook.en: Before writing each word, the decoder looks back over every word of the source.

body.zh: 2014 年的神经翻译，多把原句压成一个定长向量，再生成译文。句子一长就装不下，质量迅速下降。Bahdanau 等人给原句每个词都留一个向量，每译一个词，先给各位置打分，再加权求和。英法翻译上它得到 26.75 BLEU，同样设置的老办法只有 17.82。
body.en: Neural translation in 2014 mostly squeezed the source sentence into one fixed-length vector and generated the translation from it. Long sentences did not fit, and quality dropped quickly. Bahdanau and colleagues kept a vector for every source word; before producing each target word, the decoder scores all source positions and takes a weighted sum. On English–French it scored 26.75 BLEU, against 17.82 for an encoder–decoder trained the same way.

detail.zh:
论文的对齐图很直观。英文 European Economic Area 译成法文 zone économique européenne，词序是反的：模型生成 zone 时直接跳过前两个词去看 Area，再一个词一个词往回看。

句子越长，老办法掉得越厉害，新模型到 50 词以上也没下滑。后来的系统沿用了这个想法：2017 年的 Transformer 把它叫作加性 attention，自己改用缩放点积，还去掉了循环网络。
detail.en:
The paper's alignment plots make this concrete. “European Economic Area” becomes “zone économique européenne”, in reverse order: when producing “zone” the model skips the first two words to look at “Area”, then steps back one word at a time.

The longer the sentence, the further the old encoder–decoder fell, while the new model showed no drop even beyond 50 words. Later systems kept the idea: the 2017 Transformer called it additive attention, then switched to scaled dot-product attention and dropped recurrence altogether.

limit.zh: 每译一个词都要把原句每个词算一遍；词表只有 3 万个常用词，生僻词留待解决。
limit.en: It scores every source word for every target word, and its 30,000-word vocabulary left rare words unsolved.

sources: Bahdanau, Cho & Bengio · Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate, arXiv v1, 2014-09-01, §§1–3, 5–7, Table 1, Figs. 2–3
arXiv · version history and ICLR 2015 note
GNMT · arXiv v1, 2016-09-26, §3 on the attention module
Attention Is All You Need · arXiv v1, 2017-06-12, §§1, 3.2.1 on additive attention

title.zh: Deep Blue · 用专用芯片把棋算得更深
title.en: Deep Blue · searching deeper with custom chess chips

hook.zh: 480 块象棋芯片一起搜，重赛赢了世界冠军。
hook.en: With 480 custom chess chips searching together, it won a rematch against the world champion.

body.zh: 下棋程序靠往后推几步、给局面打分来选着，可评估越细，搜得越慢。1996 年，Deep Blue 以 2:4 输给世界冠军卡斯帕罗夫。IBM 重新设计芯片，新机器用了 480 块象棋专用芯片，在关键变化上搜得更深。1997 年重赛，它以 3.5:2.5 获胜。
body.en: Chess programs choose moves by looking a few moves ahead and scoring positions, but the richer the evaluation, the slower the search. In 1996 Deep Blue lost to world champion Garry Kasparov 4–2. IBM redesigned the chip; the new machine used 480 custom chess chips and searched deeper on critical lines. In the 1997 rematch it won 3.5–2.5.

detail.zh:
棋的知识大多是人放进去的。开局库约 4000 个局面，主要由特级大师 Joel Benjamin 手工整理；8000 多个评估特征的权重，也大多靠手调。

2016 年 AlphaGo 的论文拿它作对照：AlphaGo 评估的局面比它少几千倍，靠策略网络挑得更准、价值网络评得更准来弥补；Deep Blue 靠的是手写的评估函数。
detail.en:
Most of the chess knowledge was put in by people. The opening book of about 4,000 positions was prepared by hand, mainly by grandmaster Joel Benjamin, and the weights of the 8,000-plus evaluation features were mostly tuned by hand.

The 2016 AlphaGo paper used Deep Blue as a contrast. AlphaGo evaluated thousands of times fewer positions, making up for it with a policy network that chose positions better and a value network that scored them more precisely; Deep Blue relied on a handcrafted evaluation function.

limit.zh: 它只会下国际象棋，评估固化在芯片里，新特征加不进去。
limit.en: It played chess and nothing else, and its evaluation was fixed in silicon, so no new features could be added.

sources: Campbell, Hoane & Hsu · Deep Blue, Artificial Intelligence 134 (2002) 57–83 · DOI record
IBM Heritage · Deep Blue, 1996 and 1997 matches
Silver et al. · AlphaGo, Nature 2016 · DeepMind-hosted PDF, Discussion

title.zh: GNMT · 神经翻译走进 Google 翻译
title.en: GNMT · Neural translation reaches Google Translate

hook.zh: 中译英全部换成神经翻译，每天约 1800 万次。
hook.en: Google Translate switched all Chinese-to-English translation to a neural network, about 18 million a day.

body.zh: 到 2016 年，神经翻译在研究基准上已追近短语翻译系统，可上线还卡在三处：慢，生僻词译不好，有时漏译。GNMT 用 8 层 LSTM，把词切成“词片”，推理放到 TPU 上。2016 年 9 月，Google 翻译的中译英全部改用它，每天约 1800 万次。
body.en: By 2016, neural translation with attention was closing in on phrase-based systems on research benchmarks, but deployment was held back three ways: it was slow, handled rare words poorly, and sometimes skipped parts of the source. GNMT used eight-layer LSTMs, split words into “wordpieces”, and ran inference on TPUs. In September 2016, Google Translate switched all Chinese-to-English translation to it, about 18 million translations a day.

detail.zh:
论文的例句开头 Jet makers feud 被切成 _J et _makers _fe ud。不常见的 Jet 和 feud 各拆成两块，常见词保持完整，下划线标出词的开头。这样不用专门处理词表外的词，序列也不会像逐字符那样拉得很长。

双语评分员按 0 到 6 分给译文打分。英译中上，旧的短语系统平均 4.035 分，人工译文 4.987 分。GNMT 得 4.594 分，补上了两者差距的 58%。
detail.en:
One example sentence in the paper begins “Jet makers feud”, which becomes “_J et _makers _fe ud”. The less common “Jet” and “feud” split in two, common words stay whole, and the underscore marks the start of a word. Out-of-vocabulary words need no special handling, and sequences stay far shorter than with character-by-character modeling.

Bilingual raters scored translations from 0 to 6. For English to Chinese, the old phrase-based system averaged 4.035 and human translation 4.987. GNMT scored 4.594, closing 58% of the gap between them.

limit.zh: 它仍会漏词、译错人名和生僻术语，而且一句一句孤立地翻，不看上下文。
limit.en: It still dropped words, mistranslated names and rare terms, and translated each sentence in isolation, without context.

sources: Wu et al. · Google's Neural Machine Translation System, arXiv v1, 2016-09-26, §§1, 3–4, 6, 8 and Table 10
Google Research blog · A Neural Network for Machine Translation, at Production Scale, 2016-09-27
Attention Is All You Need · arXiv v1, 2017-06-12, Table 2 and §5.1

title.zh: YouTube 深度推荐 · 先召回几百个，再排序
title.en: YouTube recommendations · Retrieve hundreds, then rank

hook.zh: 从几百万个视频里先挑出几百个，再按预计观看时长排序。
hook.en: It pulls a few hundred videos from millions, then ranks them by expected watch time.

body.zh: YouTube 要从几百万个视频里，给每个用户挑几十个；用户满不满意几乎无从得知，只能看观看记录。2016 年 Google 的这篇论文把推荐换成两段深度网络：第一段在几十毫秒内找出几百个候选，第二段给它们打分，按预计观看时长排，不按点击率。
body.en: YouTube must pick a few dozen videos for each user from millions, and it almost never learns whether users are truly satisfied, only noisy signals such as watch history. This 2016 Google paper described a two-stage deep-network system. The first stage pulls a few hundred videos out of millions within tens of milliseconds; the second scores them, aiming at expected watch time rather than click-through rate.

detail.zh:
候选生成被写成一个超大的分类题：在几百万个视频里，猜用户下一个会看完哪个。最近 50 次观看的视频向量取平均，搜索词也一样，再拼上地区、设备等特征，送进几层网络。上线时不算概率，直接在点积空间里找最近的视频。

论文记下了几个坑。用户刚搜了 taylor swift，模型若知道这次搜索，就会把搜索结果页原样搬到首页，效果很差，所以搜索词被打散成无序的词袋。按点击率排序会抬高点进去却不看完的标题党，所以排序改按观看时长加权。
detail.en:
Candidate generation is posed as a huge classification problem: among millions of videos, which will this user watch to completion next? Embeddings of the last 50 watched videos are averaged, as are recent search tokens, joined with features such as region and device, and passed through several layers. At serving time no probabilities are computed; the system searches for the nearest videos by dot product.

The paper records some hard lessons. If the model knows a user just searched for “taylor swift”, it copies that results page onto the homepage, which performs poorly, so searches enter as an unordered bag of tokens. Ranking by click-through rate promotes clickbait that users click but do not finish, so the ranker weights examples by watch time.

limit.zh: 观看时长只是代理指标，用户到底满不满意，作者几乎拿不到真值。
limit.en: Watch time is only a proxy; the authors say they rarely get ground truth on whether users are satisfied.

sources: Covington, Adams & Sargin · Deep Neural Networks for YouTube Recommendations, RecSys 2016 · Google-hosted PDF, §§1–5

title.zh: Codex 与 Copilot · 在编辑器里续写代码
title.en: Codex and Copilot · Suggesting code inside the editor

hook.zh: 拿 GitHub 代码训的模型，在编辑器里补整行、整个函数。
hook.en: A model trained on GitHub code suggests whole lines and functions inside the editor.

body.zh: GPT-3 能照文档字符串写些简单程序，但没专门学代码，在后来的 HumanEval 上一题没对。2021 年，OpenAI 用 GitHub 公开代码微调出 Codex。6 月，GitHub 推出由它驱动的 Copilot 预览，在编辑器里补整行、整个函数。
body.en: GPT-3 could write some simple programs from Python docstrings, but it had never been trained on code and solved none of the problems in the later HumanEval test. In 2021 OpenAI fine-tuned GPT on public GitHub code to make Codex. In June, GitHub launched a preview of Copilot, powered by Codex, which suggests whole lines or functions in the editor.

detail.zh:
HumanEval 有 164 道手写的题，每题给出函数签名和文档字符串，用单元测试判对错。之所以手写，是因为现成题目的答案早已在 GitHub 上。120 亿参数的 Codex 每题只生成一次，能做对 28.8%。

论文直接写了它的毛病：文档字符串里串起的操作越多越容易错，每多一步，通过率大约降为原来的二分之一到三分之一。它还会把变量和操作对错位。
detail.en:
HumanEval has 164 hand-written problems, each with a function signature, a docstring, and unit tests. They were written by hand because solutions to existing problems were already on GitHub. With one sample per problem, the 12-billion-parameter Codex solved 28.8%.

The paper is direct about failures. The more operations a docstring chains together, the worse Codex does; each extra step cut the pass rate by a factor of roughly two to three. It also mixes up which operation goes with which variable.

limit.zh: 生成的代码可能看着对、其实没做到要求，也可能不安全，必须有人审查。
limit.en: Generated code can look right without doing what was asked, or be insecure, so a person has to review it.

sources: Chen et al. · Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code, arXiv v1, 2021-07-07, §§1–3, 6–7
GitHub blog · Introducing GitHub Copilot: your AI pair programmer, 2021-06-29
GitHub blog · GitHub Copilot is generally available to all developers, 2022-06-21

title.zh: arXiv · 预印本不用再寄复印件
title.en: arXiv · sharing preprints without mailed photocopies

hook.zh: 论文投到一台服务器，订阅者收到通知，想看再取全文。
hook.en: Authors sent papers to one server; subscribers got notices and fetched full texts on request.

body.zh: 1980 年代末，高能物理学者写完论文，只把复印件寄给一小批同行，非名校的年轻人常常看不到。1991 年，Los Alamos 的物理学家 Ginsparg 用一组脚本搭了个自动邮件服务器：作者把论文投给它，它存好并通知订阅者，想看全文再去取。
body.en: In the late 1980s, high-energy physicists mailed photocopies of new papers to a small circle of colleagues, and young researchers at less prominent institutions were often left out entirely. In 1991 Paul Ginsparg, a physicist at Los Alamos, used a set of scripts to build an automated email server. Authors submitted papers, it stored them and alerted subscribers, and full texts went out on request.

detail.zh:
原本预计一年约 100 篇，头半年就收到 400 篇。旧稿本来要三个月后自动删除，可大家发现查它比在办公室翻复印件方便，删除程序一直没装，稿件从没删过。

Ginsparg 写到，欠发达国家的物理学者很快觉得自己终于“在圈里”了：新想法能及时读到，自己的论文也能被平等地读到。
detail.en:
The plan was about 100 submissions a year; it received 400 in its first half year. Old papers were supposed to be deleted after three months, but people found it easier than hunting for a photocopy, so the deletion job was never installed and nothing was ever deleted.

Ginsparg recalls that physicists in less developed countries soon felt finally in the loop, receiving new ideas promptly and having their own work read on equal terms.

limit.zh: 审核只看切题和学术价值，放上去的论文没经过同行评审。
limit.en: Moderation checks topic and scholarly value; papers posted there have not been peer reviewed.

sources: Ginsparg · It was twenty years ago today..., arXiv v2, 2011-09-13
arXiv · Content moderation is not peer review
arXiv · Bahdanau et al. version history, v1 2014-09-01

title.zh: GPL · 让改过的程序也得能分享
title.en: GPL · keeping modified programs shareable

hook.zh: 谁都能改、能卖，但发出去时得附上源代码。
hook.en: Anyone could change or sell the program, but distributing it meant handing over the source.

body.zh: 许可太宽松时，别人可以把自由软件改一改、只发编译好的程序，再禁止分享。1989 年的 GPL 规定：谁都能复制、修改、分发，甚至收费。但分发时要附上源代码，并按同样的条款授权给所有人。
body.en: When free software was released under a very permissive license, others could modify it, ship only compiled programs, and forbid sharing. The 1989 GPL let anyone copy, modify, and distribute a program, even for a fee. But whoever distributed it had to provide the source code and license the whole work to everyone under the same terms.

detail.zh:
条款写得很具体。只发编译好的程序时，要么附上完整源代码，要么附一份至少三年有效的书面承诺，只收分发成本就提供源码。所谓源代码，指的是改这个作品时首选的那种形式。

它也划了边界。和别的独立作品放在同一个存储介质上，只算“单纯聚合”，不会把对方拉进这份许可。程序写明适用“任何更新版本”的，使用者可以按新版办。
detail.en:
The terms are concrete. Shipping a compiled program requires either the complete source or a written offer, valid for at least three years, to supply it for no more than the cost of distribution. Source code means the preferred form of the work for making changes.

It also set limits. Putting an independent work on the same storage medium is mere aggregation and does not bring that work under the license. If a program says “any later version” applies, users may follow the newer terms.

limit.zh: 交源码的义务只在分发时才有，许可也不担保代码质量。
limit.en: The duty to share source applies only when you distribute the program, and the license promises nothing about code quality.

sources: GNU General Public License, version 1, February 1989 (gnu.org), preamble and §§0–7
Stallman · The GNU Project, sections on the X Window System and copyleft (the GNU project's account)
GNU General Public License, version 2, June 1991 (header)
GNU General Public License, version 3, 29 June 2007 (header)
Linus Torvalds: Linux 0.12 release notes, license change, kernel.org archive

title.zh: Hugging Face Transformers · 把预训练模型收进一个库
title.en: Hugging Face Transformers · Gathering pretrained models in one library

hook.zh: 各家预训练模型收进一个库，一个调用就能加载。
hook.en: It gathered scattered pretrained models into one library, each loaded with a single call.

body.zh: BERT、GPT-2 之后，NLP 常见的做法是拿预训练好的大模型，在自己的任务上微调。可各家的代码和权重散在不同仓库里。Hugging Face 把它们收进一个库，统一成配置、模型、分词器三个类，都用一个 from_pretrained() 调用加载。
body.en: After BERT and GPT-2, the usual NLP workflow was to take a large pretrained model and fine-tune it on your own task. But model code and weights were scattered across repositories and frameworks. Hugging Face gathered these models into one library built on three classes, configuration, model, and tokenizer, each loaded with a single from_pretrained() call.

detail.zh:
比如要用在法语上预训练的 BERT 模型 FlauBERT，两行代码就够：一行加载分词器，一行加载模型，填同一个名字。库按名字找到对应的类，下载并缓存权重。同一个模型换个“头”，就能做分类或问答。

它从内部工具长出来，改过两次名。2019 年论文写作时，它才存在约十个月，已有 200 多篇论文用到它。到 2020 年，模型中心里有 2,097 个社区上传的模型。
detail.en:
Using FlauBERT, a BERT model pretrained on French, takes two lines: one loads the tokenizer, one loads the model, both by the same name. From the name, the library finds the right classes and downloads and caches the weights. Swapping the “head” on the same model adapts it to classification or question answering.

It grew out of internal tools and was renamed twice. When the 2019 paper was written, the library was about ten months old and more than 200 papers reported using it. By 2020 its model hub held 2,097 community-uploaded models.

limit.zh: 复用变容易了，从头预训练还是一样贵。
limit.en: Reusing models got easier; pretraining from scratch stayed expensive.

sources: Wolf et al. · Transformers: State-of-the-art Natural Language Processing, arXiv v1, 2019-10-09, §§1–3, 5
Wolf et al. · Transformers: State-of-the-Art Natural Language Processing, EMNLP 2020 System Demonstrations, pp. 38–45, §§1, 4

title.zh: Xen · 一台服务器分给几个系统
title.en: Xen · Splitting one server among several systems

hook.zh: 把客户系统稍改一改，遇到特权操作就请 Xen 代办。
hook.en: A lightly modified guest system asks Xen to carry out privileged operations for it.

body.zh: 很多人共用一台服务器，装在同一个系统里会互相拖累。虚拟机隔得更干净，可 x86 有些特权指令权限不够时会悄悄失败，VMware 只好边跑边改写机器码。2003 年的 Xen 换了条路：把客户系统稍改一改，遇到特权操作就请 Xen 代办，应用一行不用改。
body.en: Putting many users on one operating system lets their configurations collide and one heavy user slow everyone down. Virtual machines separate users more cleanly, but on x86 some privileged instructions fail silently, so VMware rewrote guest machine code as it ran. The 2003 Xen paper took another route: modify the guest system slightly so it asks Xen to perform privileged operations, while applications run unchanged.

detail.zh:
代价是得改操作系统。论文统计，移植 Linux 改动和新增了约 3000 行代码，占 x86 相关代码的 1.36%。管理功能放在叫 Domain0 的特权域里，由它创建和销毁其他虚拟机。设计目标是一台服务器跑约 100 个虚拟机。

后来的云服务用上了它。2006 年亚马逊发布 EC2 测试版时，发布博客写明 EC2 建在 Xen 上。
detail.en:
The price was a modified operating system. Porting Linux took about 3,000 changed or added lines, 1.36% of its x86-specific code. Management lives in a privileged domain called Domain0, which creates and destroys other virtual machines. The design target was about 100 virtual machines per server.

Cloud services later built on it. When Amazon released the EC2 beta in 2006, the launch post stated that EC2 was built on Xen.

limit.zh: 客户系统得改源码才能跑；论文写成时，Windows XP 只能跑些简单程序。
limit.en: Guest systems had to be modified; when the paper was written, Windows XP could run only simple programs.

sources: Barham et al. · Xen and the Art of Virtualization, SOSP 2003, §§1–3 and Table 2, Cambridge author copy
Jeff Barr · Amazon EC2 Beta, AWS News Blog, 2006-08-25 (EC2 built on Xen)

title.zh: Amazon EC2 · 服务器按小时租
title.en: Amazon EC2 · Renting servers by the hour

hook.zh: 调一个接口，几分钟开出一台虚拟服务器，用多少付多少。
hook.en: One web service call brought up a virtual server in minutes, paid for by use.

body.zh: 以前要上线网站，得先买服务器或签按月按年的租约，还要提前猜流量。猜多了机器闲着，猜少了用户看到“网站太忙”。2006 年 8 月，亚马逊推出 EC2 测试版：调一下接口，几分钟就开出一台虚拟服务器，不用了就关。当时只有一种规格，每小时 10 美分。
body.en: Putting a website online used to mean buying servers or signing monthly or yearly rentals, then guessing traffic in advance. Guess high and machines sat idle; guess low and users saw “site too busy.” In August 2006 Amazon opened a limited beta of EC2: a web service call brought up a virtual server within minutes, and customers shut it down when done. There was one configuration, at 10 cents an hour.

detail.zh:
Barr 的发布博客举过一个例子：一个只在早 7 点到晚 7 点用的内部库存系统，晚上把实例关掉，服务器费用就能省下一半左右。

系统盘打包成 AMI 镜像存在 S3 里，调用接口就能用它启动实例；底层虚拟化用的是 Xen。测试期每个账户最多同时开 20 台。
detail.en:
Barr's launch post cited an internal inventory application used only from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.; shutting the instance down at night would cut server costs by about half.

A boot disk was packaged as an AMI and stored in S3, and web service calls launched instances from it; the virtualization underneath was Xen. During the beta an account could run up to 20 servers at once.

limit.zh: 刚推出时，实例一关本地数据就没了，负载均衡和自动扩缩也还没有。
limit.en: At launch, local data vanished when an instance stopped, and there was no load balancing or Auto Scaling yet.

sources: AWS What's New · Announcing Amazon EC2 (beta), 2006-08-24
Jeff Barr · Amazon EC2 Beta, AWS News Blog, 2006-08-25
Jeff Barr · Happy 15th Birthday Amazon EC2, AWS News Blog, 2021-08-23

title.zh: Borg · 把闲着的资源让给批处理
title.en: Borg · Lending idle capacity to batch jobs

hook.zh: 在线服务和批处理混着跑，用不上的资源回收给批处理。
hook.en: Services and batch jobs share machines, and whatever services leave unused goes to batch work.

body.zh: 在线服务要为少见的流量高峰预留资源，平时大多用不上。Google 的 Borg 让在线服务和批处理混在同一批机器上跑，估计每个任务实际要用多少，把多出来的拿去跑批处理。论文说，要是两类作业分开，中位数大小的集群单元得多用 20–30% 的机器。
body.en: Services reserve resources for rare traffic spikes and leave most of them unused, so machines sit idle. Google's cluster manager, Borg, mixed services and batch jobs on the same machines. It estimated how much each task would actually use and reclaimed the rest for batch work. Splitting the two kinds of work apart, the 2015 paper reports, would have needed 20–30% more machines in a median cell.

detail.zh:
具体做法是：作业先报一个资源上限，Borg 每隔几秒按实际用量估一个“预留”，上限和预留之间的差额，拿去跑能接受资源差一点的批处理。中位数大小的单元里，约 20% 的工作负载跑在回收来的资源上。

Borg 的任务大多跑在 Linux 容器里，没用虚拟机。论文最后讲了这些经验怎样用到 Kubernetes 上，比如 Borg 的 alloc 对应 Kubernetes 的 pod。
detail.en:
Here is how it worked. A job states an upper limit on resources. Every few seconds Borg estimates a reservation from actual usage, and the gap between limit and reservation runs batch work that can tolerate lower-quality resources. In a median cell, about 20% of the workload ran in reclaimed resources.

Most Borg tasks ran in Linux containers, not virtual machines. The paper ends with how these lessons carried over to Kubernetes; for example, Borg's alloc became the Kubernetes pod.

limit.zh: 这些数字来自 Google 自己的集群和工作负载，换一家公司未必一样。
limit.en: These figures come from Google's own clusters and workloads; another company's could differ.

sources: Verma et al. · Large-scale cluster management at Google with Borg, EuroSys 2015, §§2, 5–6 and 8
Joe Beda · 4 Years of K8s, Kubernetes blog, 2018-06-06

title.zh: TVM · 把模型编译到各种硬件上
title.en: TVM · Compiling models for many kinds of hardware

hook.zh: 把模型当程序来编译，自动给每种硬件生成算子代码。
hook.en: It treats running a model as a compiler problem and generates operator code for each device.

body.zh: 2018 年前后，框架把干活的算子交给厂商写好的库，比如 cuDNN。这些库主要照顾服务器 GPU，换到手机或 FPGA 上就得大量手工调。TVM 把它当成编译问题：先在计算图上做融合等优化，再为每个算子生成目标硬件的代码，用学出来的代价模型挑更快的写法。
body.en: Around 2018, frameworks handed the real work to vendor operator libraries such as cuDNN. Those focused on server GPUs; moving to phones or FPGA accelerators took a lot of hand tuning. TVM treated this as a compiler problem: optimize the computation graph with steps such as fusion, then generate code for each operator on the target hardware, using a learned cost model to pick faster versions.

detail.zh:
举个例子：卷积后面跟一个逐元素加法。不融合时，卷积先把结果写回显存，加法再读回来；融合成一个内核，中间结果就不用来回搬。论文在 Titan X 上测到，融合后的算子快 1.2–2 倍。

每个算子先写清“算什么”，再决定“怎么算”：怎么分块、循环按什么顺序、数据放哪层缓存。组合太多，TVM 就在目标硬件上实测候选代码，用测到的时间训练代价模型，预测哪种写法更快。
detail.en:
A small example: a convolution followed by an element-wise addition. Unfused, the convolution writes its result back to GPU memory and the addition reads it again; fused into one kernel, the intermediate never makes the round trip. On a Titan X the paper measured fused operators running 1.2–2× faster.

Each operator is first written as what to compute, then a schedule decides how: how to tile, which loop order, which cache level holds the data. The choices multiply quickly, so TVM measures candidate code on the target hardware and trains a cost model on those times to predict which version is faster.

limit.zh: 加速只在几种硬件和推理模型上测过，代价模型也得靠在目标硬件上实测来训练。
limit.en: Its speedups were measured on a few devices and inference models, and the cost model must still be trained by measuring on real hardware.

sources: Chen et al. · TVM, OSDI 2018, abstract, §§1–5, figure 2 and §6
Chen et al. · TVM: End-to-End Optimization Stack for Deep Learning, arXiv v1, 2018-02-12
Apache Software Foundation · Apache TVM becomes a Top-Level Project, 2020-11-30

title.zh: Triton · 按“块”写 GPU 内核
title.en: Triton · Writing GPU kernels in tiles

hook.zh: 程序员按“块”写计算，线程和内存的细节交给编译器。
hook.en: Programmers write computations on tiles and leave thread and memory details to the compiler.

body.zh: 常用的深度学习运算有 cuBLAS、cuDNN 这些厂商库撑着。想试库里没有的新运算，就得请专家手写内核，写完还难移植。2019 年，哈佛的研究者提出 Triton：程序员按“块”写计算，线程怎么分工、数据怎么搬，交给编译器，块多大由自动调优来挑。
body.en: Common deep learning operations were backed by vendor libraries such as cuBLAS and cuDNN. An operation the libraries lacked needed an expert to hand-write a kernel, which was then hard to port. In 2019, Harvard researchers presented Triton. Programmers write computations on tiles, small fixed-shape arrays; a compiler decides how threads share the work and how data moves, and auto-tuning picks the tile sizes.

detail.zh:
论文第一个例子是矩阵乘法：循环里每次取 A 的一块和 B 的一块，做一次点积，加到 C 的对应块上。块的长宽只写几个候选值，让自动调优去试；线程分配、显存访问合并、共享内存同步，都由编译器处理。

测试只用了一块 NVIDIA GTX 1070。矩阵乘法和 cuBLAS 打平，在循环网络和 Transformer 的矩阵形状上，比其他编译器方案最多快 3 倍；不过在较浅的 Transformer 形状上，cuBLAS 还是更快。
detail.en:
The paper's first example is matrix multiplication. The main loop loads a tile of A and a tile of B, takes a dot product, and adds it into a tile of C. Tile sizes are given as a few candidates for the auto-tuner to try. Thread assignment, memory coalescing, and shared-memory synchronization are left to the compiler.

The tests used one NVIDIA GTX 1070. Matrix multiplication matched cuBLAS and ran up to 3× faster than other compiler approaches on recurrent-network and Transformer shapes, though cuBLAS stayed faster on shallow Transformer shapes.

limit.zh: 写内核容易了，块大小、内存访问这些性能问题还在，只是交给了编译器。
limit.en: Kernels got easier to write, but tile size and memory access still matter; the compiler and auto-tuner now handle them.

sources: Tillet, Kung & Cox · Triton, MAPL 2019, §§1–2 and 5–7, Harvard author copy
triton-lang/triton · repository README (current), citing the MAPL 2019 paper as its foundation
PyTorch · PyTorch 2.0 release blog, 2023-03-15, TorchInductor and Triton

title.zh: 差分隐私 · 按一个人的影响加噪声
title.en: Differential privacy · Sizing noise to one person's influence

hook.zh: 换掉任何一个人，公布的结果都几乎不变。
hook.en: Swap out any one person, and the published answers barely change.

body.zh: 统计机构想公布汇总数字，又不想暴露某个人。只公布汇总也不保险：允许无限次提问、回答只带一点噪声，攻击者几乎能还原整个数据库。2006 年，Dwork 等人把隐私写成一个条件：换掉任何一行，回答的分布只能变一点点。按一行数据最多能改变结果多少来加噪声，就能做到。
body.en: A statistics office wants to publish totals without exposing anyone in them. Totals alone are not safe: if anyone can ask unlimited questions and answers carry only a little noise, an attacker can rebuild almost the whole database. In 2006 Dwork and colleagues turned privacy into a condition: replacing any one row may shift the distribution of answers only slightly. Adding noise scaled to the largest change one row can make in a result satisfies it.

detail.zh:
最简单的例子是计数：每人一行，取值 0 或 1，问一共有几个 1。换掉一个人，答案最多变 1，所以敏感度是 1；在真实答案上加一个尺度为 1/ε 的拉普拉斯噪声就够了。ε 越小，单个人越难被看出来，要加的噪声也越大。

论文把这个定义叫 ε-indistinguishability，后来通行的名字是差分隐私。美国人口普查局说，2020 年普查改用了基于差分隐私的保护框架。
detail.en:
The simplest case is a count. Each person is a row with value 0 or 1, and the query asks how many 1s there are. Replacing one person changes the answer by at most 1, so the sensitivity is 1, and adding Laplace noise of scale 1/ε is enough. A smaller ε hides each person better and needs more noise.

The paper called its definition ε-indistinguishability; the later standard name is differential privacy. The U.S. Census Bureau says it moved to a protection framework based on differential privacy for the 2020 Census.

limit.zh: 它管的是单个人的影响，挡不住统计结果揭示群体规律；问得越多，噪声也得越大。
limit.en: It limits one person's influence, not what statistics reveal about groups, and more questions demand more noise.

sources: Dwork, McSherry, Nissim & Smith · Calibrating Noise to Sensitivity in Private Data Analysis, TCC 2006, author copy, §§1–3
U.S. Census Bureau · Differential privacy and the 2020 Census, overview page with references

title.zh: 联邦学习 · 数据留在手机上，只传更新
title.en: Federated learning · Keeping the data on the phone

hook.zh: 训练数据不出手机，只把模型更新传回服务器。
hook.en: Training data stays on phones; only model updates travel back to the server.

body.zh: 手机上的数据能改进输入法和语音识别，可里面有你打过的字、拍过的照片，很私密，量也大，不适合全部上传。2016 年，Google 的 McMahan 等人提出联邦学习：数据留在设备上，每轮挑一批设备各自训练，只传回模型更新，服务器再加权平均。
body.en: Phones hold data that could improve keyboards and speech recognition, but it includes what people type and the photos they take: private, and large, a poor fit for uploading to a data center. In 2016, McMahan and colleagues at Google proposed federated learning. Data stays on the devices. Each round some devices train on their local data and send back only a model update, which the server averages, weighted by data size.

detail.zh:
论文拿《莎士比亚全集》做实验：每个说话的角色算一个客户端，共 1146 个，台词多少、内容都不一样。让客户端在本地多跑几轮再上传，和每轮只算一次梯度相比，达到同样准确率的通信轮数少了 95 倍。

上传的更新仍可能泄露东西。比如特征是稀疏词袋时，非零的梯度会直接暴露用户打过哪些词。要更强的保证，可以再叠加差分隐私或安全多方计算。
detail.en:
The paper built a test from the complete works of Shakespeare: each speaking role became a client, 1,146 in all, with very different amounts and kinds of text. When clients ran several local passes before uploading, the rounds of communication needed for the same accuracy fell 95-fold compared with computing one gradient per round.

Updates can still leak. With sparse bag-of-words features, the nonzero gradients show exactly which words a user typed. Stronger guarantees can be layered on with differential privacy or secure multiparty computation.

limit.zh: 原始数据不出设备，更新仍可能泄露信息；设备掉线这类部署问题，论文也没处理。
limit.en: Raw data stays put, but updates can still leak, and the paper set aside deployment problems like devices dropping out.

sources: McMahan et al. · Federated Learning of Deep Networks using Model Averaging, arXiv v1, 2016-02-17
McMahan et al. · Communication-Efficient Learning of Deep Networks from Decentralized Data, AISTATS 2017, PMLR 54
McMahan & Ramage · Federated Learning: Collaborative Machine Learning without Centralized Training Data, Google Research blog, 2017-04-06
Bonawitz et al. · Towards Federated Learning at Scale: System Design, arXiv v1, 2019-02-04, abstract

title.zh: 22 纳米三栅晶体管 · 把晶体管立起来
title.en: 22 nm Tri-Gate · Standing the transistor up

hook.zh: 电流通道竖成一道薄鳍，栅极从三面包住它。
hook.en: The channel becomes an upright fin that the gate wraps on three sides.

body.zh: 几十年来，晶体管都是平的，栅极只从上面控制电流。Intel 说，到 22 纳米再往小做越来越难。2011 年，它宣布要用三栅晶体管量产芯片：电流通道竖成一道薄鳍，栅极从两侧和顶上包住它。按 Intel 的数字，和自家 32 纳米相比，性能相同时功耗不到一半。
body.en: For decades transistors were flat, with the gate controlling current from the top only. Intel said shrinking them further had grown harder at the 22 nm generation. In 2011 it announced it would build chips in volume with Tri-Gate transistors: the channel becomes a thin vertical fin, and the gate wraps it on both sides and across the top. By Intel's figures, the new transistors needed less than half the power of its 32 nm ones at the same performance.

detail.zh:
可以把平面晶体管想成平铺在地上的水渠，闸门只从上面压下来；三栅晶体管把水渠竖成一道薄墙，闸门从左、右、上三面卡住。三面一起控制，导通时能过尽量多的电流，关断时尽量接近零，开关也更快。

低电压下，Intel 报告性能最多比自家 32 纳米提高 37%。宣布当天，它演示了代号 Ivy Bridge 的 22 纳米处理器；这批芯片 2012 年 4 月作为第三代酷睿上市。
detail.en:
Picture a planar transistor as a channel laid flat, with a gate pressing down from above. Tri-Gate stands the channel up as a thin wall and clamps it from left, right, and top. With control from three sides, as much current as possible flows when it is on, current comes as close to zero as possible when it is off, and switching is faster.

At low voltage, Intel reported up to 37% more performance than its own 32 nm transistors. It showed a 22 nm processor code-named Ivy Bridge on the day of the announcement, and the chips went on sale in April 2012 as the third-generation Core family.

limit.zh: 三栅改进的是栅极对电流的控制，芯片快不快，还取决于很多别的设计。
limit.en: Tri-Gate improves the gate's control over current; a chip's speed depends on much else.

sources: Intel · Intel Reinvents Transistors Using New 3-D Structure, press release, 2011-05-04
Intel · 3rd Generation Intel Core processors, launch press release, 2012-04-23
Samsung · EUV-based 7nm LPP production release, 2018-10-18, naming its earlier 10nm FinFET process

title.zh: EUV 光刻 · 用极紫外光印芯片
title.en: EUV lithography · Printing chips with 13.5 nm light

hook.zh: 改用 13.5 纳米的极紫外光，细线条一次就能印出来。
hook.en: Switching to 13.5 nm light let the finest lines print in a single exposure.

body.zh: 芯片上的图形用光刻制造。193 纳米 DUV 在一些精细图形上需要多重图形化，工序和成本随之增加。EUV 使用 13.5 纳米光，在合适的层和工艺中能减少这些步骤，不代表所有层都只需一次曝光。相关实验从 1980 年代开始；到 2019 年，采用 EUV 工艺的芯片进入商用产品。
body.en: Chip patterns are made by lithography. Fine features can require multiple patterning with 193 nm DUV, adding process steps and cost. EUV uses 13.5 nm light and can reduce those steps for suitable layers and processes; it does not mean every layer needs only one exposure. Experiments began in the 1980s, and chips made with EUV reached commercial products in 2019.

detail.zh:
难处在于，这种光几乎会被所有东西吸收。所以它得在高真空里产生和传播，也不能用透镜，只能靠多层膜反射镜把掩模上的图形缩小四倍，投到硅片上。光源是用激光两次打中飞过的小锡滴，把锡打成发出 EUV 的等离子体，每秒最多五万次。

EUV 也没有取代全部光刻。芯片上最复杂的几层用 EUV 印，其余各层仍用 DUV 光刻机。ASML 说，到 2021 年底，客户工厂里在用的新一代 EUV 机器有 127 台。
detail.en:
The hard part is that almost everything absorbs EUV light. It must be made and carried in a high vacuum, and lenses are out: multilayer mirrors shrink the mask pattern fourfold onto the wafer. To make the light, a laser hits a passing droplet of tin twice, turning it into a plasma that emits EUV, up to 50,000 times a second.

EUV did not replace all lithography. It prints the most intricate layers of a chip, while the rest still use DUV machines. By the end of 2021, ASML says, 127 of its latest-generation EUV machines were in use at customer sites.

limit.zh: 光有 EUV 还不够，芯片厂还得把掩模、光刻胶和设计工具一起调好。
limit.en: EUV alone was not enough; chipmakers also had to tune masks, photoresists, and design software around it.

sources: TSMC · N7+ is first EUV process delivering customer products in high volume, press release, 2019-10-07
Samsung · Starts production of EUV-based 7nm LPP process, press release, 2018-10-18
ASML · Making EUV: from lab to fab, company story, 2022-03-30
ASML · EUV lithography systems, product page (13.5 nm light, NXE, layer use)

title.zh: 信息论 · 给信息找到一把尺子
title.en: Information theory · putting a number on information

hook.zh: 信息用比特来量，每条有噪声的线路都有传输上限。
hook.en: Shannon measured information in bits and proved every noisy channel has a capacity.

body.zh: 1940 年代，没人说得清一条有噪声的线路能传多少信息。直觉上，想少出错只能多重复，越传越慢。Shannon 把信息量定义为做选择时的不确定性，叫熵，用比特计。他还证明，每条有噪声的信道都有容量 C：低于 C，编码得当，错误能任意少；高于 C，怎么编都不行。
body.en: In the 1940s there was no common yardstick for how much information a noisy line could carry. Intuition said fewer errors meant more repetition and a slower rate. Shannon defined information as the uncertainty in choosing one message from a set, called it entropy, and measured it in bits. He proved that every noisy channel has a capacity C: below that rate, good coding makes errors as rare as you like; above it, no coding can.

detail.zh:
Shannon 自己举过例子。每秒发 1000 个符号，两种符号各占一半，噪声让每 100 个错 1 个。直觉答案是每秒 990 比特，可接收方不知道错在哪里。按他的算法，实际只有 919 比特每秒。

容量定理只证明好编码存在，没给造法。后来的编码一点点逼近这个界限。1993 年的 Turbo 码论文，标题就叫“接近 Shannon 极限”；1996 年，冷落多年的 LDPC 码被重新发现，在模拟里几乎和 Turbo 码一样接近极限。
detail.en:
Shannon gave his own example. Send 1,000 symbols a second, both equally likely, and let noise corrupt one in a hundred. The tempting answer is 990 bits per second, but the receiver does not know which symbols are wrong. By Shannon's measure, the real rate is only 919 bits per second.

The capacity theorem shows good codes exist without saying how to build them. Later codes closed in on the limit. A 1993 paper presented turbo codes under the title “near Shannon limit”. In 1996, long-neglected LDPC codes were rediscovered and, in simulations, came almost as close to the limit as turbo codes.

limit.zh: 熵只管有多少种可能，不管内容真不真、有没有用；噪声变了，容量还得重算。
limit.en: Entropy counts possibilities, not whether a message is true or useful, and capacity must be recomputed when the noise changes.

sources: Shannon · A Mathematical Theory of Communication, Bell System Technical Journal, July and October 1948 (reprint with corrections), Introduction, §§6–7, 9, 12–14
Shannon · Prediction and Entropy of Printed English, Bell System Technical Journal, January 1951, §1
MacKay and Neal · Near Shannon Limit Performance of Low Density Parity Check Codes, 1996 preprint for Electronics Letters, abstract and results

title.zh: 随机逼近 · 带着噪声一步步找答案
title.en: Stochastic approximation · homing in through noisy trials

hook.zh: 每次结果都带随机性，照样能一点点调到目标。
hook.en: Even when every trial is noisy, small and shrinking adjustments still home in on the target.

body.zh: 有些实验只能一次次试。比如找让一半受试对象起反应的剂量，每次结果都带随机性，反应曲线长什么样也不知道。Robbins 和 Monro 的办法是：看上次的结果，把下次剂量往目标挪一点，步子逐次变小，比如 1/n。他们证明，在一定条件下，这样试下去，剂量会在概率意义下收敛到目标。
body.en: Some experiments can only be run one trial at a time. Say you want the dose at which half the subjects respond: each outcome is random, and the shape of the response curve is unknown. Robbins and Monro proposed a simple rule: use the last result to nudge the next dose toward the target, with steps that shrink over time, such as 1/n. They proved that, under certain conditions, the doses converge in probability to the target.

detail.zh:
拿半数反应剂量来说。第 n 次给剂量 x_n，有反应，下次就降 a_n/2；没反应，就升 a_n/2。步长要满足两条：a_n 的平方加起来有限，a_n 本身加起来是无穷大。1/n 两条都满足。

后来的随机梯度下降（SGD）面对同一类问题：每步只用一个随机样本估梯度，方向带噪声，步长条件也一样。Bottou 2010 年在文本分类上做过对比：达到同样的测试错误率，SGD 用 1.4 秒，SVMLight 用了 23,642 秒。
detail.en:
Take the half-response dose. On trial n, give dose x_n. A response lowers the next dose by a_n/2; no response raises it by a_n/2. The steps must meet two conditions: the squares of a_n have a finite sum, while the a_n themselves sum to infinity. The choice 1/n meets both.

Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) later faced the same kind of problem: each step estimates the gradient from one random example, so the direction is noisy, and the usual step-size conditions are the same. In Bottou's 2010 text-classification comparison, SGD reached the same test error in 1.4 seconds that SVMLight reached in 23,642 seconds.

limit.zh: 它保证最终会收敛，却不告诉你要试多少次才够。
limit.en: It guarantees eventual convergence but says nothing about how many trials are enough.

sources: Robbins and Monro · A Stochastic Approximation Method, Annals of Mathematical Statistics 22(3), September 1951, §§1–5
Bottou · Large-Scale Machine Learning with Stochastic Gradient Descent, 2010, author's PDF, §§2.2, 5 and Figure 1

title.zh: Metropolis 方法 · 按概率决定走不走
title.en: The Metropolis method · accepting moves by probability

hook.zh: 每次随机挪一个粒子：能量降了就接受，升了按概率接受。
hook.en: Move one particle at random, keep the move if energy falls, and sometimes if it rises.

body.zh: 从分子间作用力算压强，得对所有分子的位置积分。平面上几百个粒子，就是几百维的积分，网格法和随机撒点都不行。Metropolis 等五人改成每次随机挪一个粒子：能量降了就接受，升了按概率接受，否则退回原位。这样走下去，各构型的频率趋向正确的分布，直接平均即可。
body.en: Computing a substance's pressure from molecular forces means integrating over every molecule's position. A few hundred particles in a plane give an integral over hundreds of dimensions, hopeless on a grid, and random sampling fails too. Metropolis and four coauthors instead moved one particle at random: accept the move if the energy falls; if it rises, accept it with a certain probability, or else put the particle back. Configuration frequencies then approach the correct distribution, so plain averages give the answer.

detail.zh:
接受规则可以拿数感受一下。能量升高 1 个 kT，接受的概率约 37%。升高 3 个 kT，只有约 5%。所以系统多半往低处走，偶尔也爬坡。被拒绝的移动也要计数，把原构型再记一次，否则有些状态会被算少。

1983 年，Kirkpatrick、Gelatt 和 Vecchi 把这套规则搬到优化上：用成本代替能量，先在高温下“熔化”，再慢慢降温，叫模拟退火。只接受改进的搜索容易困在局部最优，Metropolis 规则允许有控制地往上走几步。
detail.en:
A few numbers make the rule concrete. A move that raises the energy by one kT is accepted about 37% of the time. Raise it by three kT, and the chance is about 5%. So the system mostly drifts downhill but sometimes climbs. A rejected move still counts: the old configuration is recorded again, or some states would be underweighted.

In 1983 Kirkpatrick, Gelatt, and Vecchi carried the rule over to optimization. A cost function replaces energy, and the system is first “melted” at high temperature, then cooled slowly: simulated annealing. A search that accepts only improvements gets stuck in local optima; the Metropolis rule allows controlled uphill steps.

limit.zh: 它能证明最终会趋向正确的分布，却说不出要走多久。
limit.en: It proves the process tends toward the right distribution, but not how long that takes.

sources: Metropolis, Rosenbluth, Rosenbluth, Teller and Teller · Equation of State Calculations by Fast Computing Machines, Journal of Chemical Physics 21(6), June 1953, §§I–IV, VI
Kirkpatrick, Gelatt and Vecchi · Optimization by Simulated Annealing, Science 220, 13 May 1983, introduction and statistical-mechanics section

title.zh: 动态规划 · 把多步决策拆开算
title.en: Dynamic programming · breaking long decisions into steps

hook.zh: 不用排好整串决策，只要知道每个状态下该怎么做。
hook.en: Instead of planning every decision in advance, find the best move for each state.

body.zh: 排产、进货、换设备，都要连着做很多步决策，每一步都会改变后面的局面。老办法是列出所有决策序列逐个算，阶段和选择稍多，有时连当时的计算机都吃不消。Bellman 只要一条规则，说清每个状态下该怎么做。他用最优性原理写出递推方程，把大问题拆成一步步的小问题。
body.en: Scheduling production, buying stock, or deciding when to replace machines takes many decisions in a row, each changing what comes next. The classical approach listed every possible sequence and scored each one; even moderate numbers of stages and choices could overwhelm the computers of the day. Bellman asked only for a rule saying what to do in each state. From his principle of optimality he wrote recursive equations that break a large problem into one step at a time.

detail.zh:
差别能数出来。10 个阶段、每步 10 种选择，完整的决策序列有 10¹⁰ 种。Bellman 只问：从眼下的状态出发、还剩 N 步，最好能拿多少？第一步走到新状态后，剩下的最好结果就是还剩 N−1 步的答案，所以只需比较第一步的几种选择。

后来的强化学习直接借了这套框架。Watkins 和 Dayan 1992 年的论文说，Q-learning 可以看作异步的动态规划：它不用事先知道奖励和状态转移概率，靠一次次尝试，逐步改进每个状态下每个动作的估值。
detail.en:
The difference can be counted. With 10 stages and 10 choices each, there are 10¹⁰ complete sequences. Bellman asks instead: starting from this state with N stages left, what is the best possible return? After the first decision, the best that can follow is the answer for N−1 stages from the new state, so only the first decision's options need comparing.

Reinforcement learning later borrowed the framework directly. Watkins and Dayan's 1992 paper describes Q-learning as a form of asynchronous dynamic programming: without knowing the rewards and transition probabilities in advance, it improves its estimate for each action in each state through repeated trials.

limit.zh: 每个可能的状态都要算出一个值；描述状态的变量一多，要算要存的东西也跟着变多。
limit.en: Every possible state needs its own value, so more state variables mean more to compute and store.

sources: Bellman · The Theory of Dynamic Programming, Bulletin of the AMS 60(6), November 1954, §§1–5, 7–8, 12 and bibliography
Watkins and Dayan · Q-learning, Machine Learning 8, 1992, abstract and §1

title.zh: FFT · 把大变换拆成小变换
title.en: The FFT · splitting one big transform into small ones

hook.zh: 拆成小变换，计算量从 N² 降到 N log N 量级。
hook.en: Splitting a big Fourier transform into small ones cuts N² work to order N log N.

body.zh: 直接算 N 点傅里叶级数要 N² 次运算，4096 个点就是 1600 多万次。Cooley 和 Tukey 沿用前人的思路：N 能分解成很多因子时，大变换能拆成一串小变换，运算量降到与 N log N 成正比。N 取 2 的幂时，还能在原数组里就地算完。
body.en: Computing an N-point Fourier series directly takes N² operations, so 4,096 points need more than 16 million. Cooley and Tukey built on earlier ideas: when N factors into many parts, one large transform splits into a chain of small ones, and the work drops to something proportional to N log N. When N is a power of 2, the computation even runs in place, with no extra storage.

detail.zh:
拿 N = 1024 算：直接计算约 105 万次，新方法不到 20,480 次。差了约五十倍，N 越大差得越多。代价是结果的顺序被打乱：第 j 个结果，落在把 j 的二进制位倒过来的位置上。

FFTW 的作者在 2005 年写道，这个常用的自由软件库主要用的仍是 Cooley–Tukey 算法，但难点换了地方：拆分带来跳跃的内存访问，会妨碍缓存。所以 FFTW 实际测量多种拆法的运行时间，挑最快的那个。
detail.en:
Try N = 1,024. Direct computation takes about 1.05 million operations; the new method needs fewer than 20,480. That is roughly fifty times fewer, and the gap widens as N grows. The price is scrambled output: result j lands at the position given by reversing the binary digits of j.

In a 2005 paper, the authors of FFTW wrote that their widely used free library still relies mainly on the Cooley–Tukey algorithm, but the hard part has moved: splitting causes scattered memory access that works against caches. So FFTW times many ways of splitting and picks the fastest.

limit.zh: N 是质数时这招帮不上忙；在今天的机器上，内存访问方式同样决定快慢。
