limit.en: It does not help when N is prime, and on today's machines memory access matters as much as arithmetic.

sources: Cooley and Tukey · An Algorithm for the Machine Calculation of Complex Fourier Series, Mathematics of Computation 19 (1965), pp. 297–301
Frigo and Johnson · The Design and Implementation of FFTW3, Proceedings of the IEEE 93(2), 2005, §§I–II

title.zh: Adam · 每个参数各自调步长
title.en: Adam · Giving each parameter its own step size

hook.zh: 给每个参数分别记梯度和梯度平方的平均，各自定步长。
hook.en: It tracks averages of each parameter's gradient and squared gradient to set that parameter's step.

body.zh: 普通 SGD 的参数共用一个学习率，但不同参数的梯度尺度和噪声可能差很多。Adam 分别记录梯度与梯度平方的指数滑动平均，做偏差修正后，用前者除以后者的平方根加上 ε，调整每个参数的更新尺度。它减轻了对梯度尺度的敏感性，但更新量并不总被学习率硬性限制。
body.en: Plain SGD uses a shared learning rate, while parameters can have very different gradient scales and noise. Adam tracks exponential moving averages of gradients and squared gradients. After bias correction, it divides the first estimate by the square root of the second plus ε to adapt each parameter's update. This reduces sensitivity to gradient scale, but the learning rate is not a hard cap on every update.

detail.zh:
设想两个参数，一个的梯度总在 1000 上下，另一个只有 0.001。学习率 0.001 的 SGD，前者每步挪 1，后者只挪百万分之一。用 Adam，梯度方向稳定时，两个参数每步都挪大约一个学习率。

后来的模型直接拿来用：2017 年的 Transformer 和 2018 年的 BERT 预训练，用的都是 Adam。
detail.en:
Picture two parameters, one with gradients around 1,000 and one around 0.001. SGD with a learning rate of 0.001 moves the first by 1 per step and the second by a millionth. Under Adam, when a gradient's direction is steady, both move by about one learning rate per step.

Later models simply adopted it: the 2017 Transformer and BERT's 2018 pretraining both used Adam.

limit.zh: 收敛证明只管凸问题，管不到神经网络；后来还有人找到让 Adam 收敛不到最优的凸问题。
limit.en: Its convergence proof covers only convex problems, and later work found a simple convex case where Adam misses the optimum.

sources: Adam · arXiv v9, 2017-01-30, ICLR 2015 conference version, Algorithm 1 defaults
Attention Is All You Need · arXiv v1, 2017-06-12, §5.3
Reddi, Kale and Kumar · On the Convergence of Adam and Beyond, ICLR 2018 (arXiv posting 2019), abstract and §1

title.zh: Penn Treebank · 程序先标，人再改
title.en: Penn Treebank · machines annotate, people correct

hook.zh: 让程序先标词性和句法，人只管纠错，标得又快又齐。
hook.en: Programs tagged first and people corrected, which made annotation faster and more consistent.

body.zh: 统计方法要从真实文本里学语言规律，得先有标好词性和句法的语料，可纯人工标又慢又难统一。Penn Treebank 让程序先标，标注员只负责纠错和拼接。到 1992 年 11 月，词性标注已达约 489 万词次。其中约 288 万词次，还标了简化的句法树。
body.en: Statistical methods that learn language from real text need corpora tagged for parts of speech and ideally syntax, but annotating entirely by hand was slow and hard to keep consistent. The Penn Treebank had programs annotate first: a tagger proposed parts of speech, a parser built partial structure, and annotators fixed errors and joined the pieces. By November 1992 it held about 4.89 million tagged tokens, about 2.88 million of them with simplified syntactic trees.

detail.zh:
论文做过对照实验：同样四位标注员，校对机器预标的文本，平均每千词 20 分钟；从头手标要 44 分钟。标注员之间的分歧率，校对是 4.1%，手标是 7.2%。

后来的句法分析研究常拿它当标准的训练和测试集。Collins 1997 年的分析器用树库的《华尔街日报》部分训练和测试。它的成分精确率是 88.1%，召回率 87.5%。
detail.en:
In a controlled comparison, four annotators corrected machine-tagged text at an average of 20 minutes per 1,000 words, against 44 minutes tagging from scratch. Disagreement between annotators was 4.1% when correcting and 7.2% when tagging by hand.

Later parsing research used it as a standard training and test set. Collins's 1997 parser, trained and tested on the treebank's Wall Street Journal portion, reached 88.1% constituent precision and 87.5% recall.

limit.zh: 它的句法只有骨架，名词短语内部基本不分析；材料也以美式英语为主。
limit.en: Its syntax is only a skeleton, with noun phrases mostly left unanalyzed, and the text is mainly American English.

sources: Marcus, Santorini and Marcinkiewicz · Building a Large Annotated Corpus of English: The Penn Treebank, Computational Linguistics 19(2), 1993, §§1–5 and Table 4
Collins · Three Generative, Lexicalised Models for Statistical Parsing, ACL 1997, abstract and §4
Zaremba, Sutskever and Vinyals · Recurrent Neural Network Regularization, arXiv v1, 2014-09-08, §4.1

title.zh: SQuAD · 答案必须从原文里摘
title.en: SQuAD · Answers taken straight from the passage

hook.zh: 十万多道人写的阅读题，答案都得是原文里的一段。
hook.en: Over 100,000 human-written questions, each answered by a span of the passage.

body.zh: 此前的阅读理解数据，要么质量高但只有几千道题，要么有上百万题，却是挖空实体自动生成的。SQuAD 请众包工作者就维基百科文章写了 107,785 个问题，答案必须是原文里的一段。题目由人写，评分却能自动完成。基线模型 F1 是 51.0%，人类是 86.8%。
body.en: Before 2016, reading comprehension datasets were either high quality with only a few thousand questions, or had over a million questions generated automatically by blanking out entities. SQuAD had crowdworkers write 107,785 questions on Wikipedia articles, and every answer had to be a span of the passage. People wrote the questions, yet scoring stayed automatic. The paper's baseline reached 51.0% F1, against 86.8% for humans.

detail.zh:
论文第一个例子讲降水。问“什么让降水落下”，答案是 gravity：要先找到 falls under gravity 那句，再明白 under 在这里表示原因，不表示位置。为了不让题目照抄原文，网页禁用了复制粘贴，提醒工作者用自己的话问。

两年后，BERT 的集成模型超过了排行榜上的人类成绩，但这要打折扣。2017 年，Jia 和 Liang 在段落里自动插入一句话，不改答案，也不会误导人，却能干扰模型。已发表模型的平均 F1 从 75% 跌到 36%。
detail.en:
The paper's first example is about precipitation. Asked what causes precipitation to fall, the answer is “gravity”: a system must find the sentence saying it falls under gravity and see that “under” marks a cause, not a location. To keep workers from copying the passage, the interface disabled copy and paste and asked them to use their own words.

Two years later a BERT ensemble passed the leaderboard's human score, but that needs qualification. In 2017 Jia and Liang automatically inserted a sentence that left the answer unchanged and would not mislead people but distracted models. The average F1 of published models dropped from 75% to 36%.

limit.zh: 每道题在原文里都有答案，模型只管挑最像的一段，从不用判断“原文没说”。
limit.en: Every question has an answer in the passage, so a model never has to decide that the text does not say.

sources: Jia and Liang · Adversarial Examples for Evaluating Reading Comprehension Systems, arXiv v1, 2017-07-23, abstract
Rajpurkar, Jia and Liang · Know What You Don't Know: Unanswerable Questions for SQuAD, arXiv v1, 2018-06-11, abstract

title.zh: GLUE · 用一个总分考九项任务
title.en: GLUE · Scoring nine tasks with one number

hook.zh: 把九个语言理解任务放在一起考，取平均当总分。
hook.en: It tests models on nine language tasks and ranks them by the average.

body.zh: 到 2018 年，语言理解模型大多只为一个任务设计，换个领域就吃力。GLUE 收集了九个任务，有语法、情感、复述、蕴含等，训练数据从 706 条到 40 万条不等。测试集标签不公开，在网站上统一打分取平均。有的任务数据很少，能在任务间共享知识的方法就占便宜。
body.en: By 2018, most language understanding models were built for one task and struggled with text from other domains. GLUE gathered nine existing tasks, including grammaticality, sentiment, paraphrase, and entailment, with training sets from 706 to 400,000 examples. Test labels stay private; systems are scored on a website and ranked by their average. Some tasks have very little data, which rewards methods that share knowledge across tasks.

detail.zh:
初版论文的基线里，最高平均分是 60.3，来自 BiLSTM 加 ELMo。总分也掩盖了差别：CoLA 上不少基线接近 0，SST-2 上却都在 80 以上。

分数涨得比预想快。BERT 初版报告 GLUE 80.4 分，比此前最好成绩高 7.6。到 2019 年 5 月，最高分离作者估计的人类水平只差 3.3，部分相同的作者推出了更难的 SuperGLUE。
detail.en:
Among the first version's baselines, the best average was 60.3, from a BiLSTM with ELMo. The average also hid large differences: many baselines scored near 0 on CoLA but above 80 on SST-2.

Scores rose faster than expected. The first BERT paper reported 80.4 on GLUE, 7.6 points above the previous best. By May 2019 the top score was only 3.3 points below the authors' estimate of human performance, and some of the same authors introduced the harder SuperGLUE.

limit.zh: 有些任务可能靠表面技巧就能解掉；总分只是简单平均，不代表各种能力都一样好。
limit.en: Some tasks might yield to superficial tricks, and a plain average does not mean every ability is equally strong.

sources: GLUE · arXiv v3, 2019-02-22 (ICLR 2019), footnote on the updated QNLI

title.zh: LAION-5B · 公开 58.5 亿对网络图文
title.en: LAION-5B · Releasing 5.85 billion web image–text pairs

hook.zh: 大厂的图文数据不公开，它一口气公开了 58.5 亿对。
hook.en: Big labs kept their image–text data private; LAION-5B released 5.85 billion pairs.

body.zh: CLIP 用 4 亿对图文训练，数据没公开；在 LAION 自己 2021 年放出 4 亿对的 LAION-400M 之前，公开的英文图文数据集最大约 1 亿对。大规模图文研究于是集中在少数几家公司。LAION-5B 从网页里挑出带 alt 文本的图片，按 CLIP 算的图文相似度筛选，公开了 58.5 亿对，图片要使用者自己下载。
body.en: CLIP was trained on 400 million image–text pairs that were never released, and before LAION's own 400-million-pair LAION-400M (2021), the largest public English image–text dataset had about 100 million. Research on large image–text models had pooled in a few companies. LAION-5B took images with alt text from web pages, filtered them by CLIP similarity between image and text, and released 5.85 billion pairs. Users download the images themselves.

detail.zh:
一对图文要过几关：从 Common Crawl 里找带 alt 文本的图片，下载，去掉文字太短或图片太小的，再用 CLIP 算相似度，低于门槛的删掉。最后这关删掉了约 500 亿张图片里的九成左右。因为只给链接，网页一变，图片就可能失效。

论文用其中 4 亿对的子集训练 CLIP，在 ImageNet 零样本分类等测试上，和 OpenAI 的原版持平或接近。论文还写道，Stable Diffusion 就是用它的几个子集训练的。
detail.en:
A pair had to pass several checks: find images with alt text in Common Crawl, download them, drop pairs with too little text or too small an image, then score image–text similarity with CLIP and delete pairs below a threshold. That last check removed about 90% of the roughly 50 billion original images. Because only links are given, images can vanish when pages change.

The paper trained CLIP on a 400-million-pair subset and matched or came close to OpenAI's original models on tests such as zero-shot ImageNet classification. It also reports that Stable Diffusion was trained on several of its subsets.

limit.zh: 自动过滤挡不住所有有害图片，后来还被查出含有指向疑似儿童性虐待材料的链接。
limit.en: Automatic filtering could not catch all harmful images, and links to suspected child sexual abuse material were later found in it.

sources: LAION-5B · arXiv v1, 2022-10-16, §§1, 3, 5–7 and Appendix A

title.zh: 磁芯存储 · 用磁化方向存一位
title.en: Magnetic-core memory · storing bits as magnetization

hook.zh: 磁芯靠磁化方向存一位，比静电存储管快，也好伺候。
hook.en: Whirlwind traded fussy storage tubes for magnetic cores and got faster, easier-to-maintain memory.

body.zh: 1950 年代初，MIT 的 Whirlwind I 用静电存储管当内存，管子很难伺候，毛病反复出现。磁芯存储用小磁芯的磁化方向存一位，横竖导线按坐标选中它。1953 年 8 月和 9 月先后换上两组磁芯，存取时间从约 25 微秒降到 9 微秒，维护时间也少了。
body.en: In the early 1950s, MIT's Whirlwind I used electrostatic storage tubes as its fast memory, and they kept failing. Magnetic-core storage held each bit as the direction of magnetization in a small core, with wires in two directions picking out the one to read or write. After two banks of cores went in during August and September 1953, access time fell from about 25 microseconds to 9, and maintenance took less time.

detail.zh:
按坐标选中靠的是“半电流”。Forrester 的专利里，每根导线只通翻转所需电流的一半。只在一根通电导线上的磁芯，电流不够，不会翻转；横竖两根导线交叉处的那一个收到两份，才会翻转。

代价是读出会毁掉内容：读一个磁芯要把它翻转，原来的信息不另存就丢了。Whirlwind 的办法是读完马上写回去。写回产生的瞬态电流会干扰读出放大器，于是又设计了恢复更快的放大器。
detail.en:
Coordinate selection relied on half currents. In Forrester's patent, each wire carries half the current needed to switch a core. A core on only one energized wire does not change state; only the core where the energized horizontal and vertical wires cross gets both halves and switches.

The price was that reading destroyed the contents: reading a core flips it, so the information is lost unless it is saved elsewhere. Whirlwind simply wrote the data back after every read. Transients from the rewrite disturbed the sense amplifiers, so a faster-recovering amplifier was designed.

limit.zh: 读出后必须重写的麻烦还在，读写电路的干扰也得靠改进放大器来对付。
limit.en: Every read still had to be followed by a rewrite, and circuit interference needed better amplifiers.

sources: Project Whirlwind Summary Report No. 35, third quarter 1953, §§1, 3.1, 3.3 (bitsavers scan)
Project Whirlwind Summary Report No. 37, first quarter 1954, introduction and §3.1 (bitsavers scan)
An Wang · US Patent 2,708,722, filed 1949-10-21, granted 1955-05-17
Amdahl, Blaauw & Brooks · Architecture of the IBM System/360, April 1964, p. 96 and Figure 1
Liptay · System/360 Model 85 cache, IBM Systems Journal 7(1), 1968, pp. 15–16

title.zh: RAMAC 磁盘 · 直接找到任意一条记录
title.en: RAMAC disk · reaching any record directly

hook.zh: 不用先给卡片排序，交易来一笔就能记一笔。
hook.en: No sorting cards first: each transaction could be posted as soon as it arrived.

body.zh: 穿孔卡片记账，要先人工分拣，再成批过机器，一个库存例子要过七台机器。难的是在大文件里直接改动单独一条记录。IBM 350 磁盘把 50 张金属盘叠在一根竖轴上，存取臂能移到任意一张盘的任意一道磁道。500 万个字符分成 5 万条记录，哪一条都能直接取出。
body.en: Punched-card accounting meant sorting cards by hand and running them through machines in batches; in one IBM inventory example, the cards passed through seven machines. Reaching and changing a single record in a large file was the hard part. The IBM 350 disk stacked 50 metal disks on a vertical shaft, with an access arm that could move to any track on any disk. Its five million characters were organized as 50,000 records, any of which could be fetched directly.

detail.zh: 手册按每次读盘约 600 毫秒估时。平均每张发票三项商品，一小时能处理约 450 张，相关记录同时更新。操作员还能在控制台用键盘查任一账户，几乎马上拿到当前余额。
detail.en: IBM's manual estimated about 600 milliseconds per disk read. With three items per invoice on average, the machine handled about 450 invoices an hour while updating every related record. An operator could also query any account from the console keyboard and get its current balance almost at once.

limit.zh: 找记录变成了机械寻道，还是得等：手册估约 600 毫秒，工程师回忆实际约 800 毫秒。
limit.en: Seeking was still mechanical: the manual planned on about 600 milliseconds, and an engineer recalled about 800 in practice.

sources: IBM 305 RAMAC Manual of Operation, Form 22-6264-1, April 1957, pp. 5–13 and 59 (bitsavers scan), p. 18
IEEE Milestone · RAMAC, 1956 (ETHW record: dates and capacity)
IBM History · RAMAC (IBM's account, access-time recollection)

title.zh: System/360 · 大小机器跑同一套程序
title.en: System/360 · the same programs on every model

hook.zh: 六个型号性能差约 50 倍，指令集却完全一样。
hook.en: Six models spanning a fiftyfold performance range shared one instruction set.

body.zh: IBM 原有五条产品线，字长和十进制运算方式各不相同。1964 年的 System/360 把程序员看到的机器和具体实现分开：六个型号性能差约 50 倍，指令集却严格一致。内存和外设够用时，按手册写的程序大小型号都能跑。一个家族取代了原来五条产品线。
body.en: IBM had five product lines that differed in word length and decimal arithmetic. System/360, announced in 1964, separated the machine programmers see from how each model was built. Its six models spanned about a fiftyfold performance range, yet shared one strictly defined instruction set. Given enough storage and devices, a program written to the manual ran on small and large models alike, and this one family replaced all five lines.

detail.zh:
型号之间差多少？最小的 Model 30 每次从主存取 8 位，周期 2.0 微秒。最大的 Model 70 每次取 64 位，周期 1.0 微秒。16 个通用寄存器在 Model 30 上就放在主存里，程序员看到的却始终是同一组。

字符为什么用 8 位，不用 6 位？商业记录里数字出现的次数，是带字母数据的两倍多。一个十进制数字只占 4 位，存储、磁带和磁盘都更省。
detail.en:
How different were the models? The smallest, the Model 30, fetched 8 bits at a time from main storage with a 2.0-microsecond cycle. The largest, the Model 70, fetched 64 bits with a 1.0-microsecond cycle. On the Model 30 the sixteen general registers even sat in main storage, yet programmers always saw the same set.

Why 8-bit characters rather than 6? Numbers appear in business records more than twice as often as alphanumeric data, and packing each decimal digit into 4 bits makes better use of storage, tapes, and disks.

limit.zh: 它只保证合乎手册、不依赖执行时间的程序；IBM 旧机器上的程序不在保证之内。
limit.en: It guaranteed results only for valid programs that did not depend on timing; programs for IBM's older machines were not covered.

sources: Amdahl, Blaauw & Brooks · Architecture of the IBM System/360, IBM J. Res. Dev. 8(2), April 1964, pp. 87–96 and Figure 1 (course-hosted scan)
Same paper · IEEE Xplore record, pp. 87–101
IBM History · System/360 (launch date, product lines, IBM's account)
Liptay · System/360 Model 85 cache, IBM Systems Journal 7(1), 1968, p. 15

title.zh: Moore 1965 · 最省钱的元件数年年翻倍
title.en: Moore, 1965 · cheapest component count doubles yearly

hook.zh: 每块电路最省钱的元件数，大约每年翻一倍。
hook.en: The cheapest number of components per circuit was doubling about every year.

body.zh: 1965 年，集成电路刚用进商用计算机。一块电路里元件放得越多，每个越便宜；放太多，成品率下降，成本又回升，所以总有一个最省钱的数。Moore 指出，这个数大约每年翻一倍：当时约 50 个，到 1975 年会达到 65,000 个。他还预言了家用计算机。
body.en: In 1965, integrated circuits were just entering commercial computers. More components on one circuit spread the cost, but too many lowered yields and pushed the cost per component back up, so there was always a cheapest number. Gordon Moore observed that this number was roughly doubling every year: about 50 components then, and an expected 65,000 by 1975. He also predicted home computers.

detail.zh: 65,000 个元件放得下吗？Moore 算了笔账：按当时的公差，晶体管可以每隔千分之二英寸放一个，一英寸 500 个，一平方英寸 25 万个。65,000 个只占约四分之一平方英寸，用现有的光学工艺就够。这里的“元件”也包括电阻和二极管。
detail.en: Would 65,000 components fit? Moore did the arithmetic. With existing tolerances, transistors could sit two thousandths of an inch apart: 500 per linear inch, a quarter million per square inch. So 65,000 components would need only about a quarter of a square inch, and existing optical techniques were enough. Components here include resistors and diodes as well as transistors.

limit.zh: 这是拿几年数据做的外推，Moore 自己也说，长期走势有点不确定。
limit.en: It was an extrapolation from a few years of data, and Moore called the longer term a bit uncertain.

sources: Moore · Cramming more components onto integrated circuits, Electronics, 1965-04-19; Proc. IEEE 86(1) reprint, 1998
Same reprint · full text, course-hosted copy, pp. 82–85

title.zh: PUE · 看电有多少到了 IT 设备
title.en: PUE · measuring how much power reaches IT equipment

hook.zh: 机房总耗电除以 IT 设备耗电，越接近 1 越省。
hook.en: PUE divides total facility energy by IT energy, and values near 1.0 mean little overhead.

body.zh: 机房的电不全给服务器、存储和网络设备，配电损耗和冷却也在耗电。2007 年，行业联盟 The Green Grid 发布 PUE：机房总能耗除以 IT 设备能耗。它最小是 1.0，越接近 1.0，设施本身多耗的电越少。
body.en: A datacenter's electricity does not all go to servers, storage, and network equipment; power distribution losses and cooling draw from it too. In 2007 the industry consortium The Green Grid published PUE: total facility energy divided by IT equipment energy. PUE cannot go below 1.0, and the closer it gets, the less extra energy the facility itself uses.

detail.zh:
举个算例：一座机房一年从电网取电 1,500 万千瓦时，其中 1,000 万送到了 IT 设备。它的 PUE 就是 1.5。伯克利国家实验室测过 22 座机房。它们的 PUE 在 1.3 到 3.0 之间。

数字要看口径。Google 报告整个机队 2025 年的平均 PUE 是 1.09，并说把变电站、变压器这些开销都算了进去；这是 Google 自己的测量。
detail.en:
A worked example: a facility draws 15 million kWh from the grid in a year, and 10 million kWh reaches the IT equipment. Its PUE is 1.5. Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory measured 22 datacenters, with PUE between 1.3 and 3.0.

The boundary of the measurement matters. Google reports a fleet-wide average PUE of 1.09 for 2025 and says it counts overhead such as substations and transformers; these are Google's own measurements.

limit.zh: PUE 只管设施，不管计算：服务器空转耗的电，照样算进 IT 能耗。
limit.en: PUE describes the facility, not the computing: energy burned by idle servers still counts as IT energy.

sources: The Green Grid · White Paper #49, PUE: A Comprehensive Examination of the Metric, 2012, executive summary, §§I–II, 4, 4.10, 6.6 (LBNL-hosted copy)
Google Data Centers · Efficiency: fleet PUE and measurement notes (Google's own reporting)

title.zh: Fat-tree · 用普通交换机搭满速网络
title.en: Fat-tree · Building full-speed networks from commodity switches

hook.zh: 用许多一样的普通交换机，让上万台主机都能全速互通。
hook.en: Many identical commodity switches let tens of thousands of hosts talk at full speed.

body.zh: 2008 年前后，机房网络多是交换机树，越往上越贵，带宽卡在树根。为了省钱，上层带宽常不够分，最坏时千兆网卡只能跑 125 Mbps。Al-Fares 等人改用许多同样的普通交换机连成 fat-tree，48 口交换机就能让 27,648 台主机全速互通。
body.en: Around 2008, datacenter networks were usually trees of switches, pricier toward the top, with bandwidth capped at the root. To save money, upper tiers were often oversubscribed; in the worst case a gigabit host got only 125 Mbps. Al-Fares and colleagues wired many identical commodity Ethernet switches into a fat-tree instead. With 48-port switches, 27,648 hosts could all talk to each other at full speed.

detail.zh:
所有交换机都一样，所以都能用便宜的通用产品。论文估算，这套网络的交换设备约 864 万美元；用高端交换机给 2 万台主机做到满带宽，约需 3,700 万美元。

难处在于用上这么多条路。普通路由只挑一条，流量会挤到少数核心交换机上。论文让交换机按目的地址分散流量，同一台主机的包始终走同一条路。16 台主机的模拟里，随机通信能达到理想带宽的 75%，超额订阅 3.6:1 的传统树只有 53.4%。
detail.en:
Because every switch is the same, all of them can be cheap commodity parts. The paper estimates the switching hardware at $8.64 million, against about $37 million to give 20,000 hosts full bandwidth with high-end switches.

The hard part is using all those paths. Ordinary routing picks just one, so traffic piles onto a few core switches. The paper spreads traffic by destination address while keeping each host's packets on one path. In a 16-host emulation under random traffic, this reached 75% of the ideal bandwidth, against 53.4% for a conventional tree oversubscribed 3.6:1.

limit.zh: 实验只模拟了 16 台主机，大规模的成本是估算的，还没算上多得多的线缆。
limit.en: The experiment emulated only 16 hosts, and the large-scale costs were estimates that left out the far greater cabling.

sources: Al-Fares, Loukissas & Vahdat · A Scalable, Commodity Data Center Network Architecture, SIGCOMM 2008, §§1–3, 5–6 (author copy)
Same paper · ACM Digital Library record
Singh et al. · Jupiter Rising, SIGCOMM 2015, abstract, §§1–3.2 and Table 2

title.zh: NVLink · GPU 之间不再挤 PCIe
title.en: NVLink · Moving GPU traffic off PCIe

hook.zh: GPU 之间有了专用通道，不必都挤在 PCIe 上。
hook.en: GPUs got a dedicated link to each other instead of all sharing PCIe.

body.zh: 到 2016 年，一台服务器装 4 块或 8 块 GPU 已很常见。GPU 之间交换数据全走 PCIe，NVIDIA 说这越来越成瓶颈。它随 P100 推出 NVLink，称带宽是 PCIe 3.0 x16 的 5 倍。相连的 GPU 能直接读写对方显存。
body.en: By 2016, servers with four or eight GPUs were common. Data moving between GPUs went over PCIe, which NVIDIA described as a growing bottleneck. With the Tesla P100, NVIDIA introduced NVLink, which it called five times the bandwidth of PCIe 3.0 x16. GPUs linked this way can also read and write each other's memory directly.

detail.zh:
P100 只有 4 条链路，连不满 7 个邻居，所以 8 卡的 DGX-1 分成两组：每组 4 块 GPU 两两直连，两组之间再加 NVLink。GPU 之间的流量全走 NVLink，PCIe 就空出来接网卡、访问主机内存。

后来几代沿用这条路。Volta V100 换上第二代 NVLink，链路增到 6 条，总带宽 300 GB/s。2022 年的 Hopper 是第四代，NVIDIA 称 DGX H100 里每块 GPU 有 900 GB/s 带宽。
detail.en:
The P100's four links cannot reach seven neighbors, so the eight-GPU DGX-1 split its GPUs into two groups of four, each fully connected by NVLink, with extra NVLink connections between the groups. All GPU-to-GPU traffic went over NVLink, leaving PCIe free for network cards and host memory.

Later generations continued the line. Volta V100 brought second-generation NVLink, with six links and 300 GB/s in total. For Hopper, in 2022, NVIDIA cited 900 GB/s of NVLink bandwidth per GPU in DGX H100.

limit.zh: 它只连 NVIDIA 的 GPU 和支持它的 CPU，机器之间还得靠别的网络。
limit.en: NVLink connects only NVIDIA GPUs and supporting CPUs; machines still needed other networks between them.

sources: NVIDIA Tesla P100 whitepaper WP-08019-001_v01.1, 2016, pp. 7–8, 20–24, 35–36
NVIDIA V100 whitepaper v1.1, August 2017, p. 19 on second-generation NVLink

title.zh: TPU v1 · 为推理专门造一颗芯片
title.en: TPU v1 · A custom chip built for inference

hook.zh: 语音识别可能让数据中心翻倍，Google 自己做了推理芯片。
hook.en: Facing a projected doubling of datacenter compute, Google built its own chip for inference.

body.zh: 2013 年，Google 估算：如果每人每天用三分钟语音搜索，数据中心就得翻倍，用普通 CPU 太贵。团队用 15 个月做出一颗专做推理的芯片，2015 年起投入使用。在 Google 六个生产应用上，它平均比同期 CPU 和 GPU 快 15–30 倍。
body.en: In 2013 Google projected that if people used voice search for three minutes a day, its datacenters would need double the computation, which would be very expensive with ordinary CPUs. A team built an inference-only chip in 15 months, running in datacenters from 2015. On six of Google's production applications, it was on average 15 to 30 times faster than a contemporary CPU and GPU.

detail.zh:
关键约束是响应时间：一个应用要求 99% 的请求在 7 毫秒内返回。在这条线内，TPU 能跑到自身最高吞吐的 80%。CPU 和 K80 只能开小批量，分别只有 42% 和 37%。

瓶颈常在内存，不在算力。六个应用里，两个 MLP 和两个 LSTM 受内存带宽限制，只有两个 CNN 受算力限制。作者估计，换上 K80 那样的 GDDR5 显存，TPU 还能再快两到三倍。
detail.en:
The binding constraint was response time: one application had to answer 99% of requests within 7 milliseconds. Within that limit the TPU reached 80% of its maximum throughput. The CPU and K80 had to run small batches and reached only 42% and 37%.

The bottleneck was often memory, not arithmetic. Of the six applications, the two MLPs and two LSTMs were limited by memory bandwidth and only the two CNNs by compute. The authors estimated that GDDR5 memory like the K80's would make the TPU two to three times faster.

limit.zh: 比的是 2015 年的同代芯片，倍数不能推到后来；训练也还得用现成的 GPU。
limit.en: It was compared with 2015-era chips, so the ratios do not carry over to later hardware, and training still ran on GPUs.

sources: Jouppi et al. · In-Datacenter Performance Analysis of a Tensor Processing Unit, arXiv v1, 2017-04-16, §§1–8 and 10
Jouppi et al. · Ten Lessons From Three Generations Shaped Google's TPUv4i, ISCA 2021, Table 1
Jouppi et al. · Google's Training Supercomputers from TPU v2 to Ironwood, arXiv v1, 2026-06-14, introduction

title.zh: TPU v3 液冷 · 更密集的芯片，换一种散热方式
title.en: TPU v3 liquid cooling · A different way to cool denser chips

hook.zh: 每颗芯片 450 W，Google 为这代 TPU 改用液冷。
hook.en: At 450 W per chip, TPU v3 moved Google from fans to liquid cooling.

body.zh: Google 前两代 TPU 都用风冷，v2 每颗的热设计功耗是 280 W。2018 年的 TPU v3 升到每颗 450 W，改用了液冷：铜冷板压在芯片封装上，冷却液流过冷板，把热量带走。按 Google 后来的说法，这让部署的芯片密度翻了一倍。
body.en: Google's first two TPU generations were air-cooled; v2 had a thermal design power of 280 W per chip. TPU v3, in 2018, rose to 450 W, and Google switched to liquid cooling: copper cold plates sit on the chip packages, and coolant flowing through them carries the heat away. According to Google's later accounts, this doubled the density of deployed chips.

detail.zh:
液冷先改变的是机房布局：TPU 要集中放在几个相邻机柜里，才能分摊冷却设施的成本。训练用的超级计算机本来就这样摆；推理要靠近各地用户，有些机房已经塞满。所以 2020 年的推理芯片 TPUv4i 把热设计功耗压到 175 W，回到风冷。

泵比风扇省电得多：每颗液冷 TPU v3 分摊的泵功率，不到同等热设计功耗下风冷所需风扇功率的 5%。从 TPU v3 起，Google 的训练系统只用液冷。
detail.en:
Liquid cooling changed facility layout first: the TPUs had to sit in several adjacent racks to share the cost of the cooling equipment. Training supercomputers already looked like that. Inference needs to be near users worldwide, and some datacenters were too full. So TPUv4i, the 2020 inference chip, held its thermal design power to 175 W and went back to air cooling.

Pumps used far less power than fans. Pump power per liquid-cooled TPU v3 was less than 5% of the fan power air cooling would need at a comparable thermal design power. Since TPU v3, Google's training systems have used liquid cooling only.

limit.zh: 热照样得排出机房，代价是机柜要成组摆放，还要配水路和备用电源。
limit.en: The heat still has to leave the building, and the price is grouped racks, plumbing, and backup power for cooling.

sources: Google · 100 things we announced at I/O '18, 2018-05-10, item 19
Jouppi et al. · Ten Lessons From Three Generations Shaped Google's TPUv4i, ISCA 2021, Table 1 and lesson 5
Padilla & Iyengar (Google) · Evolution of Google's IT Liquid Cooling, Hot Chips 2025 tutorial, slides 4–10

title.zh: Heuristic DENDRAL · 把看谱经验写进程序
title.en: Heuristic DENDRAL · putting chemists' rules into the program

hook.zh: 先按谱峰排除不可能的结构，再拿预测谱和实测谱比对。
hook.en: It used spectral peaks to rule out structures, then ranked the rest against the measured spectrum.

body.zh: 化学家要从质谱图倒推出分子结构。原来的 DENDRAL 算法能列全所有无环结构，但只按原子价拼图，不看实测数据。Heuristic DENDRAL 把看谱的经验写进程序：先按特征峰定下该有、不该有的片段，只生成合格结构；再预测每个候选的谱图，和实测谱比对排序。
body.en: A chemist holding a mass spectrum wants to work back to the structure of an unknown compound. The earlier DENDRAL algorithm could list every possible acyclic structure for a formula, but it knew only valences and ignored measured data. Heuristic DENDRAL built chemists' rules into the program: characteristic peaks decided which fragments must or must not appear, only fitting structures were generated, and a rough model predicted each candidate's spectrum for ranking against the real one.

detail.zh:
论文的例子是 3-辛酮。光按原子价能连出 790 种图，化学上稳定的无环结构有 698 种。程序看谱峰判断它是乙基酮，把醇、醚、醛和其他几种酮放进“不能有”的清单。最后只生成 3 个结构，正确的那个就在其中。

1984 年回顾时，Buchanan 和 Shortliffe 写道，MYCIN 借用了 DENDRAL 的经验，头一条就是产生式规则好用，也就是“如果……那么……”式的规则。
detail.en:
The paper's example is 3-octanone. Valences alone allow 790 graphs, and 698 acyclic structures are chemically stable. Reading the peaks, the program concluded it was an ethyl ketone and put alcohols, ethers, aldehydes, and other ketones on its must-not list. It then generated just three structures, and the correct one was among them.

Looking back in 1984, Buchanan and Shortliffe wrote that MYCIN grew out of DENDRAL by reusing its lessons, foremost the power of production rules, the if-then kind.

limit.zh: 它只在少数几类分子上接近化学家，碰到环状结构就吃力，常给出好几个候选。
limit.en: It neared a chemist's skill only for a few classes of molecules, struggled with rings, and often returned several candidates.

sources: Buchanan, Sutherland & Feigenbaum · Heuristic DENDRAL, Machine Intelligence 4 (Edinburgh University Press, 1969), pp. 209–254 · scan in the NLM Joshua Lederberg Papers, introduction and §§1, 3.5, 6
NLM catalog record for the same paper
Buchanan & Shortliffe (eds.) · Rule-Based Expert Systems, 1984, chapter 1 (author-hosted)

title.zh: Shakey · 给它目标，它自己排步骤
title.en: Shakey · a robot that plans its own steps

hook.zh: 操作员只说目标，它自己看路、排计划、推箱子。
hook.en: An operator names the goal; the robot looks, plans, and pushes the boxes itself.

body.zh: 1966 年 SRI 立项时，自动机大多靠几块简单的板载电路控制。SRI 想用大型计算机通过无线电指挥机器人，只给目标，不给步骤。Shakey 分层干活：STRIPS 排出动作顺序，PLANEX 执行并盯着进度，最底下是“推箱子”这类自带感知和纠错的动作。
body.en: When SRI began the project in 1966, most automata ran on a few simple onboard logic circuits. SRI wanted a full-scale computer to direct a mobile robot by radio, giving it a goal but not the steps. Shakey worked in layers: STRIPS planned a sequence of actions, PLANEX carried out and monitored the plan, and at the bottom sat preprogrammed actions such as pushing a box, each with its own sensing and error recovery.

detail.zh:
一次实验的任务，是用 2 号箱子把一扇门堵上。走到半路，实验者在它要经过的门前放了一只陌生箱子。摄像机看到路被挡，把箱子记进模型。PLANEX 没有从头重排，换了一组房间绕过去，照样把门堵上。

能这样绕，是因为 STRIPS 存下的计划带参数：不记“经过这几个房间”，记的是“从某个房间穿过一个中间房间，进到第三个房间堵门”。下一个任务是把那只箱子推开，它直接借用了这个计划的前四步。报告把这看作一种学习。
detail.en:
In one experiment the task was to block a door with box 2. Partway through, the experimenters put an unknown box in front of a door on Shakey's route. The camera saw that the way was blocked, and the box went into the model. PLANEX did not replan from scratch; it went around through a different set of rooms and still blocked the door.

This worked because STRIPS stored plans with parameters. Instead of “go through these rooms”, a plan said “go from some room through an intermediate room into a third, then block the door there.” The next task, pushing the new box aside, reused the first four steps of that plan. The report treated this as a form of learning.

limit.zh: 它只在几间专门布置的房间里活动，门和墙的位置都事先写进了模型。
limit.en: It worked only in a few specially arranged rooms, with doors and walls written into its model in advance.

sources: Nilsson (ed.) · Shakey the Robot, SRI Technical Note 323, April 1984 · chapters 1, 3, 5, 8 and 9
SRI International · publication record for Technical Note 323

title.zh: ALVINN · 让神经网络看路开车
title.en: ALVINN · a neural network learns to steer

hook.zh: 不写看路规则，把图像直接喂给网络，让它说往哪转。
hook.en: No hand-written vision rules: road images go straight into a network that picks the steering direction.

body.zh: 当时的自动导航靠人写的图像处理程序，换了条件就容易出问题。CMU 的 Pomerleau 把摄像机和测距仪的低分辨率图像直接送进一个三层神经网络，让它输出往哪转。网络用 1200 张模拟道路图训练，装上试验车后，在校园林间小路上开过 400 米。
body.en: Navigation systems of the time relied on hand-built image processing, which worked under some conditions and failed under others. Dean Pomerleau at CMU fed low-resolution images from a camera and a laser range finder straight into a three-layer neural network and had it output the direction to steer. Trained on 1,200 simulated road images, it drove CMU's NAVLAB test vehicle along a 400-meter path through campus woods.

detail.zh:
输入很小，视频图只有 30×32 个点。输出是一排 45 个单元：中间代表直走，越往两边转得越急。有了逼真的模拟道路，反向传播半小时就训出一个还不错的跟路系统，传统方法调了好几个月才到相近水平。

1990 年的后续论文改成边看人开车边学。只看人开，网络学不会车偏了怎么拉回来，所以每张图像都在软件里平移、旋转出 14 张。网络每秒处理 25 张图，车速能开到试验车的上限，每小时 20 英里。
detail.en:
The input was tiny: the video image had just 30×32 points. The output was a row of 45 units, the middle one meaning straight ahead and outer ones meaning sharper turns. With a realistic road simulator, backpropagation produced a fairly good road follower in half an hour; traditional methods had taken many months of tuning to reach a similar level.

A 1990 follow-up learned by watching a person drive. A network that only sees good driving never learns to recover from drifting, so each image was shifted and rotated in software into 14 more. The network processed 25 images a second, enough to drive at the NAVLAB's top speed of 20 miles per hour.

limit.zh: 1988 年那版只在晴天的一条校园小路上实测过，遇到岔路方向会来回摆。
limit.en: The 1988 network was tested on the vehicle only along one campus path on sunny days, and at forks its steering swung back and forth.

sources: Pomerleau · ALVINN: An Autonomous Land Vehicle in a Neural Network, NIPS 1988 proceedings record

title.zh: Stanley · 赢下沙漠无人车赛
title.en: Stanley · Winning DARPA's desert robot race

hook.zh: 无人干预，Stanley 最先跑完 2005 年的沙漠赛道。
hook.en: With no human help, Stanley was first to finish the 2005 desert course.

body.zh: 2004 年第一届 DARPA 大挑战，没一辆车跑完全程的 5%。2005 年的第二届，同样不准人工干预。激光只能可靠地看清前方约 22 米，斯坦福的 Stanley 让摄像机学会激光认出的路面颜色，往更远处找路。它用 6 小时 53 分 58 秒最先跑完。
body.en: At the first DARPA Grand Challenge in 2004, no vehicle covered more than 5% of the course. The 2005 race again allowed no human intervention. Stanford's Stanley could trust its lasers only about 22 meters ahead, so its camera learned the color of road the lasers had confirmed and looked for drivable ground farther out. It finished first, in 6 hours, 53 minutes, and 58 seconds.

detail.zh:
定位的小误差会被放大。激光打在前方最远约 30 米处，车身俯仰或侧倾估计差不到 0.5 度，平地上就会冒出“幻影障碍”。团队让人只在没障碍的路上开，用这些粗糙标签自动调参数，可行驶区域被误判成障碍的比例从 12.6% 降到 0.002%。

视觉也起了作用。论文估计，如果没有摄像机、全程限速每小时 25 英里，用时约 7 小时 5 分，可能落到 CMU 的 Sandstorm 之后。
detail.en:
Small pose errors got magnified. The lasers hit the ground up to about 30 meters ahead, so an error under half a degree in estimated pitch or roll created phantom obstacles on flat ground. The team had a person drive only over clear ground and used those rough labels to tune parameters automatically. The share of drivable area misread as obstacle fell from 12.6% to 0.002%.

Vision mattered too. The paper estimates that without the camera, capped at 25 miles per hour the whole way, Stanley would have taken about 7 hours and 5 minutes and possibly finished behind CMU's Sandstorm.

limit.zh: 比赛环境是静态的；作者说，Stanley 不能在车流里开，也分不清高草和石头。
limit.en: The race environment was static; the authors say Stanley could not drive in traffic or tell tall grass from rocks.

sources: Thrun et al. · Stanley: The Robot that Won the DARPA Grand Challenge, Journal of Field Robotics 23(9), 2006 · author PDF, §§1, 5–6, 10–11

title.zh: GroupLens · 让口味相近的人互相推荐
title.en: GroupLens · letting like-minded readers recommend to each other

hook.zh: 看和你口味相近的人怎么打分，猜你会不会喜欢这篇帖子。
hook.en: It predicts your rating of a post from people whose past ratings matched yours.

body.zh: 1994 年前后，Usenet 已有 8000 多个新闻组，读者只能按内容和作者筛，或者靠版主把关。GroupLens 改看别人的评价：读者读完给帖子打 1 到 5 分。服务器先算谁和谁过去打分相近，再用口味相近的人的评分，预测你会给新帖打几分。
body.en: Around 1994, Usenet carried more than 8,000 newsgroups. Readers could filter by content or author, or rely on a moderator to judge for everyone. GroupLens used other readers' opinions instead. People rated each article from 1 to 5; servers worked out whose past ratings matched whose, then predicted how much you would like a new article from the ratings of people with similar taste.

detail.zh:
论文举了个小例子。过去的打分里，Ken 和 Meg 完全同步，Ken 和 Lee 大体相反。一篇新帖，Meg 打了 5 分，Lee 打了 2 分。喜欢它的人和 Ken 口味一致，不喜欢的人和他相反，所以给 Ken 的预测是 4.56 分。

作者还设想过怎样比较算法：删掉评分矩阵里的一些分数，看谁猜得回来。2006 年起的 Netflix Prize 也是这样比的，藏起一部分已知评分，比谁猜得准。
detail.en:
The paper works through a small example. In past ratings, Ken and Meg rose and fell together, while Ken and Lee mostly disagreed. On a new article Meg gave a 5 and Lee a 2. Because the person who liked it shares Ken's taste and the one who disliked it has the opposite taste, Ken's predicted rating is 4.56.

The authors also planned how to compare algorithms: delete some ratings from the matrix and see who recovers them best. The Netflix Prize, from 2006, compared predictions the same way, by hiding known ratings.

limit.zh: 没人评过的帖子它猜不了，新用户也得先攒一阵评分才有用。
limit.en: It cannot predict anything for an article nobody has rated, and new users must build up ratings before predictions help.

sources: Resnick, Iacovou, Suchak, Bergstrom & Riedl · GroupLens: An Open Architecture for Collaborative Filtering of Netnews, CSCW '94, pp. 175–186 · author-hosted copy, including Figure 5 and the prediction example
Koren, Bell & Volinsky · Matrix Factorization Techniques for Recommender Systems, IEEE Computer 42(8), 2009 · section on recommender system strategies and Figure 1

title.zh: Okapi BM25 · 把词频和文档长度算进排序
title.en: Okapi BM25 · counting term frequency and document length

hook.zh: 词出现越多分越高，但会饱和；文档越长，同样的词越不值钱。
hook.en: Repeated terms help with diminishing returns, and the same count is worth less in longer documents.

body.zh: 检索系统要按相关程度给文档排序。Okapi 系统起初不管词出现几次、文档多长，作者后来发现这样会偏爱长文档。他们把词频和长度加进公式，1994 年又把两个变体合成带参数的 BM25：词出现越多分越高，但会饱和；文档越长，同样的词频得分越低。
body.en: A retrieval system ranks documents by how relevant they are to a query. City University's Okapi system at first ignored how often a term appeared in a document and how long the document was; the authors later found this favored long documents. They then added term frequency and length, and in 1994 merged two variants into one parameterized formula, BM25. More occurrences raise the score with diminishing returns, and the same count is worth less in a longer document.

detail.zh:
按论文常用的参数算一下。在平均长度的文档里，一个词出现 1 次得 1 分；出现 10 次，也只得 2.5 分。同样 10 次，放在两倍平均长度的文档里，只得约 2.22 分。

这个公式后来进了常用的开源搜索库：2016 年，Apache Lucene 把默认打分换成了 BM25。
detail.en:
Here is the paper's formula with its usual parameters. In a document of average length, one occurrence of a term scores 1. Ten occurrences score only 2.5. The same ten occurrences in a document twice the average length score about 2.22.

The formula later went into widely used open-source search software: in 2016, Apache Lucene made BM25 its default scoring.

limit.zh: 它只数查询词出现几次、文档多长，不懂同义词，也不管词序。
limit.en: BM25 only counts query terms and document length; it knows nothing of synonyms or word order.

sources: Robertson, Walker, Jones, Hancock-Beaulieu & Gatford · Okapi at TREC-3, §§1, 3.2, 8–9 and Table 10 (PDF hosted by Microsoft Research)

title.zh: Netflix Prize · 用矩阵分解预测评分
title.en: Netflix Prize · Predicting ratings by matrix factorization

hook.zh: 给每个用户、每部电影各学一个向量，内积就是预测评分。
hook.en: Learn a vector for each user and each movie, and their inner product predicts the rating.

body.zh: 2006 年，Netflix 悬赏 100 万美元，求把自家算法的评分误差降低 10%。经典做法是找口味相近的用户来推。Koren 等人总结比赛经验，主张矩阵分解：给每个用户、每部电影各学一个向量，内积就是预测评分。大奖在 2009 年 9 月颁出。
body.en: In 2006 Netflix offered $1 million for cutting the rating error of its own algorithm by 10%. The classic approach found users with similar taste and borrowed their ratings. Koren, Bell, and Volinsky distilled the contest's lessons in favor of matrix factorization: learn a vector for each user and each movie, and take their inner product as the predicted rating. The grand prize was awarded in September 2009.

detail.zh:
文章里有个小例子：所有电影平均 3.7 星，《泰坦尼克号》比一般电影高 0.5 星，Joe 打分偏严，平均低 0.3 星。只看偏差，Joe 给它的估计就是 3.9 星，剩下的才交给两个向量的内积去解释。

大奖颁给了 BellKor's Pragmatic Chaos 队，获胜提交的误差比 Netflix 好 10.06%。The Ensemble 队的成绩一模一样，只是晚交了约 20 分钟。
detail.en:
The article gives a small example. Say the average rating is 3.7 stars, Titanic runs 0.5 stars above average, and Joe, a critical user, rates 0.3 stars below average. From biases alone, Joe's estimate for Titanic is 3.9 stars; only the rest is left for the user and movie vectors to explain.

The prize went to BellKor's Pragmatic Chaos, whose winning submission was 10.06% better than Netflix on the official leaderboard. The Ensemble had exactly the same score but submitted about 20 minutes later.

limit.zh: 获胜提交混合了 100 多组预测器；评分太少的新用户、新电影，照样难推。
limit.en: The winning entry blended more than 100 predictor sets, and new users and movies with few ratings stayed hard.

sources: Koren, Bell & Volinsky · Matrix Factorization Techniques for Recommender Systems, IEEE Computer 42(8), August 2009 · DOI record
Netflix Prize · official home page, archived January 2010: grand prize awarded September 21, 2009
Netflix Prize · official leaderboard, archived January 2011

title.zh: GraphCast · 从历史数据学天气预报
title.en: GraphCast · Learning weather forecasts from historical data

hook.zh: 算出 10 天的全球天气预报，一台 TPU 上不到一分钟。
hook.en: It produces a ten-day global forecast in under a minute on a single TPU.

body.zh: 中期天气预报一直靠超级计算机解大气方程，几十年的历史数据很难拿来改进模型。GraphCast 从这些数据里学：输入此刻和 6 小时前的全球大气，预测 6 小时后，一步步推到 10 天。和 ECMWF 最好的确定性预报 HRES 比，它在九成评测目标上明显更准。
body.en: Medium-range forecasts have long come from supercomputers solving the equations of the atmosphere, and decades of historical data were hard to use for improving the model. GraphCast learns from that data directly. It takes the global atmosphere now and six hours earlier, predicts six hours ahead, and repeats the step to reach ten days. Against HRES, ECMWF's best deterministic forecast, it was significantly more accurate on 90% of verification targets.

detail.zh:
一次预测要处理多少数？0.25 度的经纬网格约有 104 万个格点。每个格点上有 227 个变量，整个状态约 2.36 亿个数。模型先把格点信息编码到二十面体网格上，用图神经网络在节点间多轮传递消息，再解码回经纬格点。

训练用的是 1979–2017 年的数据。在 32 台 Cloud TPU v4 上训了约四周。它没有专门为极端天气训练，但拿来追踪气旋时，2018–2021 年的路径中位误差比 HRES 小。
detail.en:
How many numbers go into one step? The 0.25-degree grid has about 1.04 million points. Each point carries 227 variables, so a full state is about 236 million numbers. The model encodes grid values onto an icosahedral mesh, passes several rounds of messages between nodes with a graph neural network, and decodes back to the grid.

The paper trains on data from 1979 to 2017. Training took about four weeks on 32 Cloud TPU v4 devices. It was not trained specifically for extreme weather, yet when used to track cyclones, its median track error over 2018–2021 was lower than HRES's.

limit.zh: 它只给一个确定的预报，给不出各种可能结果的分布，也离不开传统数值模式。
limit.en: It gives one deterministic forecast, not a range of possible outcomes, and still depends on traditional numerical models.

sources: Lam et al. · GraphCast: Learning skillful medium-range global weather forecasting, arXiv v2, 2023-08-04 · introduction, GraphCast, verification, severe-event and discussion sections
Same paper · arXiv v1, 2022-12-24, Figure 1 and discussion
Science · DOI record of the published article, 2023

title.zh: o1 · 先想一阵再回答
title.en: o1 · Thinking before answering

hook.zh: 用强化学习教模型先写一长串思路，再给答案。
hook.en: Reinforcement learning taught a model to work through a long chain of thought before answering.

body.zh: o1 用大规模强化学习训练：回答之前，先在内部写一长串思路，学着发现错误、换个办法。OpenAI 报告，训练时多做强化学习、回答时多想一会儿，成绩都会往上走。2024 年 AIME 数学竞赛题上，GPT-4o 平均做对 12%，o1 单次作答做对 74%。
body.en: o1 was trained with large-scale reinforcement learning to work through a long internal chain of thought before answering, learning to catch its mistakes and try other approaches. OpenAI reported that scores rose both with more RL during training and with more thinking time when answering. On 2024 AIME competition problems, GPT-4o solved 12% on average; o1 solved 74% in a single attempt.

limit.zh: 有些写作类任务上，人们反而更喜欢别的模型；原始思路也只给用户看摘要。
limit.en: On some writing tasks people preferred other models, and users see only a summary of its reasoning.

sources: OpenAI · Learning to reason with LLMs, 2024-09-12

title.zh: Gemini 1.5 · 一次读进百万词元
title.en: Gemini 1.5 · Reading a million tokens at once

hook.zh: 上下文从 3.2 万词元拉到 100 万，研究里试到了 1000 万。
hook.en: The context window went from 32,000 tokens to one million, with 10 million tried in research.

body.zh: Gemini 1.0 一次只能读 3.2 万个词元。1.5 Pro 换成 MoE 架构，向部分用户开放了 100 万词元的上下文，一小时的视频也能整段放进去。把一句话藏进这么长的输入里，它几乎每次都能找回来。
body.en: Gemini 1.0 could read 32,000 tokens at a time. Gemini 1.5 Pro moved to a mixture-of-experts architecture and opened a one-million-token context to some users, enough for an hour of video in one prompt. Hide one sentence anywhere in that much input and it found it almost every time.

limit.zh: 藏一句话再找出来，是最简单的长文测试；同时藏 100 句，召回率只有六成多。
limit.en: Finding one hidden sentence is the simplest long-context test; with 100 hidden sentences, recall fell to just over 60%.

sources: Gemini Team · Gemini 1.5 technical report, arXiv v1, 2024-03-08

title.zh: GB200 NVL72 · 一整柜当一块 GPU 用
title.en: GB200 NVL72 · A whole rack acting as one GPU

hook.zh: 72 块 Blackwell GPU 用 NVLink 连成一体，装进一个液冷机柜。
hook.en: 72 Blackwell GPUs joined by NVLink into one domain, liquid-cooled in a single rack.

body.zh: 大模型拆到很多 GPU 上训练和推理，卡与卡之间的通信常常卡住整体速度。GB200 NVL72 把 72 块 Blackwell GPU 装进一个液冷机柜，用第五代 NVLink 连成一个域，每块 GPU 的双向带宽 1.8 TB/s。新的 Transformer Engine 还加入了 4 位浮点推理。
body.en: Training and serving large models across many GPUs often stalls on communication between them. GB200 NVL72 puts 72 Blackwell GPUs in one liquid-cooled rack and joins them with fifth-generation NVLink into a single domain, at 1.8 TB/s of bidirectional bandwidth per GPU. Its new Transformer Engine also adds 4-bit floating-point inference.

limit.zh: 宣传的推理提速，是特定输入长度和延迟设定下的估算；发布时还写着规格可能调整。
limit.en: The headline inference speed-ups are estimates for set input lengths and latency targets, and the launch said specs could change.

title.zh: AlphaFold 3 · 从单个蛋白到分子组合
title.en: AlphaFold 3 · From single proteins to molecular complexes

hook.zh: 把蛋白质、DNA、RNA 和小分子放在一起，预测它们怎么结合。
hook.en: It predicts how proteins, DNA, RNA and small molecules fit together.

body.zh: 细胞里的蛋白质、DNA 和其他分子从不单独工作，要看懂生物，得看它们怎么相互作用。AlphaFold 3 一次预测整个复合物的三维结构：扩散模块从一团原子出发，一步步收拢成最终的坐标。在蛋白质和其他分子的相互作用上，它比已有方法至少准 50%。
body.en: Inside a cell, proteins, DNA and other molecules never work alone, so understanding biology means seeing how they interact. AlphaFold 3 predicts the 3D structure of a whole complex: a diffusion module starts from a cloud of atoms and refines it step by step into final coordinates. For interactions between proteins and other molecule types, it was at least 50% more accurate than existing methods.

limit.zh: 它给出的是静态结构，看不到分子怎么动；在无序区域还会编出不存在的结构。
limit.en: It predicts static structures, not how molecules move, and it can invent structure in disordered regions.

sources: Nature · Accurate structure prediction of biomolecular interactions with AlphaFold 3, 2024-05-08

title.zh: Llama 3.1 · 把 405B 的权重放出来
title.en: Llama 3.1 · Releasing weights at 405B

hook.zh: 最大的 405B 版本也能下载权重，自己部署、自己微调。
hook.en: Even the largest, 405B version came with weights to download, run and fine-tune yourself.

body.zh: Meta 说，开放模型的能力此前大多落后于闭源模型。Llama 3.1 放出了三个尺寸的权重，最大的 405B 用超过 15 万亿词元训练，还量化到 FP8，一台服务器就能跑起来。
body.en: Meta noted that open models had mostly trailed closed ones in capability. Llama 3.1 released weights in three sizes; the largest, at 405B parameters, was trained on more than 15 trillion tokens and quantized to FP8 so it runs on a single server.

limit.zh: 许可证是 Meta 自定的社区许可：月活超过 7 亿的公司要另行申请，衍生模型名字得带 Llama。
limit.en: The licence is Meta's own: companies above 700 million monthly users must ask separately, and derived models must carry the Llama name.

title.zh: 诺贝尔奖 · 物理和化学奖都给了 AI
title.en: Nobel Prizes · Physics and chemistry honour AI

hook.zh: 物理奖颁给神经网络的奠基工作，化学奖颁给蛋白质设计与结构预测。
hook.en: Physics honoured the foundations of neural networks; chemistry honoured protein design and structure prediction.

body.zh: 2024 年 10 月，诺贝尔物理学奖授予 Hopfield 和 Hinton，表彰让人工神经网络能够学习的奠基性发现。第二天，化学奖一半给了做计算蛋白质设计的 Baker，另一半给了做蛋白质结构预测的 Hassabis 和 Jumper。评奖说明写到，AlphaFold2 已被 190 个国家的两百多万人用过。
body.en: In October 2024 the Nobel Prize in Physics went to John Hopfield and Geoffrey Hinton for foundational discoveries that let artificial neural networks learn. A day later, half of the Chemistry prize went to David Baker for computational protein design, and half to Demis Hassabis and John Jumper for protein structure prediction. The announcement notes that AlphaFold2 had been used by more than two million people in 190 countries.

limit.zh: 奖项回顾的是已有的成果；AI 还能给物理和化学带来什么，要靠之后的研究回答。
limit.en: The prizes recognise work already done; what AI adds to physics and chemistry next is for later research to show.

sources: Nobel Prize in Physics 2024 · press release, 2024-10-08
Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2024 · press release, 2024-10-09

title.zh: MCP · 给 AI 工具一个统一接口
title.en: MCP · One standard connector for AI tools

hook.zh: 数据源做成 MCP 服务器，AI 应用当客户端，接一次就能通用。
hook.en: Data sources run as MCP servers and AI apps connect as clients, so one integration works across tools.

body.zh: 模型被挡在数据孤岛外面，每接一个新数据源都要单独写一套集成，很难扩展。2024 年 11 月，Anthropic 开放了 Model Context Protocol：数据和工具做成 MCP 服务器，AI 应用作为客户端去连。发布时附带了规范、SDK，以及 Google Drive、Slack、GitHub 等六个现成的服务器。
body.en: Models were cut off from data behind silos, and every new data source needed its own custom integration, which was hard to scale. In November 2024 Anthropic opened the Model Context Protocol: data and tools are exposed as MCP servers, and AI applications connect to them as clients. The launch came with the specification, SDKs, and six ready-made servers, including Google Drive, Slack and GitHub.

limit.zh: 发布时只能在本地连 MCP 服务器，远程部署的工具包还在路上。
limit.en: At launch, MCP servers could only be connected locally; toolkits for remote deployment were still to come.

sources: Anthropic · Introducing the Model Context Protocol, 2024-11-25

title.zh: DeepSeek-V3 · 用 FP8 训练大 MoE
title.en: DeepSeek-V3 · Training a large MoE in FP8

hook.zh: 每个词只用到一小部分参数，整套训练用 FP8 跑完。
hook.en: Each token uses a small share of the parameters, and the whole run trained in FP8.

body.zh: 低精度训练省显存、省时间，但激活、权重和梯度里的离群值容易把训练带偏。DeepSeek-V3 是一个 MoE 模型，每个词只激活 6710 亿参数中的 370 亿。报告说它首次在这么大的模型上验证了 FP8 混合精度训练，整套正式训练用了 278.8 万个 H800 GPU 小时。
body.en: Low-precision training saves memory and time, but outliers in activations, weights and gradients can throw it off. DeepSeek-V3 is a mixture-of-experts model that activates 37B of its 671B parameters for each token. Its report says it was the first to validate FP8 mixed-precision training at this scale; the full official run took 2.788 million H800 GPU hours.

limit.zh: 这个成本只算正式训练，之前的研究和消融实验不在里面；推荐的部署单元也偏大。
limit.en: That cost covers only the official run, not earlier research and ablations, and the recommended deployment unit is large.

sources: DeepSeek-AI · DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report, arXiv v1, 2024-12-27

title.zh: IEA《能源与 AI》 · 给数据中心用电算总账
title.en: IEA Energy and AI · Counting what data centres use

hook.zh: 2024 年数据中心用了全球约 1.5% 的电，到 2030 年预计翻倍。
hook.en: Data centres used about 1.5% of the world's electricity in 2024, and the projection doubles by 2030.

body.zh: AI 到底要用多少电，决策者和市场一直缺少看清的工具。国际能源署 2025 年 4 月的报告估算，2024 年全球数据中心用电约 415 太瓦时；到 2030 年预计翻一倍多，约 945 太瓦时，比日本今天全国的用电还略多。
body.en: Policy makers and markets had lacked the tools to see how much electricity AI would need. The International Energy Agency's April 2025 report estimates that data centres used about 415 TWh in 2024 and projects more than double that, around 945 TWh, by 2030, slightly more than Japan uses today.

limit.zh: 越往后越难说准：到 2035 年，几种情景的估计从 700 到 1700 太瓦时不等。
limit.en: The further out, the less certain: by 2035, estimates across scenarios range from 700 to 1,700 TWh.

sources: IEA · Energy and AI, executive summary, 2025-04-10
IEA · Energy and AI press release, 2025-04-10
IEA · Energy and AI, full report, April 2025, §2.2, §2.3.1 and Annex A

title.zh: 编程 agent · 把整件任务交给模型
title.en: Coding agents · Handing over the whole task

hook.zh: 模型自己读仓库、改文件、跑测试，再交给人审。
hook.en: The model reads the repository, edits files and runs the tests, then hands the result back for review.

body.zh: 2021 年的 Copilot 在编辑器里补全代码。2025 年 2 月，Anthropic 推出 Claude Code，在开发者自己的终端里搜代码、改文件、写测试、跑命令、提交。5 月，OpenAI 推出 Codex，把每个任务放进预装了仓库的云端沙箱，几个任务并行跑，通常 1 到 30 分钟做完，附上终端日志和测试结果。
body.en: In 2021, Copilot completed code inside the editor. In February 2025 Anthropic released Claude Code, which searches code, edits files, writes and runs tests, and commits from the developer's own terminal. In May, OpenAI's Codex began running each task in its own cloud sandbox preloaded with the repository, several at once, usually finishing in 1 to 30 minutes with terminal logs and test results attached.

limit.zh: 生成的代码仍要人一一审过；工具调用不稳、长时间运行的命令，也还是难点。
limit.en: People still have to review every change, and unreliable tool calls and long-running commands remain hard.

sources: Anthropic · Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Claude Code, 2025-02-24
Anthropic · Introducing Claude 4 (Claude Code generally available), 2025-05-22
Claude Code docs · Connect Claude Code to tools via MCP

title.zh: IMO · 用自然语言写出金牌证明
title.en: IMO · Gold-medal proofs in plain language

hook.zh: 4.5 小时内读题、写证明，6 道题做对 5 道。
hook.en: Within 4.5 hours, two systems read the problems and wrote proofs that solved five of six.

body.zh: 2024 年，DeepMind 的系统还得先把题目译成 Lean 这样的形式语言，再算两三天。2025 年的国际数学奥林匹克上，Gemini Deep Think 直接读题、写自然语言证明，在考试时限内拿到 35 分（满分 42），由 IMO 协调员按学生标准评分认证。OpenAI 的实验模型也拿到 35 分，由三位前奖牌得主评分。
body.en: In 2024, DeepMind's system still needed the problems translated into a formal language such as Lean and took two to three days. At the 2025 International Mathematical Olympiad, Gemini Deep Think read the problems and wrote natural-language proofs within the time limit, scoring 35 of 42, graded and certified by IMO coordinators. An experimental OpenAI model also scored 35, graded by three former medalists.

limit.zh: IMO 只给答卷评分，不检验系统本身；两个模型当时都还没对外开放。
limit.en: The IMO graded the answers, not the systems behind them, and neither model was publicly available at the time.

sources: Google DeepMind · Gemini Deep Think reaches IMO gold-medal standard, 2025-07-21

title.zh: Genie 3 · 生成能走进去的世界
title.en: Genie 3 · Generating worlds you can walk through

hook.zh: 输入一段文字，生成一个能实时走动的 720p 世界。
hook.en: A text prompt becomes a 720p world you can move through in real time.

body.zh: 一帧一帧往下生成、还要实时接住用户的操作，比一次生成整段视频更难。Genie 3 每生成一帧都参考之前走过的轨迹，不需要显式的 3D 表示，就能以每秒 24 帧实时生成。世界能保持几分钟前后一致，生成过程中还能用文字改变世界里发生的事。
body.en: Generating frame by frame while responding to a user in real time is harder than generating a whole video at once. Genie 3 conditions each new frame on the trajectory so far and needs no explicit 3D representation, running in real time at 24 frames per second. Its worlds stay consistent for a few minutes, and text prompts can change events in them as they run.

limit.zh: 能做的动作还很有限；多个角色同时互动、几小时的连续体验，都还做不到。
limit.en: The actions available are still limited, and several interacting agents or hours of continuous play are out of reach.

sources: Google DeepMind · Genie 3: a new frontier for world models, 2025-08-05

title.zh: AI 做数学研究 · 解开悬而未决的问题
title.en: AI in maths research · Settling open problems

hook.zh: 通用推理模型推翻了 Erdős 问题上的一个猜想，Lean 替机器证明把关。
hook.en: A general reasoning model disproved a conjecture on an Erdős problem, and Lean checked machine proofs at scale.

body.zh: 2025 年，AI 在竞赛题上拿到金牌线；2026 年，它开始碰没人解开的问题。5 月，OpenAI 的一个通用推理模型推翻了平面单位距离问题上的一个长期猜想，证明由外部数学家核对过。同月的一篇预印本让语言模型写 Lean 形式证明、再交给机器检查，在 353 个未解的 Erdős 问题里自主解决了 9 个。
body.en: In 2025, AI reached gold-medal level on competition problems; in 2026 it began settling questions nobody had answered. In May, a general-purpose OpenAI reasoning model disproved a longstanding conjecture on the planar unit-distance problem, and outside mathematicians checked the proof. A preprint the same month had language models write formal proofs in Lean for a machine to check, and resolved 9 of 353 open Erdős problems on its own.

limit.zh: 语言模型单独写的证明还靠不住，得有人核对或交给 Lean 检查；成功率也只有几个百分点。
limit.en: Proofs written by language models alone are still unreliable, so people or Lean must check them, and the hit rate is a few percent.

sources: OpenAI · An OpenAI model has disproved a central conjecture in discrete geometry, 2026-05-20
Tsoukalas et al. · Advancing Mathematics Research with AI-Driven Formal Proof Search, arXiv v1, 2026-05-21
Feng et al. (Google DeepMind) · Towards Autonomous Mathematics Research, arXiv v1, 2026-02-10

title.zh: DeepSeek-V4 · 让百万上下文变便宜
title.en: DeepSeek-V4 · Making a million tokens cheap

hook.zh: 改了注意力，长上下文的 KV cache 只剩一成；权重按 MIT 许可开放。
hook.en: Redesigned attention cuts the long-context KV cache to a tenth, with weights under the MIT licence.

body.zh: 上下文越长，每生成一个词要读的 KV cache 越大，长上下文一直很贵。2026 年 4 月的 DeepSeek-V4 预览版改了注意力的设计：在 100 万词元的上下文里，V4-Pro 每个词的推理计算只要 V3.2 的 27%，KV cache 只要 10%。DeepSeek 自己的服务也把 100 万上下文设成了默认。
body.en: The longer the context, the bigger the KV cache each new token has to read, so long context stayed expensive. DeepSeek-V4 Preview, released in April 2026, redesigned attention: at a one-million-token context, V4-Pro needs 27% of V3.2's per-token inference compute and 10% of its KV cache. DeepSeek's own services made a one-million-token context the default.

limit.zh: 发布时是预览版，各项成绩都是 DeepSeek 自己报告的。
limit.en: It launched as a preview, and every score comes from DeepSeek's own reports.

title.zh: TPU 8t 与 8i · 训练和推理分开造芯片
title.en: TPU 8t and 8i · Separate chips for training and serving

hook.zh: 同一代 TPU 拆成两颗：一颗管训练，一颗管推理。
hook.en: One TPU generation split into two chips: one for training, one for serving.

body.zh: 训练要大量芯片一起算，推理要低延迟地回应，尤其是 agent 之间频繁往来的时候。2026 年 4 月，Google 的第八代 TPU 分成专做训练的 TPU 8t 和专做低延迟推理、内存带宽更大的 TPU 8i。一个 8t 超节点能连 9600 颗芯片；两颗芯片的每瓦性能都比上一代 Ironwood 最多高一倍。
body.en: Training needs many chips computing together, while serving needs low latency, especially when agents trade many messages. In April 2026, Google's eighth-generation TPU split into TPU 8t for training and TPU 8i for low-latency inference with more memory bandwidth. One TPU 8t superpod links 9,600 chips, and both chips deliver up to twice the performance per watt of the previous generation, Ironwood.

limit.zh: 发布时还没正式上市，不少数字是“最多”的情况。
limit.en: They were not yet generally available at launch, and several figures are best cases.

sources: Google · Our eighth generation TPUs: two chips for the agentic era, 2026-04-22

title.zh: 网络安全能力过线 · 先交给防守的一方
title.en: Cyber capability crosses a line · Defenders first

hook.zh: 模型能自己找出并利用未知漏洞后，几家公司改了发布方式。
hook.en: Once models could find and exploit unknown flaws on their own, labs changed how they released them.

body.zh: 2026 年，几家实验室报告，新模型已经能自己找出未知漏洞、写出利用方法。Anthropic 的 Claude Mythos Preview 不对公众开放，只给维护关键软件的组织用来修漏洞；Google 先把 Gemini 4 Argon 交给经过筛选的防守方。OpenAI 的 GPT-6 Astra 是它第一个达到网络安全“严重”级别的模型，公开发布时加强了防护。
body.en: In 2026, several labs reported that their new models could find unknown vulnerabilities and write exploits for them. Anthropic kept Claude Mythos Preview out of general release and gave it to organisations that maintain critical software, to fix flaws; Google rolled Gemini 4 Argon out first to vetted defenders. OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra, its first model at the Critical level of cybersecurity capability, was released broadly with strengthened protections.

limit.zh: 这些能力和漏洞数量，都来自各家自己的报告。
limit.en: These capabilities and vulnerability counts all come from the labs' own reports.

title.zh: 尼亚加拉 · 把交流电送到远处
title.en: Niagara · Sending AC power far away

hook.zh: 高压交流电让电站可以建在离用户很远的地方。
hook.en: High-voltage AC let power stations stand far from the people they served.

body.zh: 珍珠街的直流电只能送到附近几栋楼。1895 年，尼亚加拉瀑布的 Adams 水电站投入运行，用高压交流电把电送到远处，电站从此不必挨着用户。IEEE 把它记作交流电胜过直流电的关键一役。
body.en: Pearl Street's direct current reached only nearby buildings. In 1895 the Adams hydroelectric plant at Niagara Falls went into operation, sending power far away as high-voltage alternating current, so stations no longer had to sit next to their customers. IEEE records it as a key victory for AC over DC.

limit.zh: 它解决了把电送远；电从哪里来、电网怎么调度，留给了后来一代代电站和电网。
limit.en: It solved sending power far; where power comes from and how a grid is run were left to later plants and grids.

sources: IEEE Milestone · Adams Hydroelectric Generating Plant, 1895
Tesla · US patent 382,280, electrical transmission of power, 1888-05-01

title.zh: EDVAC 报告 · 把程序存进存储器
title.en: EDVAC report · Keeping the program in memory

hook.zh: 运算、控制、存储、输入、输出分开，指令也放进存储器。
hook.en: Arithmetic, control, memory, input and output as separate parts, with the instructions held in memory.

body.zh: 一台通用机器要做很长的计算，指令放在哪里？1945 年 6 月，冯·诺伊曼在 EDVAC 报告的草稿里把机器分成运算、控制、存储、输入和输出几部分，并把指令当作存储器要装的内容。这份草稿流传很广，影响了此后许多计算机的设计。
body.en: Where should a general-purpose machine keep the instructions for a long computation? In June 1945, von Neumann's draft report on the EDVAC divided the machine into arithmetic, control, memory, input and output, and treated instructions as something the memory must hold. The draft circulated widely and shaped the design of many later computers.

limit.zh: 它是一份没写完的草稿，许多工程细节要等真正造机器时才解决。
limit.en: It was an unfinished draft; many engineering details waited for the machines that were actually built.

sources: von Neumann · First Draft of a Report on the EDVAC, 1945-06-30 (Godfrey's edited text, IEEE Annals 1993)

title.zh: 图灵 1950 · 用模仿游戏问机器能否思考
title.en: Turing 1950 · Asking about thinking machines through a game

hook.zh: 把含糊的“机器能思考吗”，换成一个能检验的模仿游戏。
hook.en: He replaced the vague “Can machines think?” with an imitation game that can be tested.

body.zh: “机器能思考吗”这个问题太含糊，没法研究。1950 年，图灵把它换成模仿游戏：只靠文字交流，提问的人能不能分辨对面是人还是机器。文章还指出数字计算机是通用机器，并设想让机器像孩子一样学习。
body.en: “Can machines think?” was too vague to study. In 1950 Turing replaced it with the imitation game: talking only in writing, can an interrogator tell a person from a machine? The paper also points out that digital computers are universal machines and sketches machines that learn, the way a child does.

limit.zh: 模仿游戏测的是像不像人，不等于测出了理解或智能本身。
limit.en: The game measures whether a machine passes for a person, not understanding or intelligence itself.

sources: Turing · Computing Machinery and Intelligence, Mind 59, 1950, §§1, 5, 7

title.zh: 集成电路 · 把整个电路做进一块半导体
title.en: Integrated circuit · A whole circuit in one piece of semiconductor

hook.zh: 不再一个个焊元件，整块电路做在同一块半导体上。
hook.en: Instead of wiring parts together, the whole circuit is built in one piece of semiconductor.

body.zh: 以前的电路由一个个分立元件和导线组装而成。1959 年，Kilby 申请的专利把电路的全部元件做进同一块半导体；同年 Noyce 的专利在氧化层上沉积金属引线，把元件连起来。Moore 1965 年的预测，讲的就是这种集成电路。
body.en: Circuits used to be assembled from separate components and wires. In 1959 Kilby filed a patent for a circuit with every component built into one body of semiconductor; the same year Noyce's patent laid metal leads on an oxide layer to connect them. Moore's 1965 forecast is about these integrated circuits.

limit.zh: 元件越挤越密，怎么散热、怎么把线做得更细，留给了后来几十年。
limit.en: Packing parts ever closer left heat and ever finer wiring to the decades that followed.

title.zh: MOSFET · 隔着氧化层用电场控制电流
title.en: MOSFET · Controlling current through an oxide

hook.zh: 硅上长一层二氧化硅，上面放电极，用电场开关电流。
hook.en: An electrode over a thin oxide layer switches the current with an electric field.

body.zh: 1960 年 5 月，Kahng 申请专利：在硅上热生长一层二氧化硅，再在上面放电极，用电场控制下面的电流。这就是 MOSFET。后来的单管 DRAM 和 Dennard 的缩放规则，都建立在这种器件上。
body.en: In May 1960 Kahng filed a patent: grow a thin layer of silicon dioxide on silicon, put an electrode on top, and use the electric field to control the current beneath. This is the MOSFET. The one-transistor DRAM cell and Dennard's scaling rules both build on it.

limit.zh: 器件越做越小，漏电和发热越来越难控制。
limit.en: As the devices shrank, leakage and heat grew harder to control.

sources: Kahng · US patent 3,102,230, electric field controlled semiconductor device, filed 1960-05-31

title.zh: LISP · 给符号推理一门语言
title.en: LISP · A language for reasoning with symbols

hook.zh: 用递归函数处理符号表达式，成了 AI 研究常用的语言。
hook.en: Recursive functions over symbolic expressions; it became AI research's working language.

body.zh: 要让程序推理，就得处理符号，而不只是数字。1960 年 4 月，McCarthy 发表 LISP 的论文：用递归函数处理符号表达式，最早在 IBM 704 上为“建议接受者”实验而写。十年后，造 Shakey 机器人的团队仍把它当作主要编程工具。
body.en: Reasoning programs have to handle symbols, not just numbers. In April 1960 McCarthy published LISP: recursive functions over symbolic expressions, first built on the IBM 704 for the Advice Taker experiments. A decade later the team behind the Shakey robot still called it their principal programming tool.

limit.zh: 它方便写符号推理，数值计算还是交给 FORTRAN 这样的语言。
limit.en: It made symbolic reasoning easy to write, while numerical work still went to languages such as FORTRAN.

sources: McCarthy · Recursive Functions of Symbolic Expressions and Their Computation by Machine, CACM, April 1960

title.zh: 卡尔曼滤波 · 边测量边修正估计
title.en: Kalman filter · Correcting an estimate with each measurement

hook.zh: 每来一个新测量，就按各自的误差修正一次状态估计。
hook.en: Each new measurement corrects the state estimate, weighted by how uncertain each is.

body.zh: 维纳滤波要求统计特性不变，算起来也麻烦。1960 年，卡尔曼换成状态空间的写法：每来一个新测量，就递推地更新一次状态估计和它的误差协方差，不用保存全部历史。它后来成了导航和机器人里的标准工具。
body.en: Wiener-style filters assumed unchanging statistics and were hard to compute. In 1960 Kalman recast the problem in state-space form: each new measurement updates the state estimate and its error covariance recursively, with no need to keep the full history. It became a standard tool in navigation and robotics.

limit.zh: 原始形式假设系统是线性的、噪声是高斯的，非线性问题要另作近似。
limit.en: The original form assumes linear systems and Gaussian noise; nonlinear problems need approximations.

sources: Kalman · A New Approach to Linear Filtering and Prediction Problems, J. Basic Engineering 82, 1960

title.zh: Atlas 虚拟内存 · 两层存储看起来像一层
title.en: Atlas virtual memory · Two stores that look like one

hook.zh: 程序员不用再自己在磁芯和磁鼓之间搬数据。
hook.en: Programmers no longer moved data between core and drum by hand.

body.zh: 快的磁芯存储小，慢的磁鼓大，程序员得自己决定什么时候把代码和数据搬进搬出。1962 年，曼彻斯特的 Atlas 让硬件和监控程序自动完成这件事，在用户看来只有一层存储，这就是虚拟内存。六十年后，vLLM 用同样的分页思路管理 KV cache。
body.en: Fast core memory was small and the drum was large but slow, so programmers decided by hand when to move code and data between them. In 1962 Manchester's Atlas had the hardware and supervisor do it automatically, so users saw a single level of store: virtual memory. Sixty years later, vLLM manages the KV cache with the same paging idea.

limit.zh: 要用的内容不在快存储里时，程序还是得停下来等慢存储。
limit.en: When the data is not in the fast store, the program still waits on the slow one.

sources: Kilburn, Edwards, Lanigan & Sumner · One-Level Storage System, IRE Trans. EC-11(2), April 1962 (CHM reprint)

title.zh: 分组交换 · 把消息切成小块各自寻路
title.en: Packet switching · Messages cut into blocks that find their own way

hook.zh: 标准大小的消息块逐站存储转发，坏掉几个节点也能绕过去。
hook.en: Standard message blocks are stored and forwarded hop by hop, routing around lost nodes.

body.zh: 集中式或分层的网络，关键节点一坏就会断。1964 年，兰德公司的 Baran 提出分布式网络：消息切成标准大小的块，每个节点先存下再转发，按自适应路由绕开坏掉的节点和线路。十几年后的 Ethernet 论文，题目里就写着“分组交换”。
body.en: Centralised and hierarchical networks fail when key nodes or links are lost. In 1964 RAND's Paul Baran proposed a distributed network: messages are cut into standard blocks, stored and forwarded at each node, and routed adaptively around damage. Twelve years later the Ethernet paper put “packet switching” in its title.

limit.zh: 每一跳都要存储再转发，延迟和拥塞留给了后来的协议去处理。
limit.en: Storing and forwarding at every hop left delay and congestion for later protocols.

sources: Baran · On Distributed Communications, RAND RM-3420, 1964

title.zh: 低损耗光纤 · 用纯净玻璃把光送远
title.en: Low-loss optical fibre · Sending light far through pure glass

hook.zh: 高锟算出：玻璃只要够纯，光信号就能传上百公里。
hook.en: Charles Kao calculated that light could travel a hundred kilometres in glass that was pure enough.

body.zh: 1960 年代的光纤只能把光信号传 20 米左右。1966 年，在英国 STL 工作的高锟算出：用最纯的玻璃，光信号能传 100 公里。四年后的 1970 年，第一根超纯光纤做了出来，2009 年他因此获得诺贝尔物理学奖。
body.en: Fibres of the 1960s carried light signals only about 20 metres. In 1966 Charles Kao, at STL in the UK, calculated that fibre of the purest glass could carry them 100 kilometres. The first ultrapure fibre was made four years later, in 1970, and he shared the 2009 Nobel Prize in Physics for the work.

limit.zh: 光纤解决了传输，路由和交换仍在电子设备里完成。
limit.en: Fibre solved transmission; routing and switching still happened in electronics.

sources: Nobel Prize in Physics 2009 · press release, 2009-10-06

title.zh: Dennard 缩放 · 越做越小，功率密度不变
title.en: Dennard scaling · Smaller, at the same power density

hook.zh: 尺寸和电压一起按比例缩小，单位面积的功耗保持不变。
hook.en: Scale dimensions and voltage together, and power per unit area stays the same.

body.zh: MOSFET 要缩小，怎样缩才还能正常工作？1974 年，IBM 的 Dennard 等人给出一套比例规则：尺寸和电压一起按同一个比例缩小，器件更快，单位面积的功耗却不变。同样大小的芯片能放下更多电路，发热却不跟着变多。
body.en: How should a MOSFET shrink and still work? In 1974 Dennard and colleagues at IBM gave scaling rules: shrink dimensions and voltage by the same factor, and devices get faster while power per unit area stays the same. A chip of the same size holds more circuits without running hotter.

limit.zh: 它要求电压跟着降；电压降不动时，功率密度就会上升。
limit.en: It needs the voltage to fall too; when voltage stops falling, power density rises.

sources: Dennard et al. · Design of Ion-Implanted MOSFETs with Very Small Physical Dimensions, IEEE JSSC SC-9(5), 1974

title.zh: EM 算法 · 数据缺一块也能做最大似然
title.en: EM algorithm · Maximum likelihood with part of the data hidden

hook.zh: 先估计缺的部分，再更新参数，两步交替直到收敛。
hook.en: Estimate the hidden part, update the parameters, and alternate until they settle.

body.zh: 数据有一部分看不到时，最大似然估计很难直接算。1977 年，Dempster、Laird 和 Rubin 给出通用做法：E 步按当前参数估计缺失部分，M 步据此更新参数，两步交替。HMM 的 Baum-Welch 训练是它的特例，IBM 的翻译模型也用它训练。
body.en: When part of the data is hidden, maximum likelihood is hard to compute directly. In 1977 Dempster, Laird and Rubin gave a general recipe: the E step estimates the hidden part from the current parameters, the M step updates the parameters, and the two alternate. Baum–Welch training for HMMs is a special case, and IBM's statistical translation models were trained with it.

limit.zh: 每一步都不会变差，但可能停在局部最优，起点不好就会卡住。
limit.en: No step makes things worse, but it can stop at a local optimum, so a poor start can leave it stuck.

sources: Dempster, Laird & Rubin · Maximum Likelihood from Incomplete Data via the EM Algorithm, JRSS-B 39(1), 1977

title.zh: RISC · 用精简指令集造处理器
title.en: RISC · Reduced instructions for single-chip processors

hook.zh: 少数几条简单指令做了大部分工作，那就把指令集做简单。
hook.en: A few simple instructions do most of the work, so keep the instruction set simple.

body.zh: 指令集越加越复杂，实际跑的却大多是几条简单指令：一个 IBM 360 编译器里，10 条指令就占了 80% 的执行。1980 年，Patterson 和 Ditzel 主张，单芯片的 VLSI 处理器应该围绕精简的指令集来设计。
body.en: Instruction sets kept growing, yet most of the work was done by a few simple instructions: in one IBM 360 compiler, 10 instructions accounted for 80% of execution. In 1980 Patterson and Ditzel argued that single-chip VLSI processors should be built around reduced instruction sets.

limit.zh: 指令简单了，程序会变长，更多负担转给了编译器。
limit.en: Simpler instructions make programs longer and shift more of the work to the compiler.

sources: Patterson & Ditzel · The Case for the Reduced Instruction Set Computer, SIGARCH CAN, 1980

title.zh: 闪存 · 一整块一起用电擦除
title.en: Flash memory · Erasing a whole block electrically at once

hook.zh: 不用紫外线，也不用每位两个晶体管，按块一次擦掉。
hook.en: No ultraviolet light, no two transistors per bit: erase a whole block at once.

body.zh: EPROM 要用紫外线擦除，能电擦的 EEPROM 每位又要两个晶体管。1984 年 12 月，东芝的舛冈富士雄在 IEDM 上发表闪存：用电把一整块存储单元一次擦掉。几年后又有了 NAND 闪存。
body.en: EPROMs had to be erased with ultraviolet light, and electrically erasable EEPROMs needed two transistors per bit. In December 1984 Fujio Masuoka of Toshiba presented flash memory at IEDM: a whole block of cells erased electrically at once. NAND flash followed a few years later.

limit.zh: 每个单元能擦写的次数有限，用久了会磨损。
limit.en: Each cell can be erased only so many times before it wears out.

sources: Semiconductor History Museum of Japan · flash memory record (Masuoka, Toshiba, IEDM 1984)

title.zh: 贝叶斯网络 · 在依赖图上传递信念
title.en: Bayesian networks · Passing beliefs over a dependency graph

hook.zh: 每个节点只和邻居交换消息，整张图的判断仍然前后一致。
hook.en: Each node exchanges messages only with its neighbours, yet the whole graph stays consistent.

body.zh: 证据不确定时，推理容易前后矛盾。1985 年，Pearl 用一张依赖图表示变量之间的关系，让每个节点只和邻居传递消息，最后收敛到全局一致的信念。这成了概率图模型的基础。
body.en: Reasoning from uncertain evidence easily contradicts itself. In 1985 Pearl represented the relations between variables as a dependency graph in which each node passes messages only to its neighbours, converging to beliefs that are consistent overall. It became the basis of probabilistic graphical models.

limit.zh: 图里有环时，局部传消息不一定收敛，精确推理也可能很难算。
limit.en: When the graph has loops, local message passing may not converge, and exact inference can be intractable.

sources: Pearl · Bayesian Networks: A Model of Self-Activated Memory for Evidential Reasoning, UCLA CSD-850017, April 1985
Same paper · Cognitive Science Society proceedings, 1985
Heckerman & Shortliffe · From Certainty Factors to Belief Networks, Artificial Intelligence in Medicine, 1992
Smyth, Heckerman & Jordan · Probabilistic Independence Networks for Hidden Markov Probability Models, Neural Computation 9, 1997

title.zh: 台积电 · 只替别人造芯片
title.en: TSMC · Making only other companies' chips

hook.zh: 设计芯片不必自建晶圆厂，制造交给专门的代工厂。
hook.en: Designing chips no longer required owning a fab.

body.zh: 以前要做芯片，基本得自己有晶圆厂。1987 年，张忠谋创立台积电，只按客户的设计制造，自己不卖芯片，开创了纯代工模式。2022 年的 H100 就造在台积电的 4N 工艺上。
body.en: Making chips used to mean owning a fab. In 1987 Morris Chang founded TSMC to manufacture only its customers' designs and sell no chips of its own, pioneering the pure-play foundry model. NVIDIA's 2022 H100 is built on TSMC's 4N process.

limit.zh: 设计和制造分开以后，最先进的工艺集中在少数代工厂手里。
limit.en: With design and manufacturing separated, the most advanced processes sit with a few foundries.

title.zh: 神经语言模型 · 给每个词学一个向量
title.en: Neural language model · Learning a vector for every word

hook.zh: 词向量和下一个词的概率一起学，没见过的句子也能估计。
hook.en: Word vectors and next-word probabilities learned together, so unseen sentences can still be scored.

body.zh: n-gram 模型只认得见过的词组，换个说法就不会了。2003 年，Bengio 等人用神经网络同时学两样东西：每个词的向量，以及根据前几个词的向量预测下一个词的概率。意思相近的词向量相近，没见过的句子也能估计。word2vec 就从这个模型出发。
body.en: N-gram models know only the word sequences they have seen. In 2003 Bengio and colleagues trained a neural network to learn two things at once: a vector for each word, and the probability of the next word given the vectors of the previous ones. Similar words get similar vectors, so unseen sentences can still be scored. word2vec started from this model.

limit.zh: 要对整个词表算概率，词表一大，训练就很慢。
limit.en: Computing probabilities over the whole vocabulary made training slow for large vocabularies.

sources: Bengio, Ducharme, Vincent & Jauvin · A Neural Probabilistic Language Model, JMLR 3, 2003

title.zh: GAN · 让生成器和判别器对抗
title.en: GANs · A generator trained against a discriminator

hook.zh: 一个网络造样本，另一个网络辨真假，两边一起练。
hook.en: One network makes samples, another tells real from fake, and they train together.

body.zh: 怎么让神经网络学会生成像真的一样的样本？2014 年，Goodfellow 等人让两个网络对抗：生成器造样本，判别器判断样本来自真实数据还是生成器，生成器的目标是让判别器出错。整个系统用反向传播就能训练。后来的扩散模型拿 GAN 作对照来比生成质量。
body.en: How can a neural network learn to generate samples that look real? In 2014 Goodfellow and colleagues set two networks against each other: a generator makes samples, a discriminator judges whether a sample came from the data or the generator, and the generator tries to make it wrong. The whole system trains with backpropagation. Diffusion models later measured their sample quality against GANs.

limit.zh: 两个网络一起练不稳定，有时生成器只会造几种样本。
limit.en: Training two networks together is unstable, and the generator can collapse to a few kinds of samples.

sources: Goodfellow et al. · Generative Adversarial Networks, arXiv, 2014-06-10

title.zh: Gender Shades · 按人群分开看准确率
title.en: Gender Shades · Accuracy broken down by group

hook.zh: 深肤色女性错误率达 34.7%，浅肤色男性至多 0.8%。
hook.en: Error rates reached 34.7% for darker-skinned women but at most 0.8% for lighter-skinned men.

body.zh: 商用人脸分类器通常只报一个总体准确率。2018 年，Buolamwini 和 Gebru 按肤色和性别交叉分组，审查了三家商用系统：深肤色女性的错误率高达 34.7%，浅肤色男性最高只有 0.8%。
body.en: Commercial face classifiers were sold with a single overall accuracy. In 2018 Buolamwini and Gebru audited three commercial systems by skin type and gender together and found darker-skinned women misclassified most, with error rates up to 34.7%, against at most 0.8% for lighter-skinned men.

limit.zh: 它审查的是性别分类这一个任务，别的任务要各自分组再测。
limit.en: It audited gender classification alone; other tasks need their own breakdowns.

title.zh: RAG · 生成之前先去查资料
title.en: RAG · Looking things up before generating

hook.zh: 生成模型配一个文档索引，答案有出处，知识也能更新。
hook.en: A generator paired with a document index: answers with sources, and knowledge that can be updated.

body.zh: 预训练模型把知识记在参数里，要精确调用、给出出处、更新知识都不方便。2020 年，Lewis 等人把一个 seq2seq 生成器和一个维基百科的稠密向量索引接在一起：先检索相关段落，再据此生成答案。它在三个开放域问答任务上刷新了最好成绩。
body.en: Pretrained models store knowledge in their parameters, which makes precise recall, provenance and updates hard. In 2020 Lewis and colleagues connected a seq2seq generator to a dense vector index of Wikipedia: retrieve relevant passages first, then generate the answer from them. It set the state of the art on three open-domain QA tasks.

limit.zh: 检索不到或检索错了，生成的答案也跟着错。
limit.en: If retrieval misses or fetches the wrong passage, the answer goes wrong with it.

sources: Lewis et al. · Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks, arXiv v1, 2020-05-22

title.zh: Waymo · 驾驶座上没人的公开服务
title.en: Waymo · Public rides with nobody at the wheel

hook.zh: 在凤凰城，普通乘客可以叫到驾驶座上没人的车。
hook.en: In Phoenix, members of the public could hail cars with nobody in the driver's seat.

body.zh: 自动驾驶长期停在演示和带安全员的试点。2020 年 10 月，Waymo 在凤凰城向公众开放完全无人驾驶的叫车服务，驾驶座上没有人。在这之前，早期乘客当年的行程里已有 5% 到 10% 是完全无人的。
body.en: Self-driving had long stayed at demos and pilots with safety drivers. In October 2020 Waymo opened fully driverless rides to the public in Phoenix, with nobody in the driver's seat. Before that, 5–10% of early riders' trips that year had already been fully driverless.

limit.zh: 服务一开始只覆盖凤凰城的一片区域，不是哪里都能开。
limit.en: The service first covered one area around Phoenix, not anywhere.

sources: Waymo · Waymo is opening its fully driverless service to the general public in Phoenix, 2020-10-08
Thrun · What we're driving at, Official Google Blog, 2010-10-09

title.zh: LoRA · 冻住大模型，只训一小块
title.en: LoRA · Freezing the model, training a small update

hook.zh: 在每层加低秩矩阵来训练，可训练参数少一万倍。
hook.en: Train small low-rank matrices in each layer: 10,000 times fewer trainable parameters.

body.zh: 为每个任务都存一份完整微调过的 1750 亿参数模型，代价太高。2021 年，Hu 等人提出 LoRA：冻住预训练权重，只在每层加入可训练的低秩分解矩阵。对 GPT-3，可训练参数少一万倍，硬件需求降到三分之一，效果与全量微调相当或更好。
body.en: Keeping a full fine-tuned copy of a 175-billion-parameter model for every task is too expensive. In 2021 Hu and colleagues proposed LoRA: freeze the pretrained weights and inject trainable low-rank matrices into each layer. For GPT-3 it cut trainable parameters 10,000-fold and hardware needs threefold, matching or beating full fine-tuning.

limit.zh: 低秩更新能改的东西有限，任务离原模型太远时未必够用。
limit.en: A low-rank update can only change so much; tasks far from the original model may need more.

sources: Hu et al. · LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models, arXiv v1, 2021-06-17

title.zh: 思维链提示 · 让模型先写推理步骤
title.en: Chain-of-thought prompting · Writing out the steps first

hook.zh: 示例里写出推理过程，大模型的多步推理明显变好。
hook.en: Show worked reasoning in the examples, and large models do much better at multi-step problems.

body.zh: 模型越做越大，数学应用题、符号操作这类多步推理的成绩却几乎不涨。2022 年，Wei 等人在提示的示例里写出一步步的推理过程，让模型照着先写思路再给答案，足够大的模型在这些任务上明显变好。后来的 o1 和 R1，用强化学习来训练这条思维链。
body.en: As models grew, scores on multi-step tasks such as math word problems and symbolic manipulation stayed nearly flat. In 2022 Wei and colleagues put step-by-step reasoning into the prompt's examples, so the model wrote out its reasoning before answering, and sufficiently large models did markedly better. o1 and R1 later trained this chain of thought with reinforcement learning.

limit.zh: 写出来的思路不一定是模型真正的计算过程，也可能一本正经地推错。
