description.en: Post-training first trains domain experts with SFT and RL by GRPO, then merges them by distillation.

description.zh: 1956 年的 Dartmouth 会上，Newell、Shaw 和 Simon 介绍了他们写 Logic Theorist 用的表处理语言 IPL 2。
description.en: At the 1956 Dartmouth project, Newell, Shaw and Simon presented IPL 2, the list language they had written the Logic Theorist in.

description.zh: Moore 在 2003 年的回顾报告里，把 4004 放在他集成度和处理器性能曲线上微处理器那一段的起点。
description.en: In a 2003 retrospective, Moore placed the 4004 at the start of the microprocessor series on his complexity and performance curves.

description.zh: 后来的理论工作证明，带位置编码和硬注意力的 Transformer 能模拟任意图灵机。
description.en: Later theory proves that a Transformer with positional encodings and hard attention can simulate any Turing machine.

description.zh: 从 1979 年 5 月起，ARPANET 每个节点都用基于 Dijkstra 算法的最短路径优先来算路由。
description.en: From May 1979 every ARPANET node computed its routes with shortest-path-first, based on Dijkstra's algorithm.

description.zh: Nogueira 和 Cho 让 BERT 对 BM25 检索出的前 1000 段重新排序，超过了 BM25 和此前的神经排序。
description.en: Nogueira and Cho fine-tune BERT to re-rank BM25's top 1,000 passages, beating BM25 and earlier neural rankers.

description.zh: IEA 用 IT 用电乘以 PUE 算数据中心总用电，基准情景下全球平均 PUE 从 1.41 降到 1.29。
description.en: The IEA multiplies IT demand by PUE to get data-centre electricity, and in its Base Case the global average PUE falls from 1.41 to 1.29.

description.zh: DeepMind 的 Aletheia 研究 agent 跑在拿到 IMO 金牌线的 Gemini Deep Think 的进阶版上，把它从竞赛题带到未解的 Erdős 问题。
description.en: DeepMind's Aletheia research agent runs on an advanced version of the IMO-gold Gemini Deep Think and takes it from competition problems to open Erdős problems.

description.zh: Moore 1965 年的文章预测的就是集成电路：一块电路上最省钱的元件数会怎样增长。
description.en: Moore's 1965 paper forecasts integrated circuits: how the cheapest number of components per circuit will grow.

description.zh: MCS-4 的发布广告把这套芯片组介绍为四颗新的集成电路。
description.en: The MCS-4 announcement presents the chip set as four new ICs.

description.zh: Kilby 的专利把晶体管、二极管、电阻和电容都做进同一块半导体。
description.en: Kilby's patent builds transistors, diodes, resistors and capacitors into one body of semiconductor.

description.zh: Dennard 的单管 DRAM 专利题为“场效应晶体管存储器”，每一位用一个场效应管加一个电容存储。
description.en: Dennard's one-transistor DRAM patent, “Field-effect transistor memory”, stores each bit with one field-effect transistor and a capacitor.

description.zh: 这篇论文给出 MOSFET 按比例缩小的规则：尺寸、电压一起缩，功率密度不变。
description.en: The paper gives the rules for shrinking a MOSFET: scale dimensions and voltage together and power density stays the same.

description.zh: TPU 论文说它的指令沿用 CISC 传统，一条指令平均要跑 10 到 20 个时钟周期。
description.en: The TPU paper says its instructions follow the CISC tradition, averaging 10 to 20 clock cycles each.

description.zh: RISC 论文引用一个 IBM 360 编译器的统计：10 条指令占了 80% 的执行。
description.en: The RISC paper cites one IBM 360 compiler in which 10 instructions accounted for 80% of execution.

description.zh: H100 有 800 亿个晶体管，用台积电的 4N 工艺制造。
description.en: H100 has 80 billion transistors and is built on TSMC's 4N process.

description.zh: 台积电宣布，N7+ 是第一个大批量为客户交付产品的 EUV 工艺。
description.en: TSMC announced N7+ as the first EUV process delivering customer products to market in high volume.

description.zh: DDPM 把 GAN 列为此前的生成模型之一，并拿 ProgressiveGAN 比较样本质量。
description.en: DDPM lists GANs among earlier generative models and compares its sample quality with ProgressiveGAN.

description.zh: word2vec 从 Bengio 等人的前馈神经网络语言模型讲起，去掉其中最费时的非线性隐藏层，专门学词向量。
description.en: word2vec starts from the feedforward neural network language model of Bengio et al. and drops its costly non-linear hidden layer to learn word vectors alone.

description.zh: Ethernet 论文的题目就是“局域网的分布式分组交换”，开头还说 ARPA 网络推动了把计算机当分组交换机来用。
description.en: The Ethernet paper is titled “Distributed Packet Switching for Local Computer Networks”, and its introduction credits the ARPA network with advancing computers as packet switches.

description.zh: Shakey 的技术报告说，LISP 是团队的主要编程工具。
description.en: Shakey's technical note names LISP as the team's principal programming tool.

description.zh: McCarthy 回忆，他想要一门做 AI 用的代数式表处理语言，这个念头起于 1956 年夏天的 Dartmouth 会议。
description.en: McCarthy recalled that his wish for an algebraic list-processing language for AI arose during the 1956 Dartmouth summer project.

description.zh: o1 用强化学习训练模型怎样用思维链思考，学着发现错误、换个办法。
description.en: o1 uses reinforcement learning to train how the model thinks with its chain of thought, learning to catch mistakes and try other approaches.

description.zh: R1 论文开头说，o1 靠加长思维链在推理时多用算力；R1-Zero 只用强化学习，思维链就越写越长。
description.en: The R1 paper opens by noting that o1 scaled inference by lengthening the chain of thought; R1-Zero, trained with RL alone, learned to write ever longer chains.

description.zh: PagedAttention 借用操作系统的虚拟内存和分页，论文引了 Kilburn 等人 1962 年的 Atlas 论文。
description.en: PagedAttention borrows virtual memory and paging from operating systems, citing Kilburn et al.'s 1962 Atlas paper.

description.zh: Stanley 用一个无迹卡尔曼滤波器估计车的位置、朝向和速度。
description.en: Stanley estimates the vehicle's position, orientation and velocity with an unscented Kalman filter.

description.zh: IBM 的五个翻译模型用 EM 算法反复迭代来估计参数。
description.en: IBM's five translation models estimate their parameters by iterating the EM algorithm.

description.zh: Rabiner 指出，HMM 的 Baum-Welch 重估计和 EM 算法是等价的。
description.en: Rabiner notes that Baum–Welch re-estimation for HMMs is equivalent to the EM algorithm.

description.zh: RAG 的消融实验把可学习的稠密检索器换成固定的 BM25；在 FEVER 上，BM25 反而最好。
description.en: RAG's ablations swap its learned dense retriever for a fixed BM25 one; on FEVER, BM25 did best.

description.zh: RAG 的检索器里，查询和文档各用一个 BERT 编码成向量。
description.en: In RAG's retriever, queries and documents are each encoded into vectors by a BERT model.

description.zh: IEEE 把 Adams 电站记作交流电胜过直流电的关键一役；珍珠街供的是直流电。
description.en: IEEE records the Adams plant as a key victory of AC over DC; Pearl Street supplied DC.

description.zh: 文章第 5 节说，数字计算机能模仿任何离散状态机，所以是通用机器。
description.en: Section 5 argues that digital computers can mimic any discrete-state machine, which makes them universal machines.

description.zh: LoRA 主要在 GPT-3 175B 上检验：冻住它的权重，只训低秩更新。
description.en: LoRA is tested chiefly on GPT-3 175B, freezing its weights and training only low-rank updates.

description.zh: Model Cards 的引言引用 Gender Shades，说明人脸属性检测在不同人群上表现不一。
description.en: The Model Cards introduction cites Gender Shades on face-attribute detection performing unevenly across groups.

description.zh: Datasheets 开头举 Gender Shades 为例：商用性别分类系统在深肤色女性上错误率更高。
description.en: Datasheets opens with Gender Shades as an example: commercial gender classifiers err more on darker-skinned women.

description.zh: 法案要求通用模型的提供者保存并提供技术文档；Model Cards 提议的是随模型发布的说明。
description.en: The Act requires providers of general-purpose models to keep and supply technical documentation; Model Cards proposed documentation released alongside a model.

description.zh: Backus 后来把 FORTRAN 这类语言叫作“冯·诺伊曼语言”：变量模仿存储单元，赋值模仿一次次取数和存数。
description.en: Backus later called FORTRAN and its successors “von Neumann languages”: variables imitate storage cells, and assignment imitates fetching and storing one word at a time.

description.zh: 书里说，闪存和 DRAM 每 GB 太贵，放不下大量或很少访问的数据，所以机房里仍以磁盘为主。
description.en: The book notes that flash, like DRAM, cost too much per gigabyte for large or rarely used data, so disks still dominated.

description.zh: MYCIN 的主要作者 Shortliffe 和 Heckerman 后来写道，贝叶斯网络克服了 MYCIN 确定性因子的许多局限，他们的实验室也早已不再用确定性因子。
description.en: Shortliffe, MYCIN's lead author, and Heckerman later wrote that belief networks overcome many limits of MYCIN's certainty factors, which their lab had long stopped using.

description.zh: Smyth、Heckerman 和 Jordan 把 HMM 画成一张贝叶斯网络，Rabiner 讲的前向-后向和 Viterbi 算法，都是图上通用推理的特例。
description.en: Smyth, Heckerman and Jordan draw the HMM as a belief network and show that Rabiner's forward–backward and Viterbi algorithms are special cases of general graph inference.

description.zh: Waymo 的前身是 Google 的无人车项目。Thrun 说，团队从 DARPA 挑战赛招来工程师，其中就有 Stanley 的软件负责人 Montemerlo。
description.en: Waymo grew out of Google's self-driving project, which Thrun said recruited engineers from the DARPA Challenges, among them Montemerlo, Stanley's software lead.

description.zh: Ethernet 论文说，作为传输介质的 Ether 可以用同轴电缆、双绞线或光纤来做。
description.en: The Ethernet paper says the Ether, its transmission medium, can be built from coaxial cable, twisted pairs or optical fibres.
